text: Go back down the slope, then head southwest toward a shack near the beach to grab the Isolated Merchant's Shack grace.
Buy a Lantern from the Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) if you can spare the runes. If not, you can buy it later.
Golden Rune [5] B: Found at the shore surrounded by Skeleton enemies.
Golden Rune [1]: Found on a dead body.
Golden Rune [2]: Can be looted off of defeated Rats within the Tombsward Cave.
Travel to the Church of Elleh and talk to Kale about the howling in Mistwood to learn the Finger Snap gesture.
Locate Blaidd at the top of Mistwood Ruins. Use the Finger Snap gesture below him, then talk to him after he jumps down.
Return to Kale and talk to him about Blaidd.
Golden Rune [2]: Found on a dead body by the sea.
Bloodhound Knight Darriwil: Boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol . Drops the Bloodhound's Fang Curved Greatsword
Bloodhound's Fang: Curved Greatsword. Dropped by the boss of Forlorn Hound Evergaol , Bloodhound Knight Darriwil .
Blaidd's summon sign can be found in the evergaol if you spoke to him in Mistwood Ruins. (Summoning NPCs is generally not needed to progress questlines and will result in 25% fewer runes.)
After the fight, talk to Blaidd to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [2], then speak with him again to unlock a talisman for sale later.
miss: Must be done before entering Ranni's service, or before talking to Blaidd or Jerren at the Radahn Festival.

region: First steps in Limgrave · meeting 3 of 5
title: Talk to Blaidd
text: Blaidd's Second Encounter. Darriwil can be fought at the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, where Blaidd will become available as a summon. Speak to Blaidd again after the fight. Talking to Blaidd once will yield a Somber Smithing stone [2]. Talk to him a second time and he will mention a blacksmith along the Road to the Manor in Liurnia, and instruct the player to say that "Blaidd sent them". Doing this will unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest in the blacksmith's shop. If the Evergaol fight was completed before meeting Blaidd, he will still be available to speak to here after the player talks to him in the Mistwood Ruins.

title: Ash of War: Wild Strikes
text: Ash of War: Wild Strikes: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab located in the middle of the path leading from the Stormhill Shack site of grace to the Castleward Tunnel site of grace.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7]
text: Lump of Flesh: Can be found on a dead body by the road.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7]: It can be taken from a dead man sitting at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

region: Early Liurnia and Caelid · meeting 1 of 6
title: Talk to Finger Reader
text: She is sitting on at table at the start of the collapsed bridge.

title: Ash of War: Storm Wall
text: Ash of War: Storm Wall: Find a Teardrop Scarab , defeat it to obtain the Ash of War .

title: Sacred Tear
text: Continue up the nearby slope until you reach the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace.
Sacred Tear: Found inside the Church of Irith

region: Early Liurnia and Caelid · meeting 1 of 2
title: Talk to Thops
text: Thops: Tops is a former student of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Teaches basic Sorceries, and will move if you give him a Glintstone Academy Key.

title: Academy Scroll
text: Warming Stone: Consumable. 3x Warming Stone on a graveyard protected by several undead.
Academy Scroll: Key Item. Give to a mage to unlock more sorceries. It's by one of the big gravestones where the Skeleton Mages are rising.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]
text: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [1]: Dropped by one of the Nobles in that enemy outpost.

title: Sacrificial Twig
text: Continue downhill and activate the Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Sacrificial Twig: Special Consumable Talisman. Found on a corpse on a stone platform jutting out of the cliff to the east. Accessible from above only, by heading east from Malefactor's Evergaol.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Liurnia of the Lakes
text: Found by a campfire on the west road after passing through the outpost to the northwest of Church of Irith, before entering the forest in Liurnia of the Lakes.

title: Boss: Adan, Thief of Fire
text: Optional Boss. Imprisoned within the Malefactor's Evergaol . Drops the Flame of the Fell God spell upon defeat.

title: Map (Liurnia, East)
text: Buy a Lantern from the Nomadic Merchant (South Liurnia) if you didn't get it earlier.
Map (Liurnia, East): It's in the middle of the swampy lake, by a monument that has highlightened texts over it.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]
text: If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, you'll find the Idus Sword next to a tree west-southwest of the stele.
Continue along the watery path until you notice the Laskyar Ruins grace on your right side.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [2]: Found in a corpse just by the Laskyar Ruins Site of Grace. Unlocks crafting of Freezing Grease .

title: Meeting Place Map
text: Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse to the right of the steps to the gazebo in the center of the Laskyar Ruins .
Meeting Place Map: Can be found at the entrace of the Raya Lucarian academy, on lying corpse.

title: Golden Seed
text: Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Looted off a corpse in the middle of the upper road by the Flame Chariot and Raya Lucaria Soldiers that guard the path to Raya Lucaria Academy.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. One can be found on the ground next to a glowing sapling.

title: Map: Liurnia, North
text: From the golden tree, head southeast until the town is on your left, then continue along the outskirts to find the Academy Gate Town grace.
Map: Liurnia, North: Can be found over a grave-like big stone, at Academy Gate Town,

place.title: Academy Gate Town
walk: Many enemies can be found lurking between the half-submerged buildings of what remains of the Academy Gate Town. The roofs and parts of many buildings stick out from the lake, giving players raised surfaces to use as vantage points or use as height advantage against the surrounding enemies. Though this area takes up quite a large portion of the map, there are few points of interest located here. At one point players may come across Diallos and interact with him while he mourns over Lanya at this location. Elden Ring Map Link Palm ReaderCan be found at the edge of the broken bridge that leads to the Raya Lucaria Academy.
Other than that, some notable items could be found around this sunken town as well.
The Map, for Map: Liurnia, North can be found in this location. Elden Ring Map Link
Ash of War: Charge Forth is dropped by a Teardrop Scarab that is attached to a ceiling under some Land Squirts. Elden Ring Map Link.

Glintstone Craftman's Cookbook [4] can be found in this location. From the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace, head northwest and look for a sunken church building with enemies on the roof. The chest is located inside a tower that you can jump inside open the chest to obtain the cookbook. Elden Ring Interactive Map Here.
Golden Seed can be found on the ground next to a glowing sapling. Elden Ring Map Link.
Smithing Stone (1) can be looted off a corpse. The corpse is resting against a wall. Elden Ring Map Link
Blue-White Wooden Shield is looted en route towards Raya Lucaria Academy. Elden Ring Map Link Here

title: Map (Liurnia, West)
text: West of the grace is a larger tree. From that tree, go north to find Diallos on the northern outskirts and talk to him.
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the northern ruins of Academy Gate Town.
Map (Liurnia, West): Map Fragment. Reveals western Liurnia. Found on a monolith along the road by a junction.

title: Talk to War Counselor Iji
text: Just southwest of the map stele lies the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Follow the dirt path north-northeast through Kingsrealm Ruins and hit the illusory wall at the end to discover the Road to the Manor grace behind it.
War Counselor Iji: Blacksmith - sells Upgrade Materials such as Somber Smithing Stone [1] through [4].

title: Talk to Miriel, Pastor of Vows
text: If you exhausted Blaidd's dialogue after killing Darriwil, tell him that Blaidd sent you to unlock the Carian Filigreed Crest for purchase. Otherwise, it'll be available after entering Ranni's service.
Note: Don't buy any Somberstones from him; you'll have one of each by the end of this section.

Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. One can be looted from a corpse on the manor outer walls, above the entrance to the grounds. This area is only reachable by dropping down from the higher level walkway, right before reaching the lift to the Manor Upper Level site of grace.
Head south from the chair until you reach the Gate Town North grace on the remains of some roofs.

Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Found in Raya Lucaria Academy Rooftops, by jumping from the Tower with the Imbued Sword Key and going around until they can be looted off a corpse overseeing the lift and graveyard.
On the shore east of the building, you'll discover the Eastern Liurnia Lake Shore grace.
Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Three can be looted from a corpse sitting on a chair amid a group of Poison Flowers.
Return to the grace and follow the dirt path to a fork. Take the right path downhill to grab the Study Hall Entrance grace inside a building.
Somber Smithing Stone [3]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found off the road toward Carian Study Hall . It will be just north of the Study Hall Entrance Site of Grace.
Return to the fork and follow the other path uphill until you reach the church at the top. Activate the Church of Vows grace in front of it.
Miriel, Pastor of Vows: Miriel is the steward of Church of Vows , and will accept Scrolls and Tomes and teach lore, Incantations and Sorceries.

title: Gold Sewing Needle, Golden Tailoring Tools
text: Note: Give him the Academy Scroll and any future scrolls or prayerbooks to unlock their spells for purchase. Scrolls can also be given to Sellen or Seluvis (and prayerbooks to Corhyn or Miriel), but Miriel never moves and is the only NPC to accept both types.
Gold Sewing Needle: Sewing needle made of gold. Unique item made to alter demigod attire. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.
Golden Tailoring Tools: Tools made of gold brought with the red-haired Radagon when he married into the Carian line. Located inside a chest at the right of Church of Vows' main entrance.

title: Boss: Bell Bearing Hunter
text: Field Boss. Found at the Church of Vows during night time. Alternatively, you can spawn him by advancing to night, resting at the grace once more and then advancing to morning. Drops the Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing</a. upon defeat.

title: Stonesword Key
text: At the edge of the cliff behind the church sits a corpse with Stormhawk Feather x5.
Grave Violet: Crafting Material. One can be found by a tombstone north from the Chuch of Vows. Beware of an undead ambush.
Talk to Varre at The First Step, answer "I'll fly straight and true!", then exhaust his dialogue.
Head around the building south of Varre and drop down next to the broken pillar to find Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x2 on a ledge below the cliff.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found atop the Frenzied Flame Village outer walls.
Golden Rune [2]: Looted off Liurnia of the Lakes' north-east sarcophagi.

title: Poison Armament
text: Use Torrent to get inside the rightmost ruin and open the chest in the cellar to obtain the Twinblade.
In a corner just east past the rightmost ruin lies a corpse with Crab Eggs.
Go inside the ruined tower to find a Stonesword Key guarded by a rat.
Pick up the Golden Rune [2] next to the tower.
Head down the cellar full of rats and open the trap chest to be transported to Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

Gravity Stone Chunk: Offensive Throwable. 6x found inside a chest in the central storage shed in the main cavern. This is the same shed you are teleported to upon using the trap coffer at the Dragon-Burnt Ruins .
Crouch down and exit the hut toward the right side. Continue downward while crouched to reach the Sellia Crystal Tunnel grace.
Rot Grease: Weapon Coating. Found on a body in the middle of the raised garden-like area in the main keep.

Poison Armament: Incantation . Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the northeast section of Aeonia Swamp. Figure out its pattern via the footprints and wait for the prints to approach and then attack.

title: Rock Sling, Perfumer Traveler's Set +2
text: Note: An easy way to deal with invisible scarabs is to mount up on Torrent and holding R2 or Shift + Left Click to charge a Heavy Attack along its path. When timed right, it should die running into your weapon.
Rune Arc: Located on the island in the Caelid Swamp
Continue southwest from the island to discover the Inner Aeonia grace.

Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a body lying against the cluster of crystals in the ravine south of the Deep Siofra Well . Also accessible by heading north from the Swamp of Aeonia .
Sacramental Bud: Can be found next to the Raven enemy.
Rock Sling: Gravity Sorcery . Found inside a chest in a cellar in the northern section of the Street of Sages Ruins .
Perfumer Traveler's Set: Set includes: Traveler's Hat , Perfumer's Traveling Garb , Traveler's Gloves , Traveler's Slops , can be found on a corpse in a corner in the ruins.
Perfume Bottle: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the corner of the ruins along with the Traveler's Set .
Meteorite Staff: Glintstone Staff with S scaling but no upgrades. Found on a corpse hanging from a window in Street of Sages Ruins in the swamp of Caelid.
Golden Rune [4]: Golden Rune (4) held by a corpse within one of the shattered buildings.

title: Ash of War: Poisonous Mist
text: Head down the cellar in the ruin closest to the corner for a chest with Rock Sling.
Loot the Perfumer Traveler's Set and Perfume Bottle from the ruin in the middle.
In the ruined tower, you'll find the Meteorite Staff and a Golden Rune [4].
Head around the wall southeast of the ruined tower to discover the Aeonia Swamp Shore grace on a ledge near the shore.
Ash of War: Poisonous Mist: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the southwest section of the Swamp of Aeonia .

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Caelid South
text: Southwest of the island, in the distance, is a small mushroom-covered mountain. Head around it to find a Golden Rune [3] guarded by putrid Miranda Sprouts.

Golden Rune [4]: Two Golden Runes (4) within Sellia Gateway . First one is on top of the gateway, held by a dead body inside one of the towers. The second one is at ground level, on the path to Church of the Plague , on a broken pillar.
Crab Eggs: Found on a body underneath a broken cart next to a burnt out campfire and a small red tent.
Continue east from the campsite to discover the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank grace behind a mushroom-covered branch.
Nomadic Merchant Caelid South: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire in south Caelid. Sells the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (15) , among other items.

title: Map (Caelid)
text: Map (Caelid): Map Fragment. Reveals the Caelid region excluding Dragonbarrow . Found on a monolith at the Caelid Highway South intersection.

title: Golden Seed
text: Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree by the side of the road in south Caelid .

title: Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light
text: Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. 3x found on a body sat on a chair on the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia .
Sacramental Bud: Crafting Material. Found on a body sat on a chair in the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia .
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a body on a chair on the southern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia .
Aeonian Butterfly: 1 Aeonian Butterfly can be found on a body in the middle of the swamp here
Somber Smithing Stone [4] A: Found on a body in the swamp next to a Cleanrot Knight
Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the southeast section of Aeonia Swamp.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry, Dectus Medallion +2
text: Travel to Roundtable Hold and talk to Roderika in front of the fireplace.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika.
Return to Roderika and tell her what the blacksmith said.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika, then ask if he'll watch over her; your answer doesn't matter.
Reload the area to find them in the same room. Roderika will now offer to upgrade your spirit ashes.
Talk to Hewg about Roderika now that she's become a spirit tuner.
Talk to Diallos, who is now back at Roundtable Hold.

Note: At this point, you should have eight flasks upgraded to +5 and enough materials to upgrade any Somber weapon to +5. For beginners, I'd go with the Bloodhound's Fang (requires 18 Strength and 17 Dexterity) until you find a weapon you like.
Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry Miniboss. Roams the Caelid Highway South. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight upon defeat.
Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by the Night's Cavalry miniboss roaming the highway upon defeat. Only appears at night.
Dectus Medallion: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest atop the eastern tower in Fort Faroth , accessible via ladder past all the bats on the bottom level.
Radagon's Soreseal: Talisman. Found on a corpse by dropping down the opening on the roof and looking around the wooden walkways.
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1]: Key Item. Dropped by the Crystalian (Ring Blade) Boss at the bottom-most level of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel .
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2]: Bell Bearing. Found in a chest in the first hidden chamber of the Sealed Tunnel . Drop down into the lower section and look to the west to find the chest.
Get the Gold Scarab for 20% more runes from enemies. You'll need to kill the duo boss in Abandoned Cave in Caelid to obtain it.
Cheese the Night's Cavalry on the bridge near Lenne's Rise to ride off the cliff.
Grab the Dectus Medallion (Right) and Radagon's Soreseal from Fort Faroth.
Kill Elder Dragon Greyoll with a bleed weapon and use a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot (and Gold Scarab) before she dies.

Obtain the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1] in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel and Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] in Sealed Tunnel (note that going for the latter will trigger the festival in Caelid, which will progress quite a few questlines).

title: Golden Seed
text: Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit enemy in an unmarked military camp directly south of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree site of grace.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6], Ash of War: Bloody Slash +1
text: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6]: Cookbook item. Can be looted from the chest in the room at the top of the main stairs of Fort Haight .
Ash of War: Bloody Slash: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Beast Crest Heater Knight fought at the top of the ramparts of Fort Haight .
Bloodrose: can be found at the hight level of Fort Haight on a dead body
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found by looting a corpse on the battlements of Fort Haight .
Dectus Medallion: Key Quest Item. Found in a chest that can be reached by climbing the ladder in the tallest tower of Fort Haight .

title: Talk to Kenneth Haight
text: Kenneth Haight will move to this location after you clear our Fort Haight. He can be found up on the battlements where you fought the Beast Crest Heater Knight .

title: Erdsteel Dagger
text: Bloodrose: 6 Bloodrose bushes can be farmed at Fort Haight , at the far Southeast corner of Limgrave. 1 at the entrance stairway, 2 behind the castle, and 3 within the fort's courtyard. After collecting them, teleporting back to the nearby grace site is faster than riding back on Torrent, since the fort is a no-riding zone.
In the room up the first set of stairs is the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6].
Kill the Godrick Knight on the upper level to receive Ash of War: Bloody Slash, then pick up the Bloodrose x5 behind him.
Head down the wooden staircase to the right of the ladder to find a Smithing Stone [1].
Climb the ladder to the top for a chest with the Dectus Medallion (Left).
Erdsteel Dagger: Dagger. Rewarded by Kenneth Haight for clearing out Fort Haight .

title: Talk to Kenneth Haight
text: Kenneth Haight is first encountered at this spot. He is seen dramatically calling out for someone to aid him in his plight.

title: Cracked Pot, Boss: Beastman of Farum Azula
text: Re-enter the fort and talk to Kenneth Haight where the knight was.
Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. Can be found inside Groveside Cave . By the bonfire, there is a body that you can loot to find x1 Cracked Pot.
Golden Rune [1]: Found by a ruin next to the lake.
Beastman of Farum Azula: Optional Boss. Found at the end of the Groveside Cave mini-dungeon. Drops the Flamedrake Talisman .
Flamedrake Talisman: Talisman. Dropped by the Beastman of Farum Azula boss inside Groveside Cave .

title: Armorer's Cookbook [1]
text: Activate the Groveside Cave grace inside and equip your lantern.
Below the ledge in the room is a Cracked Pot.
Golden Rune [1] I: x2 Golden Runes (1) located along the shore.
Kill the Beastman of Farum Azula for Flamedrake Talisman and 1,000 runes.
Armorer's Cookbook [1]: Can be found inside a small camp of Soldiers and Wolves.

place.title: Groveside Cave
walk: Early in the game, you can find minor dungeons that you can complete to find various items and equipment to help you through your journey. One of the locations we would recommend you to travel to is the Groveside Cave situated at West Limgrave, north of Church of Elleh and southwest of Gatefront Ruins Map Coordinates Here. This cave is small in terms of exploring it, and as you move forward, you'll first encounter a pack of Wolves below, and some Cave Moss around. By the bonfire, there is a body that you can loot to find x1 Cracked Pot. Straight ahead is a dead end with two more wolves, there are two more bodies that you can pillage to find x3 Glowstone and x1 Golden Rune (1), as well as some Silver Firefly that's flying by the wall.

Next, head to the east side of the cave where you'll find a gold fog door, beyond it is a boss arena where the Beastman of Farum Azula is. You can visit the boss page for the Beastman of Farum Azula to find our guide on how to defeat it. This enemy rewards you with the Flamedrake Talisman and 1000 Runes. You've now cleared the area and you can interact with the portal mist to fast travel back to the entrance.

title: Homing Instinct Painting
text: Golden Rune [2]: Found on a dead body around the ruins.
Below the ledge east of the wolves, you'll discover the Murkwater Coast grace.
Poisonbloom: Can be found on a dead body in the waters.
Smithing Stone [1]: On a dead body.
Homing Instinct Painting: Key Info Item. Painting inside the Artist's Shack in Limgrave .

title: Boss: Grave Warden Duelist
text: Grab the Artist's Shack grace just outside the shack.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Southwest of the Artist's Shack in Limgrave . In a bug that looks like a Scarab.
Grave Glovewort [1]: Multiple found inside Murkwater Catacombs .
Grave Warden Duelist: Found within Murkwater Catacombs.
Banished Knight Engvall Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the boss of Murkwater Catacombs: Grave Warden Duelist, after Patch 1.03.
Battle Hammer: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs .

place.title: Artist's Shack
walk: Information on how to complete the area and relevant tips for the player go here

title: Invader: Bloody Finger Nerijus, Reduvia
text: Head inside and activate the Murkwater Catacombs grace.

Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is located in the first large room left of the boss' door, right in front of the stairs. The second one is an alcove under the stairs in the same room. The third is found by going through the very narrow corridor adjacent to the stairs in the same room. The fourth one is found by going through the doorway south of where you collected the previous one, sitting on an L-shaped ledge. The fifth one is found by dropping down from where you collected the fourth.
In the room straight ahead is a corpse with Root Resin x5 and a lever that, when pulled, unlocks the door to the boss.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [1] on the way to the boss.
Kill the Grave Warden Duelist for Banished Knight Engvall and 1,700 runes.
Bloody Finger Nerijus: Found while traversing the Murkwater River. Blood Finger Hunter Yura joins to aid you during the fight.
Reduvia: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus

title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura: NPC Questline: Found on the ground level under a broken structure. Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura by resting at a grace after defeating NPC invader Bloody Finger Nerijus.

title: Cloth Garb, Cloth Trousers
text: Cloth Garb: Can be found at the chest at the end of the dungeon in Murkwater Cave
Cloth Trousers: Can be found at the chest at the end of the dungeon in Murkwater Cave
miss: Becomes unobtainable if Patches is killed before he can surrender.

place.title: Murkwater Cave
walk: It is recommended to use a Torch to be able to see. Keep moving, until you reach the first room, in which you will find two people. One is running around, while the second one is sitting on the other corner of the room. There are two traps near the entrance of the room and a third one in its centre : walking through them will ring the alarm and more enemies will come. Deal with the two enemies.

Two more enemies will come from the corridor as soon as you approach it, be ready to dodge. There are three more enemies sitting in the next room. If you are playing a caster, opening with Glintstone Arc is a good idea to strike first and deal massive damage to all. You will find some Cave Moss in the room. Open the chest too loot x5 Mushroom.

Return to the first room and head the other way to find a fog gate Boss room. Traverse it once ready. As you enter, you will notice that there is no boss. Head to the chest and open it. You will hear a voice, unhappy by your actions and demanding revenge. Patches, a veteran FromSoftware character, makes his grandiose entrance. He will then first initiate a boss fight with you. You will eventually be prompted to forgive him during combat.

Once his health reaches about, he will surrender. The sequence won't stop until you cease attacking him. At this point he will be cowering behind his shield and cease his attacks. Do not kill him, and wait for the 'Enemy Felled' notice. You will still receive Golden Rune (1) and the Grovel for Mercy Gesture. Forgive him to return to him here and interact with him again as a merchant. He may be found at another location and his new coordinates are found here: Elden Ring Map

Loot the chest in the room if you haven't already- to obtain Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers. Opening the other chest in the room will have you ensnared in a transporter trap that sends you to Mistwood surrounded by Lesser Runebears, near Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook[4]. Map Link.
Come back to engage in combat again and during the fight he may drop another Gesture, Extreme Repentance. If you choose to kill him off and he will drop:
Patches' Bell Bearing
Spear +7
Leather Armor
Leather Gloves
Leather Boots

title: Boss: Patches
text: Found within Murkwater Cave . After defeating him, he sets up a shop in the Cave.

title: Ash of War: Unsheathe
text: Head inside and grab the Murkwater Cave grace.
Loot Mushroom x5 from the chest straight ahead.
Open the chest in the boss room to obtain Cloth Garb and Cloth Trousers.
After opening the chest, you'll be ambushed by Patches. Bring his HP below 50% without killing him and he'll surrender, giving you Golden Rune [1] x2 and the Grovel for Mercy gesture.
Talk to the now friendly Patches after the fight; your answer doesn't matter.

Remove your weapon and punch him until he becomes hostile. Let him hit you until you're almost dead and he'll give you the Extreme Repentance gesture. Either use it in front of him, or let him kill you.
Reload the area and talk to Patches about the bandits, then about the new chest.
Gold-Tinged Excrement: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on some dead bodies
Ride west-northwest past the sleeping Runebear to find the Mistwood Outskirts grace near a road.
Golden Rune [1]: x3 Found by looting the sarcophagi.
Return to Patches to learn the Calm Down! gesture.

Note: I strongly recommend buying Margit's Shackle from Patches. It can reveal illusory walls, trigger fire-breathing pillars, and (in the DLC) unlock sealed spiritsprings and break pots hanging from cliffs, all from a safe distance.
Exit the cave and continue along the water to find a corpse with Fire Grease under a bridge.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Mistwood Ruins behind a grave near the Sacrificial Twig.
Ash of War: Unsheathe: Can be obtained from a Teardrop Scarab located in the water. Beware of the Giant Crab nearby.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if Patches is killed before he can surrender. Unobtainable if Patches is killed before he gives the gesture. If missed, you can still get it from him in Liurnia or Mt. Gelmir. Unobtainable if Patches is killed before he gives the gesture. If missed, you can still get it from him in Liurnia or Mt. Gelmir.

title: Incantation Scarab
text: Crab Eggs: Found on a body located on the edge. Beware of the small skeleton army you have to face before.
Head toward the ruin west of the crabs and pick up the Slumbering Egg on top of it.
Talk to Yura standing under the ruin.
Grab the Seaside Ruins grace next to the cliff just west of the ruin.
Golden Rune [1] J: Next to a big arch structure, besides a large rock.

Incantation Scarab: Need to examine the Homecoming Painting at Artist's Shack first. The Incantation Scarab can be found Southwest of the Dragon Burnt Ruins , there will be a gravestone with a ghost sitting in front of it. Interact with the ghost, and it will drop the Incantation Scarab.

title: Boss: Flying Dragon Agheel
text: Flying Dragon Agheel: Optional Dragon Boss of Agheel Lake . Rewards a Dragon Heart you can use at the Church of Dragon Communion .

Dragon Heart: Key Consumable. Dropped by Flying Dragon Agheel . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Boss: Stonedigger Troll
text: If you die, you can return to Yura and exhaust his dialogue. His summon sign will then be available near a flat ruin in the lake.
Golden Rune [4]: Golden Rune [4] held by a corpse within the Limgrave Tunnels .
Smithing Stone [1]: Approximately x8 found in Limgrave Tunnels (mostly as yellow glowing stones on wall).
Smithing Stone [1] A: A Smithing Stone found on top of a corpse that lays on the ground. Found together with 3 other dead bodies and a rounded group of chairs.
Smithing Stone [1]: Held by a corpse sitting against a grave, surrounded by Spirit Jellyfishes and Skeleton Enemies .
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse by a staircase leading to a platform with ballistae emplacements.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. 4 can be found on a corpse in the same room where Nepheli Loux is.

Glintstone Scrap: Offensive Consumable. Found inside the Altus Tunnel . In the second cavern, head through the tunnel in the south to find a wooden balcony overlooking a pit. Drop down onto the overgrown root on the left side to reach a lower balcony below where you can find the item on a corpse.
Stonedigger Troll: Optional Boss encountered in the Old Altus Tunnel dungeon. Drops the Great Club weapon upon defeat.
Great Club: Hammer Weapon. Dropped by the Stonedigger Troll boss inside the Old Altus Tunnel upon defeat.
Roar Medallion: Dropped by Stonedigger Troll . Located in Limgrave Tunnels.

place.title: Limgrave Tunnels
walk: The Limgrave Tunnels can be found on the southeast side of the map from the Gatefront Ruins Map Coordinates Here. NOTE: Bring a Torch to light up some sections that are dark. Upon arriving at the Limgrave Tunnels, you'll see a lift that will take you down, step on the button platform and you'll find a Site of Grace there to rest or use as a checkpoint. Notice that when you ride the lift down from the entrance, you'll see that there are two pathways that you'll pass as you go down to the section with the site of grace.

First go back to the top, and on the left (west) side of the lift, you'll see that you can drop down onto the pathway below from the ledge. This is a dead-end, instead, drop down to the other pathway just below and you'll find a corpse at the end, you can pillage it to find x1 Golden Rune (4). Head to the lower section where the site is by dropping onto the platforms that are lit with candles.

Now, proceed north from the checkpoint and you'll encounter Miner enemies. These enemies with their stone skin are resistant to slashing and piercing damage, but weak to strike. Kill the first three on the wooden path, check the locations of the two miners picking at the wall to find x2 Smithing Stone (1). Then head down, turn right and check the nearby corner. There is another Miner there and in front of it, you can pick up x1 Smithing Stone (1). Check the south section where you'll see another Miner and at the tunnel path, there are three Rats and another body that you can pillage to find x1 Smithing Stone (1) - go back to the opposite tunnel path near the wooden steps and ride the elevator down.

You'll notice as you move down that there is another pathway. Check this later, for now, investigate this section. Go straight when you reach the lower level where you'll see a small shack that is being guarded by a Zombie Dog inside, another one of that hound under the shack, as well as more Miners. Kill the enemies and loot the corpse inside the shack to find x5 Large Glintstone Scrap, also, make sure to check the spot where the Miner enemy was mining to find another Smithing Stone (1) that you can pick up. Also, if you check the back of the shack, there's a tight path that you can pass through, at the end is another Smithing Stone (1). This area is now clear, go back to the lift, and make sure you are facing southeast as you go up - be ready to dodge roll or jump off the lift when you nearly pass the mid pathway of this elevator.

Move forward and you'll see more Miners here. There is one in front, another on the right, and three more at the path on the left side. Before going left, check the path on the right which is a dead-end, you'll find another body that can be pillaged to find x3 Glintstone Scrap. Next, go to the path on the left (make sure to check the sides of the wall to pick up Smithing Stones), and you'll find the third lift that goes down even further. The lower-most level contains a closed gate, and on the other side of it is the boss of this location.

As you were riding the third lift down, you should notice that there are some platforms here, one of it, having a corpse that holds an item, and a another smithing stone that you can pick up. To easily reach these platforms, ride the elevator back to the top, then start to drop down to the platforms below from the left (south) side of the lift. First, you'll find x1 Golden Rune (1) from the body and on the platform below the corpse, you can pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone (1) - go all the way to the lower-section where the gate is.

From the closed gate (leading to the boss arena), go right towards a dead-end to find x1 Smithing Stone (1). When you're ready to fight the boss, simply open the gate and the battle against the Stonedigger Troll will begin.

Slashing weapons and presumably pierce damage work fine. You can check out Stonedigger Troll page to find more guides and strategies on how to defeat this enemy - successfully defeating it rewards the player with x1 Roar Medallion and 1800 Runes.
To leave the boss arena, walk up to the portal mist and use it to return to the entrance.

title: Boss: Stonedigger Troll
text: Golden Rune [4]: Found in Groveside Cave.
Drop down all the way and activate the Limgrave Tunnels grace at the bottom.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] on the wall next to the first miner.
On the wall next to the miner down the first set of stairs is another Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] in an alcove on the ground level.
Follow the southwest tunnel to a room with a Smithing Stone [1] and some rats.
Large Glintstone Scrap: Accessed from Limgrave Tunnels . Underground. It can be found on a body, inside a little hut guarded by dogs.
In the area around the hut, you'll find 2x Smithing Stone [1].
Take the lift back up, then drop off while facing southeast to continue. On the wall between the two paths is a Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up Glintstone Scrap x3 from the right path.
Take the other path for a Smithing Stone [1] next to the miner near the lift.
Golden Rune [1]: Located within a grave area, in a sarcophagi on the hill south-west above Warmaster's Shack .

Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Players can find one at the Limgrave Tunnels. Before taking the second elevator, fall down the edge on the left, and keep falling on the surfaces against the wall. There is a Golden Rune (1) on a platform with a dead body, the next one has a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Grab a final Smithing Stone [1] from the right wall before the boss.
Stonedigger Troll: Optional Boss. Found at the end of Limgrave Tunnels. Drops Roar Medallion

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry
text: Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry roams the bridge near Agheel Lake North, only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Repeating Thrust
Ash of War: Repeating Thrust: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that roams the bridge near Agheel Lake North, only appears at night.

title: Greataxe
text: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Can be found at the base of the crucifix on a small hill.
Greataxe: Found inside the treasure chest within the carriage being pulled by two large Trolls and defended by militia and aristocracy.

title: Boss: Mad Pumpkin Head, Talk to Sorceress Sellen
text: Smoldering Butterfly: Find by looting a dead body at the base of the cliff.
Immunizing Cured Meat: Found in the small group of Poison Flowers in the outskirts of the Waypoint Ruins .
Trina's Lily: Can be found in nearby bushes on the edge cliff.
Mad Pumpkin Head: Field Boss. Found directly below the Waypoint Ruins .
Sorceress Sellen: Considered a witch and exiled member of the Raya Lucaria Academy, Sorceress Sellen sells Sorceries.

title: Boss: Mad Pumpkin Head
text: In a small alley in the back of the ruins is a corpse with Glowstone x2.
Loot the Immunizing Cured Meat and Golden Rune [1] around the Miranda Blossom in the center.
Hanging off the wall above the Miranda Blossom is a corpse with Trina's Lily x4.

Mad Pumpkin Head: Dual Boss Fight against two Mad Pumpkin Heads . They are found in an underground room, the entrance to which is in the eastern side of the ruins. No drops but allows access to a treasure room upon defeat.

title: Great Epee
text: Grab the Waypoint Ruins Cellar grace and talk to Sellen. Answer "I want to learn sorcery", then "I still want to learn" to receive the Nod In Thought gesture.
Kill the lone Noble Sorcerer on the hillside south of Waypoint Ruins, below the ruin, to obtain the Glintstone Staff (first time).
Golden Rune [1]: Found within the Sarcophagi located in the northwestern zone of Caelid .
Golden Rune [2]: Found within the Sarcophagi located in the Northwestern zone of Caelid .
Golden Rune [3]: Found within the Sarcophagi located in the northwestern zone of Caelid .

Great Epee: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, and get down, you will find a group of enemies. The Great Epee is inside a chest. on the right side.

title: Royal House Scroll
text: Golden Rune [1]: There's 1 Golden Rune (1) prior to the Bridge of Sacrifice , on the Limgrave side. There are other two at the bridge, one between the wooden barricades and the other as a drop from the enemies.

Royal House Scroll: Head southeast from the Agheel Lake South site of grace, head to the top of a cliff and you'll see a statue of an object that looks like the half piece of a bowl or a circle. Face the other way, to see a Knight. Keep going to a structure to see a man standing watching over the big structure, alongside a dead body. In that body, you will find the Royal House Scroll.

title: Larval Tear
text: Starlight Shards: Starlight Shards : Do a Spiritspring Jumping, and keep jumping until you reach the top.You will find the item over a cup-like monument, on the edge.
Golden Rune [1]: Loot the dead bodies.
Larval Tear: Key item used for Rebirth. Obtained by defeating a regular Noble enemy, that transforms into a Lesser Rune Bear. If you kill the Bear form a larval tear will drop.

title: Ash of War: Stamp
text: Talk to Yura under the ruin just west of the slope.

Ash of War: Stamp: Ash of War Upgrade. Found by defeating an invisible Teardrop Scarab roaming around the beach. You will see glowing footprints appearing in a set pattern around the area. Stand in front of its path and attack as it approaches you to reveal the creature.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave
text: Strip of White Flesh: Found on a dead body, sitting across a Soldier.
Land Octopus Ovary: Defeat Land Octopus to obtain.
Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave: General Goods vendor found southeast of the Coastal Cave entrance along the beach, sitting by a fire under a collapsed stone structure.

title: Boss: Demi-Human Chief, Sewing Needle
text: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Near the waterfall, beware of the lurking skeletons

Demi-Human Chief: Optional Boss. A duo of Demi-Human bosses found deep within the Coastal Cave . Required to defeat in order to access the Church of Dragon Communion location. Drops the Tailoring Tools and Sewing Needle key items upon defeat.
Tailoring Tools: Key Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat.
Sewing Needle: Key Quest Item. Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief boss upon defeat. Return it to Boc the Seamster in the Coastal Cave to further his storyline.
Grab the Coastal Cave grace, then talk to Boc next to it.
The only item in this cave is a Land Octopus Ovary just outside the boss room.
Kill the two Demi-Human Chiefs for Tailoring Tools, Sewing Needle and 1,200 runes. Old Knight Istvan's summon sign can be found just outside the room.
Old Knight Istvan's summon sign can be found just outside the room.
A corpse with Smoldering Butterfly lies in the tunnel past the boss.
Continue through the tunnel to emerge on a small island, then head uphill and grab the Church of Dragon Communion grace.
Examine the altar in the church and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Climb the slanted ruin next to the church to find Exalted Flesh at the top.
Northwest of the ruin, next to some trees at the edge, lies a corpse with Great Dragonfly Head x4.
Follow the cliff edge south-southeast to a scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Continue along the edge to find a Smithing Stone [2].
Return to Boc in Coastal Cave and give him the sewing needle.

place.title: Coastal Cave
walk: If you were following the walkthrough, you should have the Torch that you can buy from Merchant Kale. You will need the Torch here since this cave is dark inside. If you haven't purchased the item, fast travel back to the Church of Elleh site. Similar to the Groveside Cave, this is a small area to explore and also has an optional boss Map Coordinates for Coastal Cave.

You'll find a few things here when you reach the bonfire past the cave's entrance. First, is the Coastal Cave Site of Grace, a Martyr's Effigy, and Boc (only if you found him at his first location). You will find him writhing in pain on the ground right next to the Site of Grace, speak to him and he'll ask you to leave the place, but, this area serves as a side quest for Boc where you need to acquire an item and give it to him. Make sure to examine/rest at the site of grace before you continue forward.

As mentioned, the cave is dark, so you'll need the Torch as your main source of light. When you drop down into the pit, you'll encounter a couple of Demi-Human enemies. You are outnumbered here, so you can die if you are not careful. Kill all the Demi-Human enemies and loot their bodies to find items such as the Rickety Shield, Rainbow Stone, and x1 Land Octopus Ovary that is looted off a nearby body, next to the entrance of the boss lair. Now before going in, there is a Gold Summon Sign by the entrance that you can use to summon a companion NPC that can help you fight against the boss.

Upon entering, you'll be fighting against two Demi-Human Chief, along with its minions, the Demi-Humans. You can check our Demi-Human Chief page to find our guide on how to beat this enemy. Successfully defeating both Demi-Human Chief enemies rewards you with x1 Tailoring Tools, x1 Sewing Needle, and 900 Runes. Before leaving the lair, make sure to grab the Silver Fireflies, and near the portal mist, there's a path leading to another exit where you can loot x1 Smoldering Butterfly and x1 String from two corpses that are being guarded by two more Demi-Human enemies.

You can fast travel back to the entrance and give Boc the Sewing Needle by speaking to him. You've now cleared the Coastal Cave, before you continue to leave the Coastal Cave, we suggest that you check out the opposite exit from the boss lair and activate the Church of Dragon Communion Site of Grace so you can easily fast travel here later on.

Upon exiting the cave and go east where you'll find the Nomadic Merchant West Limgrave Map Coordinates Here. Next to the merchant, you can pick up x1 Smoldering Butterfly. Speak to the merchant to check his wares and if you have enough Runes, make sure to buy some of the useful items such as the Armorer's Cookbook [2] and notes.
notes: This cave was previously known as the Dissenter's Cave in the Elden Ring Network Test.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc the Seamster Location 2. After meeting him for the first time, Boc will move into the Coastal Cave . You will find him writhing on the ground next to the Site of Grace.

title: Golden Halberd
text: Golden Halberd: Drops from Tree Sentinel

title: Talk to White-Faced Varre
text: White-Faced Varre , Location 1. Found right next to The First Step Site of Grace . Provides Lore info. You will encounter this NPC multiple times in different locations.

title: Boss: Tree Sentinel
text: Field Boss roaming the area. Drops Golden Halberd

title: Prattling Pate, Wandering Noble Ashes +1
text: Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found by a sarcophagus in the room with the boss door. The second one is found in the next room, behind a pillar near the entrance to the narrow corridor. The third is found after climbing the ladder in the hallway where the second flamethrower pillar is. The fourth is found in a room west of where you got the third one. The final one is found to the left of the boss' door's lever.
Prattling Pate: Can be found in Stormfoot Catacombs on a corpse behind the first pillar that exudes fire.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found behind the second flamethrower pillar.

Wandering Noble Ashes: Located on a corpse that is resting against a stone coffin in the Stormfoot Catacombs in Limgrave. Proceed through the catacombs as normal until reaching a ladder that is going up, once you've reached the top continue forward past some Jade Goblins until reaching a dead end room that is being guarded by two Jade Goblins, the corpse resting against the stone coffin will hold the ashes
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Optional Boss found at the end of Stormfoot Catacombs . Drops Noble Sorcerer Ashes upon defeat.
Noble Sorcerer Ashes: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog inside the Stormfoot Catacombs .

place.title: Stormfoot Catacombs
walk: The Stormfoot Catacombs is a dungeon crypt, it is inhabited by Fanged Imps. It is due West and north from Church of Elleh, Map Coordinates Here. Upon arriving, open the doors leading to the catacombs and you'll find the Site of Grace for this location below. As always, make sure to discover or rest here to make it your last checkpoint. At the bottom of the steps, you'll find a Commoner ghost sitting in a chair that you can talk to. At the first intersection, you'll see a dead-end ahead and a path that goes further in the crypt on the right. The path ahead is where 2 Fanged Imps will ambush you, one is hiding by the corner on the left, while the other is by the corpse behind the chair in the center. - kill the Fanged Imps and loot the corpse to find x2 Root Resin.

Head down the steps and you'll see another path on the left side, a door that is in the middle of two statues, x1 Grave Glovewort [1] next to a stone coffin and on the left side of the statue is a summoning pool that you can activate. This door is locked at the moment and you will need to find the mechanism that will unlock this. Continue heading down the stairs at the north side of the crypt where you'll see more Fanged Imps that are above, you can kill them with magical ranged attacks from afar while they are unaware of your presence. In this room, you can find items such as x1 Grave Violet and another Grave Glovewort [1].

Continue forward through the narrow path, but as you reach the other end, walk carefully since you'll see a flamethrower mechanism ahead will begin to project a jet of fire. Wait by the corner and when it stops projecting the flames, quickly sprint straightforward and turn right before it projects the flames again. When it stops, go back and sprint forward. Behind this mechanism, there is a corpse that you can pillage to find x1 Prattling Pate Hello. Before you go back to the next path that has another flamethrower, you can hit the back of the mechanism to deactivate it.

Now for the next, do the same thing, sprint forward, take cover by the corner on the right, and when it stops, sprint towards it and hit the back of the mechanism to disable it. The area where this second flamethrower is, is being guarded by a couple of Fanged Imps that are on the wall, and two by each corner. Kill the enemies, loot the body to find x3 Smoldering Butterfly and grab the Ghost Glovewort [1] - next, go back to the corner where you took cover and climb the ladder.

At the top of the ladder, tread carefully since there is a Fanged Imp hiding by the corner on the left, while another which you can see ahead of you. By the corner where the Fanged Imp was, there's another Grave Glovewort [1] that you can get. Continue forward towards another dead-end room that is being guarded by two Fanged Imps, one ahead, and the other, hiding by the corner on the right, ready to ambush you. Kill both enemies and loot the body resting against a stone coffin on the left to find x1 Wandering Noble Ashes, as well as picking up another Grave Glovewort [1] at the center of this room. Retrace your steps and jump down onto the platform below you, where you'll find another Grave Glovewort [1] and the lever by the grim reaper statue at the center that will unlock the locked door - from here, you may want to rest at the site of grace first before passing through the gold mist door that leads to the boss of this location.

Beyond the mist lies the Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemy, you can visit our Erdtree Burial Watchdog page to find our guide on how to beat this enemy/boss. Succesfully defeating it rewards the player with x1 Noble Sorcerer Ashes and 1300 Runes. You've completed this area, and you can use the portal mist by the roots to fast travel back to the crypt's entrance.

title: Godrick Soldier Ashes
text: Head inside and activate the Stormfoot Catacombs grace.
Pick up Root Resin x2 from the room straight ahead.
Take the other path to a Grave Glovewort [1] in the boss door room.
Behind an unlit brazier in the next room is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Head past the first fire-breathing pillar and attack it to deactivate it, or just use Margit's Shackle if you have it. Pick up Prattling Pate "Hello" behind the pillar.
Go past the second pillar and loot the Smoldering Butterfly x3 and Ghost Glovewort [1] behind it, guarded by several Imps.
Climb the ladder in the corridor to a Grave Glovewort [1] immediately to the left.
In the room at the end, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [1] and Wandering Noble Ashes.
Drop to the ledge outside the room for a Grave Glovewort [1] and the boss lever.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Noble Sorcerer Ashes and 1,300 runes.
Travel to Stormhill Shack and head south-southwest to a cliff wall, then follow it to a slope near the edge. A Smithing Stone [1] is in the graveyard up the slope.
Magic Grease: Can be found in the graveyard on the small cliff.
Godrick Soldier Ashes: Found at the Cemetery at the west of Stormhill that is filled with Spirit Jellyfish, next to a grave. Check both sides of each grave to find it.

title: Boss: Crucible Knight
text: Starlight Shards B: Starlight Shards : Found at the very west of Stormhill at the edge of the Cliff on a stone monument.
On top of the nearby ruin is a corpse with the Crossed Legs gesture.
Crucible Knight: Found within Stormhill Evergaol, this is a solo fight without Spirit Ashes or player summons. Drops the Incantation Aspects of the Crucible: Tail
Aspects of the Crucible: Tail: Incantation. Dropped by the Crucible Knight boss in Stormhill Evergaol.

title: Arrow's Reach Talisman
text: Arrow's Reach Talisman: Found in a chest inside the Tower above Stormgate that can be accessed going all around it.

title: Invader: Recusant Henricus, Hammer Talisman
text: Golden Rune [2]: Found in a dead body at the ruins past the Stormgate.
Recusant Henricus: Hostile invader equipping a mace and wearing full body armor.
Hammer Talisman: Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against blockers.
miss: You must kill Henricus before joining the Volcano Manor.

title: Talk to Frustrated Spirit
text: Laying down on the floor, next to the remains of a burnt pillage.

title: Small Red Effigy, Duelist's Furled Finger
text: Small Red Effigy: Sends competitive sign to summoning pool.
Duelist's Furled Finger: Creates competitive multiplayer summon sign.

title: Ash of War: Golden Vow
text: Enter the colosseum to access it from the Marika statue in Roundtable Hold.
Go around the ledge of the farthest bridge pillar east of the colosseum to find Soporific Grease x3.
Ash of War: Golden Vow: Ash of War: Golden Vow provides Sacred affinity and the Golden Vow Skill. Dropped upon defeating Mounted Knight.

title: Lance
text: Somber Smithing Stone [1]: As a drop when defeating a Teardrop Scarab at the top of a ruined building.
Lance: On top of the big square structure to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs . Jump off the nearby cliff to reach the top.

title: Uchigatana, Boss: Black Knife Assassin +1
text: Uchigatana: Found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. It is in a body, hanging from the upper platform. You need to use the lever in order to reach that room. Beware of the Skeleton Archers.
Bloodrose: Can be found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs . On a body, against a wall, past a big hall with many Skeletons .
Black Knife Assassin: Field Boss. Can be found inside the Deathtouched Catacombs. Drops Assassin's Crimson Dagger .
Assassin's Crimson Dagger: Dropped by Black Knife Assassin , found inside Deathtouched Catacombs.
Deathroot: Inside Deathtouched Catacombs. Found on a chest behind the Black Knife Assassin.

place.title: Deathtouched Catacombs
walk: At the entrance of the catacombs, you will find a tormented spirit. Open the wooden door, and enter. There is a Site of Grace immediately after. Head down and turn to the left, prepare to fight some Skeletons. Some are melee combatants, while others are ranged ones. Remember that skeletons need to be “killed again” once they are down to be put to rest, if not, they will keep returning to life. You will find 2 Grave Glovewort (1) in the first big room.

Keep moving further down, there are more skeletons in the next room. Beware of the Ranged ones that are on the platform as you turn around., get to safety quickly. There is a Grave Glovewort (1) to the right side of the room.

There is a body against a wall that contains Bloodrose in the next room. Also in that room, you will find a statue with a lever, activate it. Retrace your steps, and as you reach the stairs when you fought the first skeletons. Drop down and enter a narrow corridor, now open. More skeletons await, as well as Grave Violet and Grave Glovewort (1). Kill them and take the left exit, you will reach the elevated platform from where the ranged skeletons were shooting you previously. Deal with them. At the end of the platform you will find another Grave Glovewort (1) and a Uchigatana on a hanging body.

Get back to the beginning of the Catacombs, to the room after the Site of Grace. You will notice that the big door is now open. Enter to fight the Black Knife Assassin. Once you have dealt with her, you will obtain an Assassin's Crimson Dagger and the dungeon will be completed. Before leaving, don't forget to loot the chest to obtain a Deathroot.

title: Lance Talisman
text: Head inside and activate the Deathtouched Catacombs grace.
Pick up the 2x Grave Glovewort [1] in the first room.
Go through the narrow passageway beside the staircase for a Grave Glovewort [1].
Take the other passageway to a ledge with Uchigatana and a Grave Glovewort [1].
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [1] in the room below.
Pull the boss lever in the final room, then turn around for a corpse with Bloodrose x3.
Kill the injured Black Knife Assassin for Assassin's Crimson Dagger and 1,600 runes.
Open the chest in the boss room to obtain a Deathroot.
Lance Talisman: Found at the north of Limgrave past the main road close to the edge.

title: Shamshir, Furlcalling Finger Remedy +1
text: Head south toward some gibbets near the edge for a Golden Rune [3] beneath one of them.
Turtle Neck Meat: Crafting Material. Looted from a corpse at an abandoned campsite in Altus Plateau .
Smithing Stone [1]: Smithing Stone (1) Upgrade Material can be found within Highroad Cave
Smithing Stone [2]: Smithing Stone (2) Upgrade Material can be found within Highroad Cave
Golden Rune [4]: Found by the ruins on a dead body.
Shamshir: Found inside the Highroad Cave, on a platform after the waterfall section, being feasted on by Giant Bats.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Furlcalling Finger Remedy can be dropped in Highroad Cave
Guardian Golem: Found within the Highroad Cave . Drops Blue Dancer Charm
Blue Dancer Charm: Dropped by the Guardian Golem within Highroad Cave

place.title: Highroad Cave
walk: It is recommended to enter this cave with a Torch. Drop down into the lower platform and continue dropping to each lower platform. You'lll move through a short tunnel that will lead to another small area with a hole. There is a Golden Rune (1) in a side cave here. Drop down to the next platforms to get to the lower levels.

Once you reach the bottom, take the lower route. The upper path will lead to a dead end. the lower will contain some wolves. Roll through the barrels to the left and continue to find a corpse with Arteria Leaves x3. If you loot them, there will be a wolf behind you. Drop down to find more wolves and Fire Grease.

You'll eventually reach an opening and a waterfall. Expect an encounter with Giant Bats. There is a Smithing Stone (1) behind you after you have dropped for the first time. there is a cave upstream from the waterfall too with more bats and Land Octopus. You will come across Smithing Stone (2) and Golden Rune (4).

Head back out towards and drop down along the waterfall, no jumping required. Hop onto the platform with the fallen pillar and take it across to the next platform. Take out the bats and on this platform you can loot a Shamshir. Continue to your left and you will face a Giant Land Octopus and there is a Furlcalling Finger Remedy on a ledge further down the tunnels. Hop off into the bigger waterfall and go through. You are now on the right side of the cave from the central platform with the Shamshir. Drop down behind the waterfall to proceed to the boss encounter. Defeating the Guardian Golem will drop the Blue Dancer Charm. Map Link.

title: Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing
text: Head inside and activate the Highroad Cave grace.
After dropping down once, go through the northeast tunnel for a Golden Rune [1] guarded by some wolves.
Drop down the hole in the middle, follow the downward path to some wolves, then take the left path up to a ledge with Arteria Leaf.
Below the ledge lies a corpse with Fire Grease x2.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found among the flooded gravestones surrounding Summonwater Village .
Golden Rune [4]: x2 Found by looting the sarcophagi.
Drop down the waterfall and cross the pillar in the water to pick up Shamshir next to some bats.
Continue across and through a tunnel until you reach the Furlcalling Finger Remedy hanging off a ledge.
Go through the tunnel under a waterfall and kill the Guardian Golem for Blue Dancer Charm and 1,700 runes.
Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing: Bell Bearing. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades the War Master's Shack at night.

title: Boss: Bell Bearing Hunter
text: Field Boss. Invades the Warmaster's Shack , but only at night time, replacing Knight Bernahl . You have to travel here from another site of grace to trigger it. Drops Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing upon defeat.

title: Boss: Deathbird
text: Deathbird: Appears only at night. East of Warmaster's Shack just over the cliff. It drops the Blue-Feathered Branchsword
Blue-Feathered Branchsword: Talisman. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Stormhill)

title: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
text: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Obtained when defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village .

title: Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead Summonwater Village
text: D may be encountered at the southern entrance of Summonwater Village

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner
text: Optional Boss. Found riding its boat in the flooded areas of Summonwater Village . Defeat it to progress D's questline.

title: Invader: Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater A, Sacred Scorpion Charm
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] in front of some gravestones in the water.
Mushroom: Can be found at Summonwater Village on a dead body
Head toward the part of the ruins up on the hill to find a Golden Rune [4] in a small tower.
Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater A: Hostile invader with cloth armor and a curved greatsword equipped. Invades when you first approach the Smoldering Church .
Sacred Scorpion Charm: Talisman. Dropped by invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when defeated.

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14], Missionary's Cookbook [3]
text: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14]: Cookbook item. Found on one of the two corpses in the Smoldering Church .
Missionary's Cookbook [3]: Cookbook item. Found on one of the two corpses in the Smoldering Church .
Next to some dogs and a wagon southeast of the grace is a corpse with Drawstring Lightning Grease x2.
Beyond the smoldering fence at the end of the road lies the Rotview Balcony grace.
Pick up the Nascent Butterfly x2 in front of the grace.
Loot the Golden Rune [3] and Preserving Boluses x5 from the shacks near the grace.
Climb the ledge south-southwest of the grace to discover a cemetery with a Golden Rune [1], Golden Rune [2], and a Golden Rune [3].
Travel to Bestial Sanctum and feed Gurranq the two Deathroots you got earlier to receive Bestial Sling, Clawmark Seal, and Beast Eye.
Offer the Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing and any future bell bearings to the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold to unlock new items.

place.title: Smoldering Church
walk: To claim the two cookbooks available in this area, loot the remains that are resting on the side of the church. You should find Missionary's Cookbook (3) and Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (14),

Before entering the church, prepare for battle as the NPC invader Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater shows up for battle. She deals quick attacks with her greataxe and can dodge, so time your attacks well. You will gain Sacred Scorpion Charm and Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
After the fight, you can rest at the Site of Grace found in the far end of the Smoldering Church and loot the two corpses next to it for some cookbooks.

title: Hand Ballista
text: From the South of the Lookout Tower grace, head northeast up the slope, then turn left to find 2x Golden Rune [1] x3 on the stretch leading to the tower.
Hand Ballista: At the top of the Forest Lookout Tower, west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.
Ballista Bolt: Ammo Item. Found by a cart alongside the road leading to the Evergaol

title: Boss: Runebear
text: Return to South of the Lookout Tower and head north down the cliff. After dropping down, pick up a Rainbow Stone from the campsite.
Runebear: Optional Miniboss. Found in the lower level of Earthbore Cave after leaping down into a hole near the end. Drops the Spelldrake Talisman upon defeat.
Spelldrake Talisman: Talisman. Acquired by defeating the Runebear boss inside Earthbore Cave .
Trina's Lily: Can be found near to a Stone pilar.

title: Faith-knot Crystal Tear
text: Head inside and activate the Earthbore Cave grace.
Pickled Turtle Neck: Found in the chest just inside Earthbore Cave
Golden Rune [1]: Can be found inside the abandoned Ailing Village.
Glowstone: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on a dead body.
Drop down and kill the Runebear for Spelldrake Talisman and 2,600 runes.
Trina's Lily: Can be found x3 Trina's Lily next to a small cliffside.
Faith-knot Crystal Tear: North of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins . Directly east of the Church of Pilgrimage , just down the cliff. It's in a bowl under a tree and surrounded by Poison Flowers .

title: Boss: Demi-human queen
text: Demi-Human Queen guarding the site. Drops Crystal Burst and Demi-Human Queen's Staff .

title: Demi-Human Queen's Staff, Shield of the Guilty
text: Demi-Human Queen's Staff: Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen elite enemy in Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
Crystal Burst: Drops from the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Demi-human Forest Ruins nearby a broekn stone wall.

Shield of the Guilty: In the cellar area of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins , before the main building with the Demi-Human Queen mini-boss. You will need to jump over a wall to access the stairs leading into the cellar.

title: Boss: Scaly Misbegotten
text: Kill the Demi-Human Queen near the entrance for Demi-Human Queen's Staff and Crystal Burst.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Demi-human Forest Ruins near to Demi-human
Head down the cellar in the southernmost part of the ruins for a chest containing Shield of the Guilty
String: Can be found at Earthbore Cave on some dead bodies
Golden Rune [2]: Found by the side of the road on a dead body.
Smithing Stone [1]: You can find a couple of these stones within Morne Tunnel .
Golden Rune [4]: One can be looted off a corpse inside the small shack in Morne Tunnel .
Exalted Flesh: Consumable Item. Looted from a chest inside a shack within Morne Tunnel.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: You can find a few in Morne Tunnel .
Large Glintstone Scrap: Two can be looted off a corpse behind the small shack in Morne Tunnel .
Stanching Boluses: One can be looted off a corpse in Morne Tunnel .
Soft Cotton: One can be looted off a corpse in Morne Tunnel .
Arteria Leaf: Two can be looted off a corpse that is being eaten by two Misbegotten enemies in Morne Tunnel .
Scaly Misbegotten: Optional Boss, found within Mourne Tunnel . Drops Rusted Anchor
Rusted Anchor: Greataxe dropped by Scaly Misbegotten located in Morne Tunnel .

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9], Prattling Pate +1
text: Drop down to the left of the lift for a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall.
Activate the Morne Tunnel grace at the bottom.
Climb the ladder at the end of the first room for a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall.
Head into the next room without falling, and pick up the Golden Rune [2] down the first set of stairs.
In the alcove just northeast of the rune is an outcrop with Smithing Stone [1].
Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] near the bottom of the stairs.
Follow the south tunnel to a hut with a Golden Rune [4] and a chest with Exalted Flesh.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] behind the hut, then the Large Glintstone Scrap x2 in the nearby alcove.
In the area below the stairs in the previous room, you'll find a Smithing Stone [1] on the wall and Stanching Boluses on a corpse.
Follow the west tunnel to a large room. At the west end of it, you'll find a smaller room with Soft Cotton.
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Morne Tunnel , You'll notice there are is a corpse being eaten by two Misbegotten enemies. Loot that body to find x2 Arteria Leaf.
On the wall to the right before the boss is a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
Kill the Scaly Misbegotten for Rusted Anchor and 2,000 runes.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9]: Cookbook item. Found inside the Tombsward Catacombs , locked behind an imp statue barrier. Requires a Stonesword Key to break the seal.

Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the room to the right of the boss door. A second one is found near a sarcophagus on the bottom level of the first room with a second floor.

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the room to the right of the boss door, behind the central column. A second one is found in the room to the left of the flamethrower pillar. A third one is found in a room on the upper level after riding the flamethrower pillar and before the room with the boss door's lever.
Ghost Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One found in the bottom level of the first room with a second floor, near the back.
Prattling Pate: Reusable Item. Obtained inside the Tombsward Catacombs . Found on a corpse at the end of the main path, past the flamethrowing pillar.
Cemetery Shade: Found inside Tombsward Catacombs . Drops Lhutel the Headless
Lhutel the Headless: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade inside the Tombsward Catacombs

place.title: Morne Tunnel
walk: Morne Tunnel is a small optional dungeon where you can find materials, a weapon, and an optional boss at the end. Here are the Map Coordinates. Make sure you have a Torch here in case you need to light up dark sections within the tunnel. Note: you will automatically dismount from your Spirit Steed Mount as you enter.

Ride the lift down to Underground Level 1 and you'll find the site of grace for Morne Tunnel. Ride the elevator back to the top, move to the left side and jump down the platform. You should be able to grab x1 Smithing Stone [1] from the wall. Jump back down and continue moving south where you'll encounter a Misbegotten enemy.
Killing these enemies may drop the Iron Cleaver weapon or Old Fang material. Killing Miner enemies may drop the Explosive Stone Clump item.

Continue forward, walk on the narrow beam but be ready to kill two more Misbegotten enemies on the other side. Don't go towards the tunnel path on the right, instead, continue walking forward on the wooden platform and climb the ladder at the end. Kill the Miner at the top and make sure to check the wall it was mining to obtain x1 Smithing Stone [1] - go back down and continue towards the tunnel path.

On the other side, go down the stairs and kill more Misbegotten enemies. Loot the corpse sitting in between some crates and barrels to find x1 Golden Rune [2]. Look to your left and you'll see another Miner, backstab the enemy, kill it and make sure to pick up x1 Smithing Stone [1]. Turn around, check under the wooden platform where you'll encounter some resting Miners and another corpse you can pillage to find x1 Stanching Boluses. Go southeast and you'll see another Miner kill it and grab another x1 Smithing Stone [1].

Continue forward and you should see a small shack ahead. Outside the shack, there are two Miner enemies, specifically the one on the left side of the shack, is carrying x1 Cracked Crystal. You can grab this item from its body after killing it. Check behind the shack to find x1 Somber Smithing Stone [1] that you can grab from the wall, also there is another body you can pillage to find x2 Large Glintstone Scrap. Inside the shack, there is a corpse that you can loot to acquire x1 Golden Rune [4] and a treasure chest containing x1 Exalted Flesh. There is also another Miner inside - go back to the west side where you previously looted x1 Stanching Boluses off a body and continue through the tunnel path.

Prepare as you reach the other end since you'll encounter more Misbegotten enemies. There's a lot of them, we suggest you take them out one by one. You'll notice there are is a corpse being eaten by two Misbegotten enemies. Loot that body to find x2 Arteria Leaf. There are also Miners that are excavating, kill them and check the walls to find x4 Smithing Stone [1] and x1 Somber Smithing Stone [1]. Go through the tunnel path on the west side after clearing this section where you can loot x1 Soft Cotton off a corpse. Go back and proceed north where you'll see a closedwooden gate, don't open it first, check the right side and you'll find another x1 Somber Smithing Stone [1] - if you're prepared, open the large wooden gate to fight the mini-boss of this location, the Scaly Misbegotten.
MINI-BOSS: Scaly Misbegotten

The Scaly Misbegotten appears as a larger variant of the common Misbegotten enemy. It moves slow and wields a large axe. When it attacks, you can easily react to block or dodge its attacks when it start to swing the heavy weapon. If you are wielding heavy weapons, you can interrupt its attacks if you can land a jumping attack, hitting its head. If you land a critical hit, it temporarily gets stunned, you can attack it multiple times before it recovers. Successfully defeating it rewards you with 2000 Runes and drops the Rusted Anchor weapon - to return back to the entrance, simply use the white portal mist that will appear in the boss arena after the battle.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar
text: Head inside and grab the Tombsward Catacombs grace.
Unlock the imp seal for a corpse with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9].
Pick up Grave Glovewort [1] and Grave Glovewort [2] from the first room.
Go down the stairs for a Grave Glovewort [1] to the right and a Ghost Glovewort [1] in the back.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [1] in the corridor.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar, then pick up the Human Bone Shard x5 on the ground.
In the room east of the pillar, you'll find a Grave Glovewort [2] and Prattling Pate "Thank you".
Activate the pillar while standing on top of it to reach the Golden Rune [2] on the ledge.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] in front of a coffin, then pull the lever ahead.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Lhutel the Headless and 2,200 runes.
Erdtree Avatar: Miniboss found guarding the Erdtree. Drops the Opaline Bubbletear and Crimsonburst Crystal Tear upon defeat.
Crimsonburst Crystal Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar boss upon defeat.
Opaline Bubbletear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar boss upon defeat.

title: Eclipse Crest Heater Shield
text: Golden Rune [6]: Consumable item. Dropped by an elite singing Bat enemy found along the cliffs south of the Minor Erdtree. You can hear the bat singing as you approach the cliffs. He is guarded by other Giant Bats.
Sliver of Meat: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse where a singing Bat is sitting.
Eclipse Crest Heater Shield: Ledge of the pillar near Tombsward Site of Grace. Can be reached from the ledge near Minor Erdtree

title: Winged Scythe
text: Beast Liver: Can be found on a dead body in the ruins.

Winged Scythe: Located In the center of Tombsward Ruins , there is a set of stairs leading underground into a dark hall with a door to a small room at the end. The scythe is inside a chest in the small room.

Open the chest in the cellar to obtain Winged Scythe.
Divine Fortification: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found atop a collapsed stone structure overgrown with yellow moss.

title: Boss: Ancient Hero of Zamor
text: Ancient Hero of Zamor: Optional Boss imprisoned within the Weeping Evergaol .
Radagon's Scarseal: Dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor
