text: Furlcalling Finger Remedy H: Can be looted off from a corpse once you head straight inside the Tombsward Cave.
Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8]: Can be found on a corpse within the Tombsward Cave.
Poisonbone Dart: An offensive consumable that can be found on a corpse inside Tombsward Cave.
Miranda the Blighted Bloom: Miranda the Blighted Bloom is a large, poisonous flower within the Tombsward Cave.
Viridian Amber Medallion: Viridian Amber Medallion Raises maximum stamina. It is dropped by Miranda the Blighted Bloom, found inside the Tombsward Cave.

place.title: Tombsward Cave
walk: Once you reach the area, you'll know you've reached Tombsward Cave when you see a lit brazier just by the entrance of the cave. This is an optional dungeon area that is not as large as the regular Legacy Dungeons. Equip a torch before you enter the cave as it is almost pitch black upon entering.
Since a lot of enemies in this location inflict an additional Poison effect, an option would be to bring Neutralizing Boluses with you which could alleviate poison build up and cure you of poison.

As you move deeper into the cave, you'll see a Site of Grace. Beyond that, you'll find more cave moss by just following the path of the cave. You will then reach a cavern that's filled with poisonous liquid which will slowly build up your poison meter and once it's filled, you will receive damaging status effect continously. This can be a difficult area to traverse since there's also a couple of Servant of Rots patrolling the area, this type of enemy will often drop Toxic Mushroom. Also be wary of their poisonous projectile that shoots out of their staff as it is homing.

If you just follow a straight path, you'll see a corpse with the item Furlcalling Finger Remedy beside another entrance. Go through the entrance, there should be some Poison Flowers in the area and a corpse holding a Poisonbone Dart.

Exit the room by going through where you first entered, then turn left and proceed in following the path, jump down. There are multiple Poisonblooms in the area as you proceed, turn left on the next cavern you see, turn left again and you'll see two Poisonblooms just before you make your way up the slope. Continue following the path, you will come across a Cave Moss just before you enter another area.

Once you enter this area, you'll encounter three Poison Flowers and a Giant Rat. There's also a corpse holding an Arteria Leaf in the area. Now exit the area from where you came in, continue following the path and then turn left, you'll encounter a Rat and a Giant Rat guarding two corpses. The one in the middle holds the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8], the other one holds an Immunizing Cured Meat.

Now go back and head right on the first corner and go up the slope again, you'll end up back in the room where you got the Arteria Leaf, jump down, go straight and down the slope til you reach a yellow mist blocking your way. Make sure to stock up on health as this will be the boss fight of the area.

Once you pass through the mist, you will encounter a boss fight, you will be fighting against Miranda the Blighted Bloom. There are also three smaller Poison Flowers surrounding Miranda. The best tactic is to take out the smaller enemies first before fully engaging with the boss. This boss only has two moves, the first one is a familiar move where it shoots out an AoE poison spray which will most likely cover the entire area in this. This is easily telegraphed as you will see Miranda closing her petals before releasing the toxic cloud. There's no counter for this attack and you will suffer the effects nonetheless, just see this as an opportunity to land your attacks. The other attack is where Miranda will start summoning white beams of light and shoot down the ground, this will most likely occur at the start when you enter the area. This is telegraphed as you'll see Miranda rear upwards but with her petals open, then beams o light will rise from the ground around your character's radius, then the beams will start to shoot down and deal massive damage. This can be easily dodge rolled. Miranda will unlikely repeat the second move and will continue to resort to the AoE poison spray.

After defeating Miranda, she will drop the Viridian Amber Medallion, you can then exit the cave go back to the Site of Grace at the entrance of the cave to remove the remaining poison debuff effects and fully heal your character.

title: Ambush Shard
text: Go inside and grab the Tombsward Cave grace.
Pick up the Golden Rune [2] right before the poison swamp.
On the opposite end of the swamp is a Furlcalling Finger Remedy.
Follow the northeast tunnel past some rats to pick up Immunizing White Cured Meat and Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [8].

Drop down to find a corpse in the poison with Poisonbone Dart x6.
Kill Miranda the Blighted Bloom for Viridian Amber Medallion and 2,100 runes.

Exit the cave and take down the Wandering Mausoleum by hacking away at the skull formations on its feet until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map so that you can easily come back when you want to duplicate a remembrance.
Great Dragonfly Head: A Great Dragonfly Head can be found on the ground by one of the effigies.
Ambush Shard: Weeping Peninsula : Found on a corpse in the underground jail of the Witchbane Ruins .

Just look behind you after interacting with the book. [Location 1] #2: In a bush to the left of the stairs. In front of you as you interact with the book. [Location 2] #3: In a pond to the right of the tower. It's invisible so aim where the water splashes. [Location 3]
#1: On the road leading to the tower. Just look behind you after interacting with the book. [Location 1]
#2: In a bush to the left of the stairs. In front of you as you interact with the book. [Location 2]
#3: In a pond to the right of the tower. It's invisible so aim where the water splashes. [Location 3]

title: Prattling Pate, Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
text: Grave Glovewort [1]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found on top of a sarcophagus in the room to the left of the boss door. A second one can be found in the second section of the sewers with Zombies, after dropping down underneath the Impaler Lift and one more can be found in the third section before climbing up the ladder.

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found in a dead end room with two statues and a sarcophagus. A second one can be found in the first section of the sewers with Zombies after dropping down underneath the impaler lift. A final one can be found in the corridor after pulling the boss door's lever.
Ghost Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found under the impaler lift, right by the entrance to the next corridor.
Prattling Pate: Found within Impaler's Catacombs , held by a corpse in the water underneath the spikes trap.
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Found within Impaler's Catacombs. Drops Demi-Human Ashes upon defeat.
Demi-Human Ashes: Found within Impaler's Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog

place.title: Impaler's Catacombs
walk: The Impaler's Catacombs is filled with Imps that crawl on the walls and jump at the player. When walking into new rooms you can slowly move your camera to check the walls around the entrance to look for enemies crawling on the wall to avoid being jumped in the back. The entrance can be easily found by following the cliffside on the eastern edge of Weeping Peninsula with a Site of Grace found inside at the top of the catacombs.

Heading into the Catacombs the first room players walk into is a square room with a large hole and stairs against the wall leading down. There are 2 Imps in this room, one on the wall of the entrance and one on the wall on the other end of the stairs. Avoid being pushed off into the hole while fighting them and continue to the next room where an ornate door flanked by 2 large stone statues can be found. The door is locked by some contraption but a path exists to the left for you to take.

The catacombs are a series of tunnels and rooms connecting them, often with an imp on each wall where the tunnels connect to the rooms. The first room you enter will have 3 imps, one on the ground, one on the wall in front and one on the wall of the entrance you enter from. Watch out for the third one as it will jump at you from the wall if left unchecked. Past this room the path branches into 2, one to the right and down stairs, and one forward with a left turn. Go forward first to find a room with a single Imp and a Grave Glovewort [2].

Turning around and taking the path down the stairs leads to a large empty room, looking up players will notice a lot of spikes. Stepping on the floor will trigger the mechanism and raise the floor up pushing the player into the spikes dealing damage. In the room there is a pocket in the top left where a Grave Violet can be found. You can run across the raising floor and get to the pocket in time. If you stand on the floor for too long it will raise you all the way up into the spikes, then repeatedly push you into the spikes until dead or you make it back to the pocket.

It is not possible to get out directly by running to the exit as the floor will raise above the entrance keeping you in the room. To get out players have to engage the floor mechanism then stay in the pocket and let it reach the roof. Start moving to the entrance while the floor is descending back to the original position so that there is enough time to get out.

To complete this catacombs players will have to go to the room with the spike ceiling. At the entrance to the room step on the raising floor to have it raise up then quickly step back off and have it raise past you, fall down underneath the floor to go deeper. In this lower part of the Catacombs an infinite number corpses can be found raising up from the watery path. Following the pathway will lead to more rooms full of Putrid Corpses as well as a Prattling Pate "Please help". There are a set number of Putrid Corpses in each room, but a new replacement will stand up a few seconds after one is killed. At the end of the underground watery area there is a ladder leading upwards, at the top of the ladder is the lever that opens the doors at the start of the catacombs.

Watch out when turning the corner after leaving the lever, an imp is hiding around the corner ready to jump at players rounding the corner. Simply climb out of the window at the end to get back to the starting room.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

This fight involves the boss as well as multiple Imps. The melee attacks of the Imps apply bleed and being surrounded by them while fighting the boss in this small room can quickly lead to the bleed threshold being reached and dealing large damage to the player. Clear out the imps before turning and focusing on the boss. This boss has around 1400 health but is slow and kiteable making for an easy fight once the imps are out of the way.

The boss has 2 modes of attack, one where they are standing and one where they are sitting, with only 1 attack in each mode that are both easily dodged. While sitting the boss will jump or float up then move towards the player before dropping down with their attack in a small AOE, simply move away from the landing spot and continue to hurt the boss. When it is not sitting the boss will stand tall on their hind legs and walk towards the player, when they are near they will slam their sword down.
Defeating the boss will grant you Demi-Human Ashes as well as 2400 Runes.

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry
text: Head inside to grab the Impaler's Catacombs grace.
On a coffin in the first room is a Grave Glovewort [1].
Follow the path straight ahead to a Grave Glovewort [2].
Momentarily step inside the room down the other path. When the floor rises to impale you, drop down beneath it for a Ghost Glovewort [2].
Loot the Grave Glovewort [2], Prattling Pate "Please help", Root Resin x3, and 2x Grave Glovewort [1] from the sewage area with respawning enemies.
Climb the ladder in the back, pull the lever, and pick up the Grave Glovewort [2] in the corner guarded by an Imp.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Demi-Human Ashes and 2,400 runes.
Night's Cavalry: Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling the roads around the Castle Morne Ramparts. Only appears at night. Drops Ash of War: Barricade Shield
Ash of War: Barricade Shield: Dropped by Night's Cavalry Miniboss found patrolling the roads around the Castle Morne Ramparts. Only appears at night.
Nightrider Flail: Dropped by Night's Cavalry that spawns at night near Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant Castle Morne Rampart
text: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire near the Castle Morne Rampart site of grace. Sells Stonesword Key

title: Boss: Deathbird
text: Deathbird: Spawns only at night, drops the Sacrificial Axe
Sacrificial Axe: Axe. Dropped from miniboss that only spawns at night: Deathbird (Weeping Peninsula)
Continue southwest toward a beach to find a Golden Rune [1] in front of a gibbet.
Enter Castle Morne and activate the Castle Morne Lift grace.

title: Claymore
text: Smithing Stone [2] A: Upgrade Material. From the main courtyard entrance of Castle Morne, head up the steps on the left side to find the item on a corpse. Beware the skeletal dogs in the area.
Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the left side at the back of Castle Morne 's courtyard.
Fire Grease: Consumable. 2 can be found on a corpse near the the burning pile of corpses in the courtyard.

Claymore: Greatsword. From the main courtyard entrance, hug the right wall past the burning corpses and harpies to reach the entrance to the building in the north. The sword is found in a chest to the left as you enter.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy, Steel-Wire Torch
text: Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Multiplayer Item. Found on a corpse to the right of the gallows on the top level on the castle. This area is accessed by hugging the right wall from the main courtyard area, past the burning corpses and harpies and then following the linear path to reach the roof.
Steel-Wire Torch: Torch. Found on a corpse at the end of a narrow path at the top level of the castle. Guarded by two harpies.

title: Talk to Edgar, Sacrificial Twig 1x
text: Golden Rune [2]: Looted off a corpse by the ledge of the wooden fence.
Smithing Stone [2] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse being chopped up by a Misbegotten.
Golden Rune [2]: Consumable. Found on a corpse partially hanging on a ledge at the top level of the castle. Beware the harpies nearby.
Edgar: Edgar can be found sitting on a bench up on the ramparts of Castle Morne .
Sacrificial Twig 1x: Give the letter to Edgar and he'll give you x1 Sacrificial Twig.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head back down and step on the brick rubble at the end of the rampart, then jump over the fence to grab the Behind the Castle grace.

Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse partially hanging from a wooden platform. The platform can be found by walking down west from the nearby Site of Grace and back onto a section of the castle. Look to the left edge.

title: Twinblade Talisman
text: Pickled Turtle Neck: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse in a small room with a caged ghost. Beware of the Skeletal Slime that drops from the ceiling when you collect this.
Twinblade Talisman: Talisman. Found in the tower section of the walls of Castle Morne. Climb up the ladder and go around the tower to find a chest containing the talisman.

title: Whip
text: Tarnished Golden Sunflower 10x: Can be found x10 Tarnished Golden Sunflower araund the Erdtree.
Continue down until you reach a castle platform, then drop onto a wooden beam down the hole to pick up Smithing Stone [2].

Whip: Whip. Found on a corpse inside the building known as the Rampart Gaol. This building is first accessed by walking atop the western wall of the castle. Look to the left for a building with a blue roof. Jump onto this roof and then jump down to the cliffs below. Follow the cliffs southeast until you return to a section of the castle with a big square opening. Descend into the opening by landing on the wooden beams. There is a corpse with a Smithing Stone [2] on one of the beams and there are several Rats and a Harpy at the ground level. The corpse with the whip is sitting against a wall.

title: Boss: Leonine Misbegotten
text: Turn left outside the room to discover the Beside the Rampart Gaol grace.
Throwing Dagger: Held by a corpse across the wooden bridge that's in front of Raumpart Gaol at Castle Morne.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Found at the edge of the sea.
In the narrow passage north-northeast of the ladder is a corpse with Fire Arrow x15.

Leonine Misbegotten: Optional Greater Enemy Boss. Can be found by heading southeast from the "Beside the Rampart Gaol" Site of Grace, through the wooden bridge and down a ladder onto the shores below. Drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword upon defeat.
Grafted Blade Greatsword: Greatsword. Dropped by Leonine Misbegotten upon defeat.
Edgar's summon sign can be found outside the entrance if you gave him Irina's Letter.
There are no items in the arena, so go ahead and activate the Morne Moangrave grace.
Return to Edgar and exhaust his dialogue.
Travel to the Bridge of Sacrifice and talk to Edgar beside Irina's corpse.
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Weeping Peninsula.

title: Boss: Margit, the Fell Omen
text: From Stormhill Shack, follow the uphill road to the castle entrance. Head inside and grab the Castleward Tunnel grace in an alcove.
Margit, the Fell Omen: A large, apparently elder creature, self-proclaimed as "The last of all kings". Drops Talisman Pouch and 12000 Runes upon defeat.
Talisman Pouch: Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those atempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader. Dropped by Margit, the Fell Omen upon defeat.
miss: Margit disappears if Morgott is killed first, and Morgott will drop the Talisman Pouch instead.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Rogier's summon sign can be found outside the entrance.
Activate the Margit, the Fell Omen grace, then grab the Stormveil Main Gate grace in front of the gate.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: Can be found at Stormveil Castle on the main gate.

title: Talk to Gatekeeper Gostoc
text: Fire Grease: Can be found beneath the bridge. You have to drop down onto a ledge on the east side of the bridge to access it.
Gatekeeper Gostoc: Gatekeeper Gostoc can be found by the entrance of Stormveil Castle , in the room next to the main gate into the castle

title: Marred Leather Shield
text: Golden Rune [1] B: Looted from one of the three bodies at the entrance of Stormveil Castle.
Smithing Stone [2] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the outside of the castle walls. Reachable by climbing on broken sections nearby.
After dropping down, head south-southeast and down the slope to find Bolt x10 at the end.
Smithing Stone [3] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse around the southwestern cliffs. Watch out for the Bladed Talon Eagles roosting in the area.
Continue north and drop down to discover the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
Marred Leather Shield: Shield. Found on a corpse on a wooden platform, outside the castle walls.

title: Hookclaws
text: Golden Rune [2] B: Found on a dead body on a wooden platform in the back entrance.
Hookclaws: Claw weapon. Found on a corpse in the corner of a small corridor on the first level of the wine cellar, filled with crates and patrolled by a single Castle Guard.

title: Rusty Key, Curved Sword Talisman
text: Note: Gostoc will now steal 30% of your runes each time you die inside the castle.
Go up the stairs and pick up the Throwing Dagger x5 in a narrow passage next to a locked door.
Pick up St. Trina's Arrow x10 from a hole in the wall covered with vines.
Golden Rune [2] C: Found on a wooden platform that can be reached by falling from above.
Smoldering Butterfly: Can be found Stormveil Castle in the Underground Crypt area on a dead body inside the Root Monster room.
Rusty Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the room with the Banished Knight.
Curved Sword Talisman: Talisman. Found in Stormveil Castle, a chest inside a dark room in the Wine Cellar with the Banished Knight .

title: Brick Hammer
text: Grace Mimic: Consumable. Given as a reward by a non-hostile Commoner NPC sitting on the roof of a building. Use the ladder nearby to reach him.
Kill the greataxe-wielding soldier next to him, then return to the top of the ladder. Head northwest first for a Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot.
Mushroom: Can be found at Stormveil Castle , on a dead body down stars.
Ascend the outside stairs, then the first set of stairs inside. Grab the Rampart Tower grace in the north room, but do not rest at it.
Drawstring Fire Grease: Two of them can be looted from a corpse located at Stormveil Castle.

Note: If he's not there, check to see if he's stuck at his earlier location. Clear his path of enemies, run to the stairs past the Stormhawks without resting, then teleport to the Rampart Tower and he should appear. [Location 4]
Arteria Leaf: Can be found at Stormveil Castle . There is an Arteria Leaf inside the tower, guarded by a Giant Bat
Drop onto the wooden platform inside, then go across the plank for a corpse with Fire Grease.
Brick Hammer: Can be found on the 3rd floor. It is in a corpse dangling from a window.You have to access from the 4th floor, using the wooden platforms outside.
miss: This Grace Mimic is missable if not received before you kill Godrick.

title: Marred Wooden Shield
text: Marred Wooden Shield: Medium Shield. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, exit onto the walkway with explosive barrels and War Hawks . Kill the War Hawk sitting on the western tower and then jump down the edge onto a ledge below. Follow the ledge north and jump down to the broken pillar below to find the shield.

title: Ash of War: Storm Assault
text: Ash of War: Storm Assault: Starting from the Rampart Tower grace, exit onto the ramparts where the war hawks and explosive barrels are. At the tower on the west side where the second war hawk holding an explosive barrel is, jump up onto the battlements on the north side. There is a corpse visible with an item (Marred Wooden Shield). Jumping down to the walls beneath will allow the player to get to the shield. Jumping down further will land the player on a ledge that will collapse, causing them to fall far below into some bushes. A Silver Teardrop Scarab holds the Ash of War

title: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns
text: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns: Incantation. Dropped by Crucible Knight found at the bottom floor of the Rampart Tower

title: Stonesword Key
text: Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [2] in the alcove near the Crucible Knight.
Take the shortcut lift back to the Rampart Tower and go up the stairs. Jump across the lift's wheels to pick up Throwing Dagger x5.
Golden Rune [2] D: x2 Found at the top of the castle on a dead body over a platform.
Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . Found on a corpse inside a building section with a broken roof. Accessed from the very top of the Rampart Tower with careful platforming.

title: Boss: Grafted Scion
text: Optional Miniboss. Patrols the main hall of his fortress. No special drops.

title: Claw Talisman
text: Pick up the Dozing Cross-Legged gesture from the corpse on the rooftop below.
Smithing Stone [2] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the rooftops accessible from the top of the very top of the Rampart Tower.
Claw Talisman: Talisman. Found on a corpse atop a tower accessible by ladder. The tower has several none-hostile Eagles at the top.

title: Talk to Sorcerer Rogier
text: Smithing Stone [2] D: Upgrade Material. Held by a corpse outside the room where Nepheli Loux is located, passing the wooden barricades to the west and up the stairs on your right.
Golden Rune [2] G: Found on a dead body sitting on the ground in the wine cellar where you meet Nepheli Loux .
From the corpse, turn southeast and jump to the lower part of the roof for Kukri x5.

Sorcerer Rogier: Sorcerer Rogier Location 1. Friendly NPC who sells Ashes of War . Initially met in the Chapel in the western section of the Castle. After you defeat Godrick, he moves to the Roundtable Hold .

title: Mimic's Veil
text: Golden Rune [2] H: Found on a dead body laying on the roof in the northern section of the castle.
Mimic's Veil: Reusable Key Item. Found in a chest inside the assembly room with the large war table. There is a Banished Knight in this room.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: Can be found at a stone balcony, above one of the rooms.
Stonesword Key: Held by a corpse above the Grafted Scion .

title: Highland Axe
text: Exalted Flesh: Can be found on a corpse in the back of the first floor.
Highland Axe: Axe. Found in the same hall as the Grafted Scion miniboss, under a large painting.

title: Crimson Hood, Chrysalids' Memento
text: At the west-southwest end of the room is a shortcut lift back to the Rampart Tower if you need to rest.

Crimson Hood: Roderika's questline must be completed and spirit tuning must be unlocked for this item to appear on top of the pile of corpses surrounded by the Rotten Strays where the Chrysalids' Memento was acquired.
Golden Rune [1] C: Found on a pile of limbs and dead bodies in the main courtyard.
Chrysalids' Memento: Key Quest Item. Found on top of the pile of corpses surrounded by Rotten Strays in a small room. This room is adjacent to the Grafted Scion 's hall.

title: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield, Misericorde +1
text: Note: If Roderika still hasn't moved to Roundtable Hold, you'll find the Chrysalid's Memento instead of the hood. You'll need to follow her questline at the roundtable until she becomes a spirit tuner. She'll then throw away her hood, which replaces the memento.
Enter the north-northwest room and pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [2] beneath the statue on the right.
Hawk Crest Wooden Shield: Medium Shield. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key to dispel the fog gate barring entry.
Misericorde: Dagger. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.
Iron Whetblade: Key Item. Found on a corpse inside the Armory. Requires a Stonesword Key in order to dispel the fog gate barring entry.

title: Godslayer's Seal, Godskin Prayerbook
text: Arrow: Ammunition. Found on a corpse atop some rocks near the Seethewater River Site of Grace
Fireproof Dried Liver: Consumable. Found on a corpse guarded by the Bloodhound Knight in Volcano Manor's secret passageway.

Godslayer's Seal: Found in a room barred by an Imp Statue seal, requiring a to access. From the Rampart Tower, take the lift that leads to the Grafted Scion 's hall. Exit into the courtyard where plenty of Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae. Take a hard left from this exit to find a small stairway leading into a cellar. There are several Rats in this cellar and the Imp Statue barrier behind them. The Seal is found in one of the chests behind the barrier.

Godskin Prayerbook: Can be found at Stormveil Castle , Nearest Site of Grace: Rampart Tower. From the Rampart Tower site of grace, go out the door to the outside (where the birds are). Take a running jump onto the roof across from the door. On the left side of the roof, there will be two separate areas you can drop down to. Drop down to the one without stairs on it, and drop down again. You'll land by a set of steps going down. Go down the steps to find some rats and a white fog wall. You'll need a Stonesword Key to pass through the fog wall, and inside will be two chests. One contains the Godskin Prayerbook, the other contains the Godslayer's Seal . Alternatively, from the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace, exit from the door to the courtyard and turn right. Hug the right side wall past all the enemies. You'll find the set of stairs going down on the wall on the other side.

title: Festering Bloody Finger, Talk to White Mask Varre Invasion Sign
text: Golden Rune [4] A: Looted from a dead body hanging from the higher level.
For now, climb the ladder to the left of the cellar exit and pick up Arrow x10 from behind a barrel.
Festering Bloody Finger: Can be found x3 Festering Bloody Finger at Stormveil Castle on a rooftop, in the courtyard
White Mask Varre Invasion Sign: The invasion sign for this NPC can be found in Mohgwyn Palace .

title: Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10]
text: Note: Skip this step until you've received the Festering Bloody Fingers from Varre during South Liurnia. Picking it up now makes About Invasion Multiplayer unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough. For more info, see Varre's questline.

Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10]: Can be found on a dead body in Stormveil Castle . From Rampart Tower (Site of Grace), head out the north door. Jump to the roof immediately visible to the east. Follow the left ledge, then jump down to the level with the 2 enemies (optional combat). Cross the bridge, the recipe is on the corpse directly ahead guarded by 2 weak enemies.

title: Wooden Greatshield
text: Wooden Greatshield: Greatshield. Found in a guardhouse near the northern section of the castle courtyard.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Head down the stairs and look to the right past some trees to find Mushroom x8 in a corner.
Furlcalling Finger Remedy: One is held by a corpse at Stormveil Castle , reached by descending through the stairs beside Stormveil Front Gates Site of Grace

title: Prophecy Painting
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x2 in the alley west of the stairs, then grab the Liftside Chamber grace in the room next to it.
Prophecy Painting: Info Item. Found by inspecting the large painting inside a building in the northwest section of the main courtyard.

title: Pike
text: Magic Grease: Can be found inside Stormveil Castle, on a corpse laying in the courtyard.
Golden Rune [1] D: Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.
Golden Rune [2] F: x2 Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.
Pike: Can be looted off a corpse that's lying on the heavily guarded courtyard. The nearest checkpoint is the Liftside Chamber site of grace

Smoldering Butterfly: Can be found at the Stormveil Castle courtyard, there are some corpses you can loot to find x1 Magic Grease , x1 Golden Rune (1), x2 Golden Rune (2), x1 Pike1, and x5 Smoldering Butterfly.

title: Commoner's Simple Garb
text: Golden Rune [4] B: Found on one of the dead bodies at the ramp in the northern section of the main courtyard.
Return to the courtyard and pick up Fire Arrow x12 from a wooden guard post.
Smithing Stone [2] E: Upgrade Material. Found behind some explosive barrels on the top level of the castle walls accessed from the Rampart Tower.
Golden Rune [5] B: Found on a dead body reached by a walking on a ledge at the outer side of the northern section of the castle.
Commoner's Simple Garb: Chest Armor. Found on a corpse on the balcony accessible from the Gateside Chamber Site of Grace.

title: Arbalest
text: Golden Rune [2] A: Looted from one of the three bodies at the entrance of Stormveil Castle.
Golden Rune [1] A: Found on a dead body by the Effigy.
Somber Smithing Stone [1]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Lion Guardian east of the castle courtyard.
Beast Blood: Can be acquierd at Stormveil Castle by defeating the Lion Guardian.
Old Fang: Can be acquierd at Stormveil Castle main castle grounds by defeating the Lion Guardian.
Go through the east-northeast corridor to grab the Limgrave Tower Bridge grace for later.

Arbalest: Using a Stonesword Key to access, additionally obtaining the Godskin prayerbook and Godslayer Seal: From the Rampart Tower bonfire, take the shortcut lift down to where the Grafted miniboss is fought inside the storeroom (or reach this point manually). Exit into the courtyard with the flamethrowers and barricades. Take an immediate left and hug the wall until you enter a cellar containing rats. You will hit a fog wall that requires one Stonesword Key to open. Continue past this fog wall until you reach an outdoors area again. Pull an immediate right and hug the wall until you reach a ladder. Continue past this point and almost all the way across the bridge, then jump to the rocky outcropping to your right (it's a tight jump). Continue and jump back into a walled-in area with a ballista. The Arbalest is on a corpse in that area.

title: Talk to Nepheli Loux
text: Smithing Stone [2] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper platform where Castle Guards are mounted on ballistae.
Golden Rune [2] E: Found on a dead body in a room with very long tables one level below the top one.

Nepheli Loux: Nepheli Loux Location 1. A fellow Tarnished warrior NPC found in a small room near the north of the castle. The entrance to this room is behind the courtyard, along the path leading up to the huge steps guarded by a Troll.
miss: To receive the Arsenal Charm from Nepheli in Roundtable Hold, you must exhaust her dialogue in Stormveil Castle before killing Godrick.

title: Golden Seed
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [1] x4 in the corner of the room.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found next to a Phantom Tree in the northeastern section of the castle, behind the courtyard. This tree is outside the cellar where you meet Nepheli Loux .

title: Ash of War: Stormcaller
text: Smithing Stone [2] F: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting on an upper ledge in the corridor leading up to the Secluded Chamber site of grace.
Bait the Troll into following you and attacking the fallen statue back in the courtyard to obtain 5x Smithing Stone [1] and a Smithing Stone [2].
Return to the stairs and grab the Secluded Cell grace in the room on the right before the boss.
Ash of War: Stormcaller: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the northern section of the castle.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Cracked Pot: Found behind the Living Jar enemies between the Secluded Cell and Liftside Chamber (after 2nd shortcut) Sites of Grace .

title: Manor Towershield
text: Beyond the south-southeast doorway is a shortcut lift that goes down to the Liftside Chamber.
On a wooden ledge northeast of the jars sits a corpse with Kukri x8.
Jump to the ledge on the wall and follow it to a ledge with two archways. In the area past them, you'll find Lump of Flesh x3.
Climb the sacks and head through the doorway. At the top of the room, turn right for Smithing Stone [2] x3 on a wooden ledge.
Golden Rune [2] I: Found on the roof of the castle in the northern section.

Manor Towershield: Greatshield. From the Secluded Cell site of grace, backtrack to the west and up the ramp where the Living Jars are and turn around towards the wooden platform. At the end of the platform, jump onto the ledge on the wall and follow it to the right towards some archways. Past the archways, enter the storage room on the right and head up the stairs to a walkway above. Head to the left towards a larger storage room full of Commoners . You can find the shield under the second set of stairs in this room.

title: Rancorcall
text: Pick up the Smithing Stone [3] next to the glowing message outside.
Golden Rune [5]: Found on a dead body, inside Stillwater Cave. In the same room as the Golden Rune (6).
Rainbow Stone: Can be found on a corpse near the Lifside Chamber site of grace. You can only access if you head through the hidden passage and drop down.
Return to the corpse and jump across the broken platforms to reach a corpse with Arteria Leaf on the other side.
At the end of a broken buttress sits a corpse with Smithing Stone [2] x2.
Drop to the bottom for a Golden Rune [2] in the corner.
Poisonbloom: Can be found at Stormveil Castle Castle's Underground Crypt, on a dead body nex to the ruins.
Rancorcall: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab that can be found at the underground crypt of the castle

title: Golden Seed
text: Golden Seed: Obtained by defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the underground area of Stormveil Castle. This area can be accessed via a hidden path above the door of the room with some Living Jar enemies, or by making a damaging drop outside the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Stonesword Key: At Stormveil Castle's Underground Crypt.

title: Prince of Death's Pustule
text: Prince of Death's Pustule: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the pit of the castle's crypt after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit . The body can be found next to a giant face.

title: Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: Found at the bottom of a gutter. The entrance to the crypt is found near the Liftside Chamber site of grace within Stormveil Castle . Defeating it grants a Golden Seed .

title: Boss: Godrick the Grafted
text: Godrick the Grafted: The Lord of Stormveil and the first Demigod encountered. Drops Godrick's Great Rune and Remembrance of the Grafted upon defeat.
Godrick's Great Rune: Dropped as a reward for defeating Godrick the Grafted located at Stormveil Castle .
Remembrance of the Grafted: Obtained as a reward for defeating Godrick the Grafted at Stormveil Castle .

title: Shabriri Grape
text: Nepheli's summon sign can be found near the entrance if you exhausted her dialogue earlier.
Rest at the Godrick the Grafted grace, then talk to Gostoc in the arena.
If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, you'll find a chest containing Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel in the room to the right of the throne.
Shabriri Grape: Key Item. Found next to a ghostly NPC in the underground section of Godrick's throne room.

text: Kenneth Haight can be located in the Throne Room in Stormveil Castle ��for��his final location.

title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta: Hyetta , Location 1. Hyetta roams The Lands Between in search of the distant light, drawn to her destiny by a guiding shine she feels in the back of her eyes when eating Shabriri grapes.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc the Seamster Location 3. After meeting him for the second time, Boc will move to Liurnia of the Lakes. Find him kneeling by the Lake-Facing Site of Grace, a cliff above to the entrance to Stillwater Cave .

title: Boltdrake Talisman
text: Talk to Boc next to the Lake-Facing Cliffs grace and select "Don't tell me...".

text: Warming Stone: Consumable. From Stormveil Castle, on the bridge linking to Divine Tower of Limgrave. Can be found near the edge of the cratered portion of the bridge that leads to the tower, same area as the golem fight.
Soft Cotton: Consumable. Can be found on the broken part of the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of Limgrave, past the teleporter waygate, by dropping down.

At the end of the bridge is a corpse with Stormhawk Feather x5 hanging off the right side edge.
Go back and ride the lift in the tower to reach the Divine Tower of Limgrave grace.

Interact with the rune at the top and restore the power of Godrick's Great Rune. Note: Great Runes can be equipped at sites of grace and activated with Rune Arcs. The effects are lost on death, so you'll need a new Rune Arc each time you die.

text: Note: Make sure to equip a bow or crossbow for destroying the chariot.

Travel to Roundtable Hold and exhaust Enia's dialogue in the newly opened room.

Head through the open door that leads to a corpse on a bed with the Cipher Pata.

Let Fia hold you, then select "Do you know...?" and "About the Black Knifeprint" to receive the Knifeprint Clue.
Talk to D, Hunter of the Dead about Rogier.

place.title: Stillwater Cave
walk: Stillwater Cave is a dark cave comprised of many pits where Miranda Sprouts and their giant counterparts bloom undisturbed. It is recommended to bring along a Torch and a handful of Neutralizing Boluses to counteract the poison build-up inflicted by its denizens. The Site of Grace is found shortly after entering the cave.

The cave itself is rather small and there is a very straight forward path you can take to get to the boss. Also be mindful not to roll or dodge when walking on poison water, as poison will get on your armor and hasten and lengthen poison build up.
From the Site of Grace, hug the right wall and refrain from dropping down into the pits below as they are hotbeds for the Miranda Sprouts.
There will be a single Giant Bat and some Cave Moss, you can try and stealth kill it.

There is a single Servant of Rot along the way. These are the mushroom-faced humanoids that cast poison bolts at targets from a distance. Take him out and jump the gap to reach the ledge ahead where two more servants await.
Enter the tunnel to the left of the two Servants of Rot you just killed (after jumping the gap). Pick up some Cave Moss and Budding Cave Moss.

You'll come to a room with a lootable corpse in some deep poison water. Before doing anything, look up and target lock and you'll find x2 Giant Bats above the body, dispose of them with range attacks.
After killing the two bats, turn right and look up once more to find more bats hanging from the ceiling, please note that one of these will be a stronger variation of bats.

After clearing the room, you can safely pick up the two treasures in this room, one of them being the Sage Set. Take note that the poison water in this room is deep, and your poison bar will fill slightly faster.
Go back out of the room by backtracking through the tunnel, back to where you killed the 2 Servants of Rot and continue.
Hug the edge and head southeast until you see another servant around the bend.
Jump down into the pit from here and run past all the Miranda Sprouts to find a tunnel in the southeast.

This tunnel is filled with Servants of Rot but they are all in a rested state and will take a long time to get combat ready, allowing you to simply weave around them to get to the mist gate at the end and challenge this dungeon's boss: The Cleanrot Knight.
## Boss: Cleanrot Knight

The Cleanrot Knight is an imposing figure wielding a spear and a sword. After traversing through the mist gate, the boss will almost always run towards you and use his Impale attack. This is his most dangerous move and if the attack connects, he will raise you high in the air, deal tremendous amounts of damage and inflict the scarlet rot status on you. Dodge to the side when you see his spear glowing. Use your best spirit summons to distract him and take potshots at the knight from behind. Watch out for the water on the floor which will rapidly cause you to build up the poison stat. The Cleanrot Knight drops the Winged Sword Insignia upon defeat.

Stillwater Cave is a good source of Cave Moss should you require it for farming. Nearly every stretch of the cave has nodes of this material to collect from. Exploring the cave will also yield a good amount of Budding Cave Moss as well as Crystal Cave Moss crafting items. In general, the Giant Miranda Sprouts are not worth killing as they are highly resistant to magic and release a deadly poison at melee range. It's best to skip these while exploring the cave.

place.title: Village of the Albinaurics
walk: The Village of the Albinaurics can be located at the northwest section of the map from Stormveil Castle and the nearest starting point to travel to the village is at the Liurnia Lake Shore site. Map Link. As you travel by mount, simply move northwest and run alongside the cliff. Remain on the left side, pass through a swamp section, and just ignore the enemies you run into until you reach the distressed village. You'll know when you're near once you reach the swamp section and upon going up to a rise of the land - the name of the location will appear upon formally arriving at the village.

As you enter, move towards the house, check behind it to find the Village of the Albinaurics Site. Map Link. Discover and rest here before you start to explore. Now, clear this section first around the house where the player will encounter First-Generation Albinaurics. Make sure to also loot the body near a stone coffin to obtain a Larval Tear, and grab the materials around to find Mushroom and Rowa Fruit. Next, turn around and heap up the hill where you'll encounter a single Depraved Perfumer, killing it may drop 5x Budding Cave Moss. If you walk forward, passing the two houses, on the right side, you'll see a disguised NPC. This turns out to be Albus, who will give you an important key item for your journey. Hit the pot to reveal him.

Before exhausting his dialogue, he will give you a key item, the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right). Speak to him again, exhaust his lines, and he will eventually die due to old age. Before you continue towards the boss, make sure to check behind the stone coffin next to Albus, there's another corpse that you can pillage to acquire an Ivory Sickle. If you don't need to rest at the site, you can proceed to the boss by crossing the stone bridge on this hill.

As you cross, you'll see a golden teardrop scarab. Make sure to kill it before it disappears. On the other side, you'll see a willow tree and a bonfire. The Omenkiller boss is there, as well as a few Rotten Stray. We suggest that you kill the hounds first so that you can fight the boss one on one. Instead of going down the slope, straight to the bonfire, jump down from the right side of the cliff and kill the Rotten Stray. Once the area is clear, then you can approach the bonfire and fight the Omenkiller.

You can visit the Omenkiller page to find more information about this boss, as well as guides and strategies on how to defeat this enemy. Successfully killing this boss yields 4900 Runes and drops the Crucible Knot Talisman. Make sure to also check the right side of this small arena and you will another body at the end of the path, pillage it to find a Rune Arc.

Before you leave this location, there is just one more section you need to clear. Return to the site of the village, next to the house near it, you'll find a wooden bridge. Cross the wooden bridge, kill the First-Generation Albinaurics and make sure to loot the bodies here to find some items, as well as gathering Erdleaf Flower. One can be found resting by the tree trunk, loot it to acquire an Albinauric Bloodclot, while the other is near a ledge, pillage that body to find a Crystal Sword.

place.title: Converted Tower
walk: There are a few items to be gathered at the Converted Tower. You can find a Cuckoo Glintstone just as you enter the tower. In between the tower and the walls behind it, there is a Magic Grease to be found.
You can find a Memory Stone at the top of the tower. The top of the tower is sealed by a puzzle. Read the message at the foot of the statue to find out what the puzzle is.
To clear the puzzle, perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue. The gesture can be obtained by giving Thops an Academy Glintstone Key at the Church of Irith.

If you don't have the Erudition gesture unlocked yet and you're skilled enough on horseback, the puzzle can be skipped by climbing the broken stone wall on the sides of the tower (either on foot or by horse) and then using Torrent to jump into the balcony from the back. While the climb up the wall can be done on foot, you must use Torrent's double jump to reach the balcony.
Once you reach the balcony simply climb up the steps to reach the room at the top, with the chest in the middle of it.
After collecting the Memory Stone, the seal on the door should release.
notes: Converted Tower appears to be very frequently mistaken for the Converted Fringe Tower, that is located northwest of Liurnia of the Lakes near the Black Knife Catacombs. This tower contains the sorceries Cannon of Haima and Gavel of Haima instead of the Memory Stone.

If you choose to use Erudition, note that it takes several seconds before the ladder appears, so just let the gesture animation keep going and don't end it prematurely until you see the ladder materialize.

place.title: Road's End Catacombs
walk: Road's End Catacombs is a pretty straightforward dungeon with 7 Illusory Walls. As soon as you enter, you will find the Site of grace. Keep going, and after facing a few Fanged Imps, you will find a lever. Pull it, then keep going, facing the little resistance you will find.

You will find several Grave Glovewort (2) to grab. When you reach the end, you'll notice that there is not much to do. Hit the wall at the very end to reveal a secret door. Beware of the Fanged Imps that are hiding on the back of the wall as soon as you enter.
Loot the final chest at the end of the tunnel to obtain a new Spirit Ashes called Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes.
## Another Secret Door

As you are making your way back to the entrance, at the bottom of the two sets of stairs leading to the exit, hit the archway next to the stairs to reveal a secret door with some Fanged Imps and the Watchdog's Staff and Grave Glovewort (3). Exit the hidden doorway and proceed up the first set of stairs. Once you are before the last set of stairs, head right and hit the second and fourth archway to reveal two secret doors. There is a single Fanged Imp as well as a Ghost Glovewort (2) and a Rune Arc to loot in the room on the left. Continue through the narrow path until you loot the Root Resin. Hit the wall in front of you to reveal another secret door. Keep going to obtain Grave Glovewort (2). Hit the wall to unveil ANOTHER secret door, which leads to a boss fight, the Spirit-Caller Snail. Defeat it to obtain the Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes and 3000 Runes.

place.title: Bellum Church
walk: The Bellum Church can be found in the North side of the Liurnia of the Lakes region. Players can reach the Bellum Church either by going up the ramp on the west of the church, going through the valley and the watery areas of the north part of the lakes then up the ramp, or by following the east path atop the cliffs. Around the outskirts of the Church are many Cuckoo Knight enemies and even a Night's Cavalry that roams once the sun has set. Come in the evening time to defeat the Night's Calvary and obtain Ash of War: Giant Hunt as a boss drop. Pick up the Sacred Tear found in the front of the church amongst the flowers directly in front of the main statue piece.
notes: Bellum Church is very clearly built on top of a prior structure, which you can see as the Church foundation is sitting on top of a larger foundation which you can descend through on the left side of the Church. The stone slabs from this prior structure do not match the Church slabs.

place.title: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
walk: Two things to note right off the bat:1) I explored the first floor of this place when I first found it so I might be missing a few items. I'll make a note when I'm missing an item.2) This area took me about an hour to get through because I wasn't using a magic imbued weapon. I highly recommend using one. Throughout most of this mine the only enemies attacking you are the Digger guards watching over the Diggers and the Marionette soldiers. The Diggers will not attack unless either you hit them or steal the material they are mining.
The Crystalized enemies in this dungeon have a rare chance to drop Somber Smithing Stone (2)

With that out of the way let's begin. When first entering the mine you'll find an elevator. Going down it will put you in front of the Site of Grace for this area. On the way down the elevator you might notice two doorways on the left side of the wall. If you want to reach these, go back up the elevator and destroy the boxes on the left right before you get on the elevator then jump down. Be careful because if you fall you will die. In the first doorway you will find x1 Cracked Crystal. Following the ledge left drop down and enter the next doorway. You'll get 3 Cracked Crystals. Continue following the ledges down. There are lamps to guide you. At the bottom of the elevator, before you head through the doorway, look behind you and grab the x2 Cracked Crystal that are in the corners.

Heading through the tunnel in front of the elevator will lead you to a fork in the path. Going right will bring you to a chest guarded by two Diggers. One of which will patrol the area. Inside the chest you'll find Somber Smithing Stone (2) 1x, and a Somber Smithing Stone (3) behind the raised icon. You can grab 4 Cracked Crystals from this room. Going to the left will lead you to an open area with one Digger on the left and three on the right. One of the Diggers on the right is patrolling the area while the other two are mining. You'll notice a support beam in the area. If you cross it you can jump on the wooden ledges that are jutting out. Near the top grab the Smithing Stone [3]. At the top you'll find a corpse with one Somber Smithing Stone [3]. This room holds six Cracked Crystals.

In the next room, looking to the right you'll notice another Digger sitting down. Down the first set of stairs are two more Diggers who are also sitting down. They will attack you when you near them, just like the previous one who was sitting. After killing them look to your right. You should see a Digger and a path that leads to a small room. Be careful when attacking the Digger outside of it because one from beneath the stairs will attack you. The small room holds 2 Smithing Stone [3]. One on a wall to the left and one on a corpse to the right. Going behind the stairs you'll find a corpse with 1 Golden Rune [3]. This room contains a total of sixteen Cracked Crystals and a further Smithing Stone [3]. Exiting this room leads you to an elevator with more ledges. Just like last time, stick to the left. You'll find a tunnel that leads to a ledge with Somber Smithing Stone [2] and x2 Cracked Crystal. Either return to the elevator shaft or carefully drop below to access a corpse with a Somber Smithing Stone (3).

Either path connects you to a cavern with another support beam and another elevator. Before crossing the beam, kill the Digger on your left and grab the Smithing Stone [2]. After crossing the beam, kill the patrolling Digger but don't go up the stairs. Instead go to the right of them and grab the Smithing Stone [3]. Go up the stairs and kill the other Digger that is patrolling, then take the elevator up so you have a shortcut if you die. This level holds eight Cracked Crystals, one Smithing Stone [3], and one Smithing Stone [2] in total.

Be careful going through the tunnel leading out because a Marionette soldier will run out of the room to your right and attack you with four daggers. Kill him quickly if possible. Before going into the room they came out of look at the other doorway and look up. You'll notice two more Marionette soldiers hanging waiting to attack you. Getting close will make them fall. Both have two bows each and can be annoying if not dealt with quickly. The room the first Marionette soldier came out of holds three Smithing Stone (1) and one Smithing Stone [2]. Going through the other doorway where the two Marionette soldiers dropped down from leads you to another section with two doors. As soon as you pass the doorway on the right look up and you'll see another Marionette soldier wielding bows. They won't drop down until you attack them or the other two Marionette soldiers in the room. The two on the ground both wield daggers and are guarding a chest. Kill them then the archer if you haven't yet. The chest holds a Crystal Knife.

Go through the doorway that has a tunnel in view. The first level has no enemies on it. Go down the first set of stairs and kill the Digger. After you killed him look to the left. You should see three Diggers in a circle and two Crystal Sorcerers. Take out the sorcerers first. They have more health than the Diggers and the Diggers here won't attack you unless you attack them first. After dealing with the sorcerers, kill the three Diggers in a circle and collect the three Smithing Stone [3] and the Somber Smithing Stone [1]. There are two more Diggers in this area. After killing them all (if you want to) you can collect the eight Cracked Crystals, the Smithing Stone [2], and the Smithing Stone [3]. The last two smithing stones can be found in the collapsed tunnel in the back of the room. Looking north from the bottom of the stairs, there is a tunnel with the Shatter Earthsorcery on the right side.

The tunnel in front of the stairs leads you to an elevator. To the left of it, after you break the items there, jumping down will lead you to a small tunnel with a Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Once at the bottom of the elevator you'll sell the golden boss fog, but pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [1] to your left first. If you want to go back to the Site of Grace to rest and take the elevators you found along the way down.
BOSS FIGHT:

This boss is the Crystalian. It's moves are easy to predict and you can summon spirits to help you. You won't be doing much damage in the beginning until their armor breaks at half health. Strike weapons like maces and clubs will do a lot more damage in that first phase. After their armor breaks at half health all weapons will do full damage again. Getting hit with one of her throwing blades seemed to cause one resembling it to show around my wrist allowing me to do full damage.
Spirit Ashes like Banished Knight Engvall Ashes can help keep the boss stunlocked.

place.title: Academy Crystal Cave
walk: The Academy Crystal Cave can be accessed by following the Liurnia shallows towards the west of the Raya Lucaria Academy. The entrance is found on the western cliff below the academy, barred by an Imp Statue. Look for the entrance on our Elden Ring Map Here. Two Stonesword Keys are required to dispel the fog barrier. These caves are very dark except for the flashes of glintstone spells cast by the sorcerers within. It is highly recommended to equip a Torch whilst traversing the caves.

Shortly after the entry, you will find the area's Site of Grace. Continue on into the cave and look to the left for a Crystal Cave Moss. This cave is rich in this item so be on the lookout for them if you require them for crafting. There is a Rat with its back turned which you can assassinate or skip if you wish. A couple more Rats lie in the path ahead. Following the linear path, you will arrive in a large foggy cave with many pillar-sized crystals.

There are several Twinsage Sorcerers in this cave, armed with powerful glintstone spells. Utilize the crystal pillars to block their line of sight, as well as their projectiles. At the start of the cave, look for the lone sorcerer facing a pillar and take this chance to ambush him with a critical attack. Beware of a second sorcerer just behind that pillar and the group of three sorcerers approaching from the back of the cave. Weave around the crystals and take them out one by one, mixing in any AoE attacks when you see an opportunity to hit multiple of them. There are two more sorcerers next to each other near the north section of this cave, and one more behind a pillar a few steps ahead.

After defeating all the sorcerers, look for an opening in the northwest for a small room with a cage. You can pick up a Stonesword Key from the corpse in the cage as well as some Budding Cave Moss along the walls. Go back to the large cave area and go east through a tunnel leading to a wooden doorway. Open the door and you will arrive in a storage area of sorts with a Battlemage guarding the doorway on the left. Battlemages are tanky and can take a lot more hits than the Twinsage Sorcerers. There is also a Glintstone Sorcerer patrolling the room. Go through the room the Battlemage was guarding to find another room where a Sorcerer is standing on a raised platform. Defeat the sorcerer and loot the chest in the room for a Rune Arc. To access the raised platform, attack an illusory walls close by (screenshot here) and loot another chest to collect the Crystal Staff.

Head back to the storage area and look to the east to find the fog gate leading to this dungeon's boss: The Crystalians. This boss encounter is against a pair of Crystalian opponents. One wields a spear, while the other wields a staff. Both are protected by a thick, crystal shield, significantly reducing the damage they take from your attacks. These shields will eventually break after each Crystalian's HP reaches a certain percentage. Cracks will be visible in their shields, signifying that you can now deal full damage to them. It is highly recommended that you use a tanky summon such as the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes to distract one of the Crystalians as you focus on the other. See the Crystalians page for further details on the fight.

Defeating this pair of bosses yields the Crystal Release Sorcery spell. Continue on to the door behind the bosses to reach an elevator that will take you to a tower within the academy. Climb the tower to find a chest containing the Terra Magica spell.
