From the roof, head north-northwest to find a corpse with Magic Grease on the tip of a fallen spire on your left.
Crystal Bud: Crafting Material. Looted from a corpse in a corner of the destroyed church in the middle section of Academy Gate Town.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4]: Key Item. Found at Academy Gate Town inside a chest within a tower on the rooftop of a destroyed building.
Arteria Leaf: Crafting Material. Can be found on a corpse on a rooftop near to the tower with the chest for Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4] .
miss: Unobtainable if you join the Volcano Manor before returning her necklace.

title: Talk to Diallos
text: NPC. He leaves the Roundtable Hold and then be found over the corpse of Lanya.

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird
text: Death Rite Bird: Death Rite Bird Miniboss that spawns only at night, south from the Gate Town North site of grace. Drops Ancient Death Rancor.
Ancient Death Rancor: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Liurnia of the Lake , to the east of Raya Lucaria Academy at night, south of the Gate Town North site of grace.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Stonesword Key: Found within a chest, in one of the small islands next to the Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Talk to Isolated Merchant
text: Behind the building east of the tower, next to some gravestones, lies a corpse with Crystal Cave Moss x3.
Travel to the South Raya Lucaria Gate and examine the gate seal. Grab the Main Academy Gate grace after arriving.
Isolated Merchant: Merchant. Sells Spirit Ashes, Cookbook, Stonesword Key, Warrior Set, and several useful items.

title: Celestial Dew
text: Strip of White Flesh: Crafting Material. Two can be looted from a corpse by traveling the road south from Main Academy Gate, past the Isolated Merchant.
Celestial Dew: Used to seek absolution at the Church of Vows. Found on a corpse leaning against the inner side of the locked gate.

title: Invader: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin, Furlcalling Finger Remedy F +1
text: Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin: Technically you are the invader of an NPC called "Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin".
Furlcalling Finger Remedy F: Looted off a corpse in the middle part of the Iron Ball trap stairs.
Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists: Questline Reward: Found after aiding Bloody Finger Hunter Yura in defeating his target in Raya Lucaria
miss: You must talk to Yura at least once before approaching the Grand Lift of Rold in the Forbidden Lands.

title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: He can be found requesting aid from the player in the form of a Red Summon Sign on the bridge north of the Main Gate Grace. Walk past the magic seal to find. Enter his world and defeat Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin. Afterward, talk to Yura who will be standing against the railing near to where his summon sign was

title: Golden Seed
text: Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Obtained as a reward by talking to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at this location after assisting him in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin via a red summon sign.
Golden Seed: Can be found north of the Main Academy Gate site of grace, on the bridge.
miss: Must be obtained before approaching the Grand Lift of Rold in the Forbidden Lands.

title: Marionette Soldier Ashes
text: Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Looted of a corpse in the second graveyard of Raya Lucaria Academy, before the room leading to the elevator to the higher areas.
Open the door up the stairs, then hit the illusory wall immediately on the right to discover an area with a Rune Arc.

Somber Smithing Stone [3] B: Looted on the monolith. It can be found past the Graveyard section where you'll see a large rotating lift. It is protected by a Monolith Guardian in Raya Lucaria Academy .
Golden Rune [2]: North area of the courtyard, beware of the Giant Crab .
Grab the Church of the Cuckoo grace in the corridor at the opposite side of the room.
Grace Mimic: Consumable Item. Three can be Looted off a corpse at the northwest of the graveyard. The body is next to a gravestone, sitting by the ledge.
Spellproof Dried Liver: One can be found in Liurnia of the Lakes area at the foot of a large tombstone.
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Looted off a corpse found by dropping down to the right of the door as soon as entering the first graveyard in Raya Lucaria Academy .

Marionette Soldier Ashes: When you reach the graveyard section, as you cross the other side of the bridge, make a hard left and drop down to find a path that curves to where the Marionette Soldiers are, kill the two soldiers and then loot the corpse that is hanging by the ledge to find this item.

title: Ash of War: Spectral Lance
text: Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: Consumable Item. Looted from a corpse guarded by dogs and undead in the second graveyard of the area, after crossing a wooden hanging bridge.

Golden Rune [4]: On a dead body with its back to the precipice, near the main courtyard. Held by a corpse lying against one of the stones. On a corpse lying against one of the walls of the small garden, next to the stairs.

Ash of War: Spectral Lance: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in the large graveyard east of the Church of the Cuckoo site of grace. From the site of grace, exit east into the graveyard and head northeast to find a wooden bridge. Just past the bridge, head slightly southeast towards the cliff edge behind a cluster of gravestones. There should be a lower path you can jump down onto and the scarab should be in view at this point.
Mushroom: You can find x5 Mushroom at the Raya Lucaria Academy on a corpse that is behind a tree by the wall.

title: Carian Knight Set
text: Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the platform to the right of the gate after entering Raya Lucaria Academy

Carian Knight Set: The Carian Knight Set can be picked up next to a large tombstone, past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy. When you reach the gate entrance leading to the large rotating lift, make a hard right and look below the ledge, jump down and follow the narrow path where you'll see a group of Glintstone Zombies worshipping a tombstone.

title: Gravity Well
text: Golden Rune [4]: Looted off a corpse that's sitting on a ledge. Past the first two Marionette Soldiers, you encounter on the rooftops of the academy.
Gravity Well: Dropped by the Monolith Guardian enemy that appears from a gravity portal. The section is near the graveyard and the large rotating lift of Raya Lucaria Academy .
Somber Smithing Stone [3] A: Looted off a corpse behind the altar of the Church of the Cuckoo in the academy.

title: Avionette Soldier Ashes
text: Crystal Dart: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the rooftop area of Raya Lucaria Academy, when a Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers attack.
Go up the stairs to grab the Schoolhouse Classroom grace in advance.
Golden Rune [4]: Held by a corpse situated on top of the roofs of the Academy.

Golden Rune [3]: Pillaged from a corpse located on a wooden beam of the Church of the Cuckoo ceiling. The only way though is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops of Raya Lucaria Academy .
Avionette Soldier Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Located on a corpse after taking the rotating lift down in Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Longtail Cat Talisman
text: Smithing Stone [5] A: At the lower level accessed descending from the elevator. On a dead body.
Climb the crystals near the corpse to pick up Lost Ashes of War at the end of a cliff.

Longtail Cat Talisman: Looted off a corpse that can be found at the bottom section of the large rotating lift. Past the graveyard section of Raya Lucaria Academy, simply ride the lift down and defeat the single Pendulum Statue enemy.

title: Conspectus Scroll, Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]
text: Note: If you died to its grab attack, follow the tunnel past the lava until you reach a site of grace. After resting, you should be able to return to the academy.
Conspectus Scroll: Looted off a body inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left. You'll see the corpse in front a an illusory wall.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [5]: Looted from a treasure chest inside a room. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left.

region: Academy of Raya Lucaria · meeting 2 of 2
title: Talk to Thops
text: If you give him the Academy Glintstone Key that you find in Raya Lucaria Academy, you'll find him dead, sitting in a chair, outside the Schoolhouse Classroom Site. You can loot the following from his body: Thops's Bell Bearing , Academy Glintstone Staff , and Thops's Barrier .

title: Olivinus Glintstone Crown
text: Smithing Stone [4]: Looted from a corpse on the balcony behind an illusory wall. From the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy , go to the hallway, turn left. The illusory wall is in front of the corpse inside the room.

Olivinus Glintstone Crown: Looted from a corpse on a narrow path that leads back to the Schoolhouse Classroom site of Raya Lucaria Academy . You need to pass through the illusory wall and jump over the balcony on the left, and circle back to the said site of grace. To find the illusory wall, go to the hallway from the schoolhouse classroom site, turn left. The illusory wall is in front of the corpse inside the room.

title: Ritual Pot
text: Ritual Pot: Special Tool Key Item. Found inside a treasure chest, at the end of the hallway that is guarded by sorcerers and a giant Living Jar. The nearest site of grace is the Schoolhouse Classroom in Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy E
text: Furlcalling Finger Remedy E: Looted off a corpse hanging on the fence of the second-floor balcony. The nearest site of grace is the Schoolhouse Classroom in Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Comet, Stonesword Key
text: Comet: Found behind an Illusory Wall before the Debate Hall Site of Grace.
Stonesword Key: Looted on a fountain, center of the academy's courtyard.

title: Graven-School Talisman
text: Graven-School Talisman: Talisman. Found beyond the illusory wall before the Red Wolf of Radagon boss fight. Go up the ladder close to the Debate Hall Site of Grace and then down the hole to another the room with potboys. This opens the door inaccessible as you entered this area.

title: Boss: Red Wolf of Radagon
text: Red Wolf of Radagon: Sub-boss of the area. A giant red wolf Great Enemy Boss found in Raya Lucaria within Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops 1x Memory Stone.
Memory Stone: Rewarded as a drop upon defeating Red Wolf of Radagon .

title: Golden Seed
text: Activate the Debate Parlor grace and pass time until nightfall.
Head into the courtyard and pick up the Stonesword Key on the fountain.
Glintstone Firefly: You can find x5 Glintstone Firefly Looted off a corpse, north section of the courtyard.
Golden Rune [2]: Looted off a corpse at the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy
Golden Seed: 1 can be found on the ground, next to the glowing sapling. West of the academy's courtyard.

title: Karolos Glintstone Crown
text: Karolos Glintstone Crown: Drops from the Crystallized Crab that can be found by a corner on the west side of the academy's courtyard.

title: Invader: Moongrum, Carian Knight, Carian Knight's Shield
text: Return to the courtyard and ascend the large curved staircase, picking up a Furlcalling Finger Remedy while dodging the boulder.
Moongrum, Carian Knight: Moongrum, Carian Knight. The last line of denfense before reaching Rennala's arena. Drops the Carian Knight's Shield upon defeating the hostile NPC.
Carian Knight's Shield: Dropped by Moongrum Carian Knight .

region: Academy of Raya Lucaria · meeting 2 of 4
title: Talk to Sorceress Sellen
text: Summon signs to either help or betray Sorceress Sellen at the end of her quest can be found right by the entrance to the Library. She will also be here to provide your reward should you choose to side with her.

title: Glintstone Scarab
text: Follow the south-southwest path through a covered walkway to open a shortcut back to the courtyard, then return the way you came to find a Golden Rune [4].
Jump over the balustrade near the corpse to reach a room with a ladder. Open the shortcut door first, then climb up and kill the sorcerers who summon the boulder.

Glintstone Scarab: Found inside a chest. From the garden section where you encountered the hostile NPC Moongrum Carian Knight, go west, by the gate, hug the wall and jump over the fence. Follow the path and then climb the ladder. The chest is inside the room at the top of the ladder.

title: Radagon Icon
text: Golden Rune [7]: Consumable. Held by a corpse accessible only by taking the ladder in the hidden room leading to the Sorcerers summoning the magic ball trap, then jumping out the window above the waygate.
Confirm that it's still nighttime, then use the sending gate below and kill the Bell Bearing Hunter in Church of Vows for Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing and 6,000 runes.

Reload the area and talk to Miriel. Show him the Celestial Dew, then select "Talk". If you've killed or aggro'ed any NPCs, you can cleanse your sins at the statue. Any previously hostile NPCs will then become friendly again.
Crystal Bud: You can find x5 at the second floor, on a corpse on the ledge.

Radagon Icon: Found inside a treasure chest on the second floor of the Debate Hall Site of Grace. From the gate entrance leading to the courtyard, make a hard right and jump over the fence. Climb up the ladder and head through the broken glass window. The treasure chest is on the east section.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Living Jar Shard: You can find x3 Living Shard at the Raya Lucaria Academy in the Debate Hall door.
Cracked Pot: Can be found at the Raya Lucaria Academy near the Debate Hall door.

title: Glintstone Whetblade
text: Glintstone Whetblade: Looted off a corpse that is hanging on the fence of an office balcony. From the fountain of the academy's courtyard, go west and head up the slope. The office is in front of the group of kneeling Noble Zombies.

title: Full Moon Crossbow
text: Up the stairs opposite the room, you'll find a Golden Rune [2].
Go up the stairs next to the room, then jump over the west balustrade. Open the shortcut down the stairs, then go back up to grab a Golden Rune [3] at the end.
Jump onto the rooftops below and continue to a ladder. Pick up the Golden Rune [4] on the ledge around it.
Crystal Dart: Consumable Throwable Item. Found on a corpse just outside the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace, by some digging aristocrats.
Meteor Bolt: Consumable Item. Five can be looted from a corpse on the tower after the encounter with three Avionette Soldiers and a Sorcerer

Drop to the rooftop below, then once more to a second rooftop. From there, you're gonna do a long jump, so make sure to hold the sprint button during the entire jump for the longest distance. While facing west-northwest, jump across the long gap to the rooftop ahead.

Full Moon Crossbow: Weapon. From the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, head out into the courtyard and to the left to reach the rooftops. Continue along the rooftops until the tower past the Glintstone Sorcerer and three Avionette Soldiers. Across from the tower on another rooftop, an item will be visible. Drop down to the rooftop below and jump on top of the spike near the right edge. From the spike, turn left and jump onto the gargoyle (architectural, not an enemy) protruding from a corner of the building. Another jump will bring you to the rooftop with the item, a Smithing Stone [4]. Alternatively, you can reach this item by jumping from the tower onto a roof opposite the Full Moon Crossbow's chest in the tower. From that roof, a long jump will be required to reach the rooftops with the patrolling Marionette Soldier with spears. Sprinting before the jump is required, as a normal jump will not cover the distance. Note that there is a delay before sprinting starts (likely to determine whether the player is trying to roll or sprint). Continue along the rooftops to the left, past the four Marionette Soldiers and jump onto a platform connected to a tower. Inside, two Marionette Soldiers will ambush you from either side. Climb up the ladder to find a chest with the Full Moon Crossbow.

title: Lazuli Glintstone Crown
text: Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Only accessible by dropping down from the tower with the Full Moon Crossbow .
Lazuli Glintstone Crown: Looted from a Crystal Crab . Click Here for a detailed guide on how to get it.

title: Imbued Sword Key
text: Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Looted off a corpse that can be found in a small room with some small crabs. Located at the rooftops section of Raya Lucaria Academy .

Travel to Debate Parlor and return to the rooftop where you made the long jumps. This time, drop down the north rooftops instead to pick up the Golden Rune [4] on a roof past the stretch with two Marionette Soldiers.
Imbued Sword Key: Key Item used to activate a Waygate. It can be looted off a corpse found on the east side of the Raya Lucaria Academy rooftops.

title: Academy Glintstone Key
text: Go around the ledge of the second tower to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [3] x2.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse on the rooftops of the Church of Cuckoo, protected by two Avionette Soldiers.
Go through the church windows and pick up the Golden Rune [3] on the rafters.

Academy Glintstone Key: Looted off a corpse that's on the chandelier of Church of the Cuckoo. The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops of Raya Lucaria Academy .

title: Twinsage Glintstone Crown
text: Twinsage Glintstone Crown: Drops from a Crystallized Crab once killed. You'll find it outside the second-floor balcony, east section of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . It's hiding by the corner of the scaffolding.

title: Shattering Crystal
text: Shattering Crystal: Looted off a corpse on the second floor, west side, of the Church of the Cuckoo in Raya Lucaria Academy . The only way to reach this is going through the broken glass window of the church via the rooftops

title: Azur's Glintstone Staff
text: Azur's Glintstone Staff: Looted on the ground inside a room that is full of crystals. It's on the east side, the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo within Raya Lucaria Academy.

title: Talk to Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
text: Smithing Stone [5] B: Looted off a corpse at the end of the cut out steps of the Iron ball trap.
Crystal Dart: Looted off a corpse on the broken beam connected to the stars of the Iron ball trap.
Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon: Rennala becomes a merchant in her boss room after defeating her. She provides rebirthing services, allowing you to respec your character.
Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen: Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress. To be given to Enia to draw out the power within.
Great Rune of the Unborn: Great Rune of Rennala, Queen of the Moon. Acquired as a reward for defeating the supreme sorceress.

title: Ash of War: Thops's Barrier
text: Activate the Raya Lucaria Grand Library grace and talk to Rennala. Select "Cosmetics", then "Finish Cosmetics" to learn the Balled Up gesture.
Return to Thops in Church of Irith and give him your second glintstone key to learn the Erudition gesture. Optionally, talk to him about Sellen.
Ash of War: Thops's Barrier: Ash of War. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab that spawns inside the church after Thops leaves for the academy.

title: Thops's Bell Bearing, Academy Glintstone Staff
text: Thops's Bell Bearing: Looted from Thops' corpse .
Academy Glintstone Staff: Staff. Can be found on Sorcerer Thops' body near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace after giving him the Academy Glintstone Key.
Talk to Enia in Roundtable Hold to receive a Talisman Pouch. Optionally, talk to her about Queen Marika.
Speak with Corhyn and select "Talk" now that you've obtained two Great Runes.

title: Treespear
text: Travel to Liurnia Lake Shore and head east to a spiritspring. Use it while facing east-northeast, then grab the Liurnia Highway South grace by the road.
Treespear: Found on the Caravan left at the edge of the collapsed bridge.

title: Shabriri Grape, Two Fingers Heirloom
text: Return to Liurnia Highway South and pop the two balloons near the grace for 2x Golden Rune [6].
Stormhawk Feather: Found on a corpse by the road.
Cuckoo Glintstone: Consumable Item. Four can be found on a dead body, against a wall within Purified Ruins. Beware of the group of Soldiers.
Shabriri Grape: Can be found in a hidden cellar. The path is blocked by debris and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy. Once downstairs, you can find it on your left.

Two Fingers Heirloom: Talisman. Found in a chest inside a hidden cellar in the Purified Ruins . The cellar entrance is concealed by wooden planks and barrels that you can roll onto or attack to destroy.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Held by a corpse near the armored giant spawn.
Mushroom: Crafting Material. Four can be looted from a corpse guarded by two zombie dogs north from Purified Ruins.

title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta , Location 2. She is found at the western side of the Purified Ruins . She asks for another Shabriri Grape but does not give any reward this time.

title: Nox Mirrorhelm, Scythe +3
text: Pick up Cuckoo Glintstone x4 from a corpse in the ruined building.
Loot the Shabriri Grape and Two Fingers Heirloom in the cellar covered with breakable planks in the ruined building.
In front of some barrels west of the cellar, you'll find a Golden Rune [3].
Talk to Hyetta by the ruins near the shore and give her a Shabriri Grape.
Pick up Mushroom x5 from the corner of the ruins north-northeast of Hyetta.
Return to the road and grab the Liurnia Highway North grace before a battlefield.
On top of the ruin north-northeast of the grace is a corpse with Beast Blood, guarded by wolves.
Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. One can be looted from a teardrop scarab that explodes upon defeat.

Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found by facing east while riding down the lift by the entrance and jumping onto a small balcony as the lift passes it by. The second one is found by turning the corner in the corridor to the right of the boss door. The third one is found by heading up the stairs to the right of the door sealed by an Imp Statue and following the path to an alcove in a small room at the end. The final one is found along a corridor leading up to the room with a ladder to the library.
Root Resin: Crafting Material. Five can be looted from a corpse in the first chamber after descending the lift into Cliffbottom Catacombs.

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the large room with the Imp Statue seal - Check the area behind the stairs leading up to the Imp Statue. The second one is found in a narrow corridor on the top level of the multi-leveled hall where you can see the boss lever statue. In the same multi-leveled hall, drop down onto the central stair-bridge and then drop further down into the pit below and check the corridors for the third and fourth Grave Glovewort (3).
Nox Mirrorhelm: Helmet. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : In the sealed room, accessible by using a Stonesword Key at the Imp Statue.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a corpse on a dead-end chamber within Cliffbottom Catacombs, near the Stone Sword Key Imp gate.
Scythe: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs : toward the end of the dungeon, find a staircase to go up into a room with some Imps and a trap.

Ghost Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. In the large multi-level hall, drop down to the very bottom via the gaps on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors of this bottom pit for several items, one of which is a Ghost Glovewort (3).

Prattling Pate: Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs , in the very bottom level of the large multi-leveled hall. You can drop down to this level via the gap on either side of the central stair-bridge. Check around the corridors here for several items, one of which is the Prattling Pate.
Page Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found in Cliffbottom Catacombs, in an altar right before you pull the lever to open the Boss Door.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. Found on a corpse by the lever that opens the Boss Room Door in Cliffbottom Catacombs.
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Optional Boss found at the end of the Cliffbottom Catacombs . Drops the Kaiden Sellsword Ashes upon defeat.
Kaiden Sellsword Ashes: Found within Cliffbottom Catacombs . Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

title: Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3], Carian Glintblade Staff
text: Enter and activate the Cliffbottom Catacombs grace.
Ride the lift down while facing east, then jump to a ledge with Grave Glovewort [2].
Pick up Root Resin x5 from the first room.
Continue until you reach a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [2].
Go down the stairs and continue to a room with a Grave Glovewort [3] beneath the floor.
Unlock the imp seal on the second floor to pick up Nox Mirrorhelm.
In front of some bookshelves beneath the floor is a Rune Arc.
Pick up Grave Glovewort [2] from the top floor room, then pick up Scythe from the room at the end.
Before dropping down, loot the Golden Rune [3] and Grave Glovewort [3] in the left passage.
Drop onto the staircase, then once more to the bottom for a Ghost Glovewort [3] in the middle.
Loot the 2x Grave Glovewort [3], Hefty Beast Bone x3, and Prattling Pate "Wonderful" around the room.
Continue ahead to find a Grave Glovewort [2] in the corridor.
Climb the ladder at the end and pick up Page Ashes from the altar on the left.
Pull the boss lever, then turn around to find Old Fang x3 in the corner.
Kill the Erdtree Burial Watchdog for Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3,200 runes.
Travel to Liurnia Highway North and head up the northwest slope. Pick up a Golden Rune [4] from the camp outside the tower.
Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3]: Cookbook Key Item. Found on a corpse on a wooden walkway in an upper level of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .
Carian Glintblade Staff: Staff. Found on the top floor of the Highway Lookout Tower in Liurnia .

place.title: Cliffbottom Catacombs
walk: Cliffbottom Catacombs is a catacombs that is filled with imps and omens. Walk carefully to not wake or alert the omens or get jumped on by the imps. The catacombs also have multiple buttons on the floor that trigger traps that shoot projectiles at the player; you can use them to your advantage by triggering them to hit enemies. The imps in this dungeon will throw a blue pot explosion at players.

Leaving the Site of Grace going down the stairs you will see the elevator room, step on the button to lower yourself down. A lever is present at the top and bottom of the shaft for you to call the elevator if it is not there. The first room after the elevator has 2 imps, one on the wall ahead and one standing on the right of the entrance. Past this room is the pair of locked doors flanked by 2 statues, the door will be unlocked by a lever found deep in the catacombs.

Stepping into the rest of the catacombs you will walk into a square room with a staircase, the stairs lead downwards going over a pit where an omen can be seen sitting. Going forward into the next tunnel be careful of both the floor trap as well as the imp in the ceiling, there is another imp on the corner ahead that will jump you so be prepared for it.

Through this tunnel you enter into a room with a high ceiling, and some stairs leading up on the left side, straight ahead there is a sleeping ogre between the pillars, kill it to get to the grave glovewort behind it. Up the stairs is a sealed door and an imp statue but also another omen, this time awake and patrolling, above them are a pair of imps ready to throw grenades at you if you catch their attention. You could either rush the imps by going up the stairs and ignoring the omen or kite the omen down the stairs to separate the imps and the omen to make for an easier fight. You can also stealth up the side of the stairs and through the door while the omen is walking the other direction, the imps will not notice.

The room sealed by the Imp statue will require a Stonesword Key to open, inside you will find 1 imp enemy and the Nox Mirrorhelm. Go up the stairs and carefully deal with the two imps in this room, a floor trap is placed right at the entrance to the room which can be used to shoot projectiles into one of the imps. Following the path out of this room you will find yourself in the space above the initial set of stairs and entrance. There are multiple imps in this area and in the room on the left you can find 3 imps, the body there holds the scythe for you to loot.

To proceed to the lever you have to drop down into the room under the first set of stairs leading from the locked doors. This part of the catacombs has multiple omens roaming the halls so tread carefully. Moving around the tunnels here you can find remains with loot on them, one of which is the Prattling Pate "Wonderful".

From the room you dropped down into go east to advance, there you will find a single omen blocking the way forward, kill it to proceed. At the end of these tunnels is a ladder, climb it to find a room with a carpet and some bookshelves. On the left you will find an omen looking at a tomb in front of a stone statue, going right will lead you to the lever and the way back to the start. On the tomb is the Page Ashes.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

This fight is against a variant version of the Erdtree Burial Watchdog that uses a staff, spells and has three heads that will do a three-headed fire-breathing attack. The fight is against just the boss without any additional enemies. The boss still uses the same movement pattern as the normal Erdtree Burial Watchdog, in their seated form floating up and towards the player before stomping down and walking towards the player to slam and slamming that down while in their standing form. While seated the Erdtree Burial Watchdog will also cast spells at players, breathing flames at them or casting seeking Glintstone Sorceries. Defeating this boss will reward you with Kaiden Sellsword Ashes and 3,200 Runes.

title: Lucerne
text: Lucerne: East of Highland Lookout Tower in East Liurnia of the Lakes, found in the battlefield between phantoms and knights near where the armored giant spawns. Break some carts to reveal the treasure.
Golden Rune [3]: Two ( 2 ) Golden Runes (3) found within the graveyard.
Golden Rune [6]: Found within the graveyard.

title: Talk to Hyetta
text: Hyetta spawns near the site of grace. She will ask for another Shabriri Grape and will ask what the grapes really are. Telling her will make her puke and then thank you for telling her. After sitting down at the grace nearby she will have more dialog. After once again sitting at the grace she will move to her next location.

title: Land Squirt Ashes
text: Continue following the road until you reach the Gate Town Bridge grace at the end.
Talk to Hyetta near the grace, give her a Shabriri Grape, and answer that they're human eyes. Reload the area, then exhaust her dialogue.
Pick up the Sliver of Meat guarded by a Runebear south of the grace.
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Three can be looted from a gazebo close to the South-East of Academy Gate Town. Beware of a Giant Lobster ambush.
Golden Rune [6] A: You will spot a ballon, that has some enemies attached to it. Defeat all of them and destroy the ballon to obtain the Golden Rune.
Strip of White Flesh: Crafting Material. Can be found in the back of the bridge. Beware of the Infested pods lurking there.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: One can be found at the northern side of the broken bridge that leads to Raya Lucaria Academy

Land Squirt Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found at a grave with several groups of land squirts nearby on the east shore of Liurnia Lake. To reach it, start at the Gate Town Bridge site of grace, go down to ground level, and simply travel north along the shore.

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner
text: Return to Gate Town Bridge and head east toward a spiritspring. Just south of it is an exploding scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
Use the spiritspring while facing north to find an astrolabe with Starlight Shards at the edge.
Tibia Mariner: One of the locations where Tibia Mariner Boss appears.

Deathroot: Deathroot dropped by Tibia Mariner located at Liurnia of the Lakes

Continue along the path until you reach Uld Palace Ruins, where an Ancestral Follower will be shooting at you from a bridge. Make your way onto the bridge by going under it, then cross it to discover the Ruined Labyrinth grace.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar

Take down the second Wandering Mausoleum by hitting the formations around its feet. Optionally, mark its location on your map.

Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.
Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.
Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar.

title: Rosus' Axe, Boss: Black Knife Assassin +3
text: Grave Glovewort [2]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first is found to the left of the boss door, just before the steps leading downwards. The second one is found just past the Imp Statue-sealed room, in a dead end to the left. The third and fourth are found in the first section of the sewer area after dropping down the ladder.

Spellproof Dried Liver: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse in the room with the saw traps.-11

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the room with the cleaver traps. Wait for the second-to-last cleaver to fall and then stand on top of it to use it as a lift. Jump onto the tunnel in the wall and the glovewort can be found just to the right of the entrance. The next one is found by continuing along the same tunnel. All the way to the end of the path is an illusory wall hiding the Black Knife Assassin 's mist gate. The glovewort is found just before this gate.

Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. The first one is found in the center of a small room past the hall with the cleaver traps. The second one is found in the second section of the sewer area, after dropping down the ladder. The third one is found by returning to the cleaver trap room, waiting for the second-to-last cleaver to fall and then standing on top of it. It will bring you up where you can jump onto a tunnel entrance. Follow this path past the statues and the glovewort will be in a small alcove on the right. The final one is found by dropping down the hole in the alcove where the third glovewort was found to a sewer section where the boss door's lever can also be found.
Black Knife Assassin: Miniboss of the Black Knife Catacombs. Drops Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
Assassin's Cerulean Dagger: Dropped by the Black Knife Assassin found inside Black Knife Catacombs.
Black Knifeprint: Black Knifeprint is a Key Item needed to advance in Sorcerer Rogier's questline. Dropped by Black Knife Assassin upon defeat.
Rune Arc: Consumable Item. Found on a corpse on the lowest area of the catacombs, where two giant crabs spawn.
Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade boss of the Black Knife Catacombs
Deathroot: Can be found inside a chest behind the Cemetery Shade in the Black Knife Catacombs .

title: Great Mace
text: Go inside and activate the Black Knife Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [2] next to the boss door room.
Unlock the imp seal to pick up the Rosus' Axe.
Grab the Grave Glovewort [2] in front of some rubble before the cleaver room.
Loot Spellproof Dried Liver from a corpse in front of a cleaver, then ride the cleaver up to a ledge with a Grave Glovewort [4].
Continue to a dead end and pick up the Grave Glovewort [3] in front of a hole, but don't drop down yet.
Hit the illusory wall at the end to reveal a corridor with a Grave Glovewort [4] and a boss.
Kill the Black Knife Assassin for Assassin's Cerulean Dagger, Black Knifeprint, and 4,200 runes. D, Hunter of the Dead's summon sign can be found at the entrance.
D, Hunter of the Dead's summon sign can be found at the entrance.
Drop down the earlier hole, pull the boss lever behind you, then pick up the Ghost Glovewort [3].
Pull the second lever and loot the 2x Grave Glovewort [2], Grave Glovewort [3] and Rune Arc in the room.
Climb the ladder in the room to a Grave Glovewort [3] in front of a coffin.
Kill the Cemetery Shade for Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes and 3,500 runes.
Open the chest at the end to obtain a Deathroot.
Travel to the East Raya Lucaria Gate and head up the slope east-northeast of the grace to reach a campsite with Slumbering Egg x2.
Ride down the ruin below the cliff, then head north-northeast to find a chair with a Rune Arc.
At the cliff northwest of the chair, you'll find another Rune Arc.
Enter the camp and pick up the Cuckoo Glintstone x3 next to a spiked barricade near the left-side catapult.
Great Mace: Can be found inside a chest, in the bandit camp.

place.title: Black Knife Catacombs
walk: The Black Knife Catacombs features many skeleton enemies and multiple moving guillotines throughout its chambers. The sewers are infested by crabs, with 2 giant crabs waiting for unsuspecting prey. This catacombs even has 2 bosses found in different rooms and with different loot, the Black Knife Assassin fight is not necessary for the player to advance through to find the lever that opens the doors to the Cemetery Shade fight.

Many of the skeletons that are found in this Catacombs exhibit a strange behavior of rolling at the player, and attack quite rapidly. Players should be careful when fighting these enemies as they can be very fast to close the gap and attack. Some of the skeletons are also special in that they cannot be killed by themselves, instead, one has to defeat the nearby necromancer which kills the skeletons automatically and permanently (until you rest or die). Going down the stairs from the Site of Grace there will be one such skeleton half way down. You can watch how this skeleton moves and attacks to learn what to expect from them later on, move back up the stairs to make the fight more manageable.

Once at the bottom of the stairs you will find the locked doors of the catacombs, flanked by 2 statues. These doors will open when you use the lever found at the end of the catacombs, the doors lead to the final boss fight of the catacombs. On the left is the way forward down a short flight of stairs. At the bottom of these stairs are 2 more skeletons, one at the crossroad and one further down the tunnel who will start rolling towards you rapidly once they spot you. Again, moving up the staircase can help with the fight to bring them into a wider fighting area or help with kiting them.

The first left on this tunnel is the room sealed by an imp statue, use a Stonesword Key here to open the room. Inside you will find 2 skeleton enemies on the left side, on the body leaning against the tombstone in the room you will find the Rosus' Axe.

Heading forward will bring you to the room with multiple guillotines, as well as 2 skeleton archers. Running past this area will lead you to a corner room with another rolling skeleton and a ladder to go down to the sewer level. In the sewer level there are many small crabs that are non-hostile, they will drop crab eggs when killed. From here you can also see the lever below the lit statue kept behind the rusted bars, the way to get behind the bars is elsewhere. Going forward will trigger the Giant Crabs to rise up from the ground, one in front but also one behind the player. A Rune Arc is found at the end of the sewer area.

To advance in this Catacombs, the player has to go to the room with the multiple guillotines and then ride a guillotine blade upwards to land on the platform above. Kill the skeleton archers in the room to stop them interfering. In the tunnel connected to the platform above are 2 enemies in a small space, carefully dispatch them to proceed to a long and large room with many statues of Erdtree Burial Watchdogs and multiple enemies. Keep following the path and the wall at the end of the path will disappear when attacked, revealing the golden veil for the fight with the Black Knife Assassin. There is a Golden Summon Sign before the fight that will allow you to summon D, Hunter of the Dead to cooperate with you for this fight. There are certain conditions for the summon sign to appear: It seems you must be on this stage of Rogier's quest, have completed D's quest and then have spoken with D about Rogier's quest.

On the right side of the room with the vanishing wall is a small shaft behind a Grave Glovewort. Falling down this shaft will put the player at the lever to open the locked catacomb doors. There you will find the Ghost Glovewort as well as two skeleton enemies and the lever to open the rusted gate to lead you out.
BOSS BATTLE: Black Knife Assassin

For this fight, using the Golden Summon Sign and bringing D will greatly ease the fight by having another character tanking and being focused by the boss. The Black Knife Assassin boss is fast moving, dodging many attacks as they move. They have 2 distinct attacks that are easy to predict and dodge. When their arm glows red they will fire out a red projectile at the player, they also occasionally jump up high with a large jumping attack that is easily sidestepped. Defeat this boss to obtain the Assassin's Cerulean Dagger as well as the Black Knifeprint and 3150 Runes.
BOSS BATTLE: Cemetery Shade

The fight with the Cemetery Shade features multiple skeleton enemies that assist the boss. The fight can get very dangerous when surrounded by them and hit with the green projectile from the boss, binding the player in place. The Cemetery Shade boss also has short blinks that allow it to dodge attacks as it approaches the player to attack in melee. Position yourself around the pillars to use them to absorb the binding projectiles as these move quite fast and may be hard to dodge naturally. Defeating this boss will reward you with the Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes as well as 3500 Runes. There is a chest in the room with a Deathroot found inside.

title: Howl of Shabriri

Talk to Melina at the Grand Lift of Dectus grace.

Golden Rune [3]: Consumable Item. Looted off a corpse on the slopes leading to Frenzy-Flaming Tower in eastern Bellum Highway.
Continue up the slope to find a corpse with Burred Bolt x5 on a long slanted rock.
Howl of Shabriri: Incantation . Found in a chest on the second level of the Frenzy-Flaming Tower .

Gavel of Haima: Found in the chest at the top of the Converted Fringe Tower .

Golden Rune [4]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse near the center of the garden.

place.title: Ranni's Rise
walk: Ranni's Rise is found to the west of the Three Sisters sub-region. When first entering the area, you may come across Renna's Rise and Seluvis's Rise but these two are blocked by a magical seal, preventing entry. The only tower accessible initially is Ranni's Rise. Head into the tower and up to the first floor to find its Site of Grace. Look for a lift on this floor which will take you to the top of the tower where you will meet Ranni the Witch.

Ranni will ask for your servitude and will set you off on a quest to find the hidden treasure of Nokron. (If she refuses to give you the quest, try returning to the Roundtable Hold to speak to Rogier once more.) She asks that you speak to three other persons in her service: Blaidd, War Counselor Iji, and Preceptor Seluvis. These three NPCs will then appear on the first floor (in spectral form as their actual locations are elsewhere). A fog wall will surround Ranni's Rise, temporarily turning it into a safe zone. Speak to all three of the aforementioned NPCs. Iji will simply acknowledge that you are both now in service of the Lady, while Blaidd will ask you to meet him in Mistwood at the Siofra River Well. Seluvis will ask that you meet him at his tower in the south. Oblige and return upstairs to speak to Ranni, and she will tell you that she will go into a deep slumber. This will remove the fog wall. Lastly, head to Seluvis's Rise to acquire a task from him.
notes: Ranni's Rise is part of the Trio of locations aptly named as the Three Sisters, with connections towards Ranni the Witch. The other locations are Seluvis's Rise, where Preceptor Seluvis, an ally of Ranni, stays and Renna's Rise. Named after one of Ranni's alias they used. The Snow Witch Set is found on Renna's Rise, and it is speculated that it is the name of the Snow Crone Mentor that Ranni had.

Many of Ranni's loyal retainers, allies, and other characters related to her, like Blaidd, Preceptor Seluvis, and War Counselor Iji, make an appearance in the location, albeit spectrally. Considering this location, functionally the base of operations for Ranni, it only makes sense for her agents to show up here.

Ranni's Rise is the spot of many of the quest events relating to Ranni and the Age of Stars. Swearing fealty to Ranni happens here, for example. As you progress along Ranni's questline, you will most likely have to swing by Ranni's Rise multiple times to not only get the latest objectives on Ranni's plan but also explore the multitude of stories of her allies and their relationship to her. Some encounters with Blaidd, Preceptor Seluvis, and War Counselor Iji, especially on how they change both externally and internally as characters with the progression of Ranni's plan. As Ranni achieves her objectives with the help of the Tarnished, this will affect these three characters greatly, and Ranni's Rise is where you will be able to find out how much those effects really are. Conversely, it would also show the effects of Ranni's actions on her loyal retainers.

text: Duo Boss Fight at the end of the Abandoned Cave . Drops the Gold Scarab talisman upon defeat.

title: Boss: Putrid Avatar
text: Head inside and grab the Abandoned Cave grace.
Drop into the rot and backstep toward an Abductor Virgin. Just east of it is a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Continue to a ledge and jump toward the ground below to pick up Serpent Bow.
Pick up Fire Grease from an alcove in the tunnel.

place.title: Abandoned Cave
walk: ## Entry

The Abandoned Cave entrance is located on the eastern wall of the canyon in Caelid, slightly northwest of the Sellia Evergaol. It can be reached from the Smoldering Wall Grace by walking across the tree (could be Erdtree roots?) that spans the canyon.

When crossing the canyon on the tree, there is a protrusion which curves diagonally from left to right (relative to the player's direction, when crossing the canyon from west to east). Stick to the left side of the tree during the section where this protrusion moves to the right, as the right side is not walkable and will result in slipping off the tree and falling to death in the canyon (if this happens, the runes will then need to be retrieved from the tree, instead of from the safety of the cliffside).
## Main Dungeon Walkthrough

The dungeon starts with a one-way drop into a deep pool of scarlet rot. Proceeding left after the drop and past the geysers of rot, the player will reach a fork. On the right, past another geyser, is a dead end containing a Dragonwound Grease. The left leads to a dry tunnel, which slopes downward to the next room. The martyr effigy (to enable summoning) is located on the left at the bottom of this slope.

The next room contains, once again, a pool of scarlet rot below and a few geysers. After entering, an item is visible below; the Serpent Bow. To it's right, a Servant of Rot will be standing on some dry land, behind which is the path forward.
The tunnel leads down a few steps, then widens into a room with a Rat and another Servant of Rot. The tunnel then curves right into a small room with two rats and a Fire Grease on a corpse.

Continuing onward, the tunnel opens into a large room with a Giant Miranda Flower (scarlet variant) in the middle with a few shallow pools of scarlet rot on the right edge of the room. Approaching the center of the room causes smaller Miranda Flowers to pop up from the ground. To the left, there is a pile of broken Iron Virgins which can be climbed to reach a ledge with the Venomous Fang. On the opposite side of the room is another ledge with two Servant of Rot. Behind them is a short tunnel that leads to the boss.
## Boss: Cleanrot Knights
A pair of Cleanrot Knights (one of each variant) can be found in a large room containing mostly dry land, with a shallow pool of scarlet rot near the entrance.
Upon defeat, the Cleanrot Knight pair drop the Golden Scarab talisman and 7000 runes.
notes: Preserving Boluses alleviate build up of and cures scarlet rot
Neutralizing Boluses alleviate build up of and cures poison
The Cure Poison incantation alleviates build up of and cures poison
The Flame, Cleanse Me incantation alleviates build up of and cures both poison and scarlet rot
Avoid rolling through the pools of scarlet rot as this accumulates rot on the player's body, resulting in continued buildup for a short period even after moving out of the rot.

title: Cracked Pot
text: Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. One found at the end of a tree branch extending from the northwest cliffs behind the tree.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar
text: Field Boss. Drops Greenburst Crystal Tear and Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear upon defeat.

title: Imp Head, Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog
text: Grave Glovewort [3]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs : After descending the lift by the entrance, head into the western corridor and look behind the central support of the next room to find the first glovewort. The second one is found in the scarlet rot-flooded room east of the lift. The glovewort is to the right of the doorway. The last one can be found by returning to the lift, sending it up and then dropping into the opening below it. Go through the scarlet rot-flooded corridor and enter the small opening on the right. Continue through the next room and look for a ladder on the right. Climb the ladder and you can find the glovewort in the hallway above.

Grave Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs : The first one is found inside the eastern corridor, after descending the lift by the entrance. Go back to the lift and step on the plate to send it up and immediately jump off. Head into the opening and through the scarlot rot-flooded corridor. Look to the right for a narrow opening and follow it into a room where you can find the glovewort in the back.

Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs . After descending the lift, step on its pressure plate again to send it up and immediately jump off. Drop down into the opening and head into the scarlot rot-flooded corridor to find the glovewort, by the narrow opening on the right.
Imp Head: Helmet. Found inside Minor Erdtree Catacombs , held by a corpse laying over a sarcophagus.

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs : The first one is found in the back of the scarlet rot-flooded room, east of the lift. The second glovewort can be found by sending the lift up and dropping into the opening below. Head into the scarlot rot-flooded corridor and go through the narrow opening on the right. Continue on through the next room and climb up the ladder on the right. Follow the linear path and turn right to wind up on the upper balcony of the scarlot rot-flooded room. The glovewort is found by a pillar in the back on the left side.
Erdtree Burial Watchdog: Duo boss fight against a Watchdog wielding a Sword and another wielding a Scepter. Drops the Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes upon defeat.
Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes: Spirit Summon Ash. Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo bosses within the Minor Erdtree Catacombs .

title: Whirl, O Flame!
text: Enter it and grab the Minor Erdtree Catacombs grace.
Ride the lift down and take the west path to a room with a Grave Glovewort [3].
Pull the boss lever in the next room, then return to the lift to pick up a Grave Glovewort [4].
Send the lift up to reveal a room below it. Drop down to pick up Ghost Glovewort [4] and Grave Violet x3 from a corridor blanketed with rot.
Go up the stairs in the corridor to discover a room with a Grave Glovewort [4] and a Golden Rune [4].
Climb the ladder to a room with Imp Head (Wolf), picking up a Grave Glovewort [3] on the way.
Pick up Sacramental Bud x2 and a Grave Glovewort [5] from the ledge at the end.
Loot the Grave Glovewort [3], Aeonian Butterfly, and Grave Glovewort [5] in the room below.
Drop down below the lift again and kill the two Erdtree Burial Watchdogs for Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes and 7,400 runes.
Whirl, O Flame!: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab on the road between Rotview Balcony and Caelem Ruins next to the wagon.

place.title: Minor Erdtree Catacombs
walk: Imps make these catacombs their home, with many of them perched on the walls and the ceilings, awaiting passersby. Bring ranged attacks and spells or craft throwable Consumables to knock them off their perches and prevent unwanted surprises Press the target lock key frequently to easily find these mischievous creatures.

From the site of grace, head down the first corridor ahead and hit the Imp on the ceiling from afar. There is a lift leading down around the corner. From the lift, head down the western corridor and defeat the Imp in the corner. The room around the corner has a couple more Imps inside. There is a Grave Violet just before you enter the room and a Grave Glovewort (3) at the back of the room before the next room. In the next room, there is an imp hiding in the right side and one more clinging to the ceiling. After defeating them, pull the lever by the statue and then head back to the lift.

This time, head towards the east corridor and collect the Grave Glovewort (4) on the way. In the next room, hit one of the Imps in the upper level from the corridor and three Skeletal Slimes will drop in from the ceiling. There are several more slimes in the room behind the pillars and a couple more Imps in the upper level. Beware of the floor here which is oozing with water that inflicts rot. There is a Grave Glovewort (3) to the right by the entrance and an Aeonian Butterfly on the corpse in the center. There is another Grave Violet and a Grave Glovewort (5) in the back half of the room.

Head back to the lift once more and step on the switch then get off before it rises. The rest of the dungeon is found in a passageway underneath the lift. Drop down below and take out the Imp patrolling the area. The next room is filled with the same scarlet rot fluid and several slimes will drop down from the ceiling as you approach. You can take them out or just sprint past them. There is a narrow passage to the north with a set of stairs leading to a room with a bunch of crabs. Take them out and pick up the Grave Glovewort (4) and Golden Rune (4) by the wall at the end. On the east side of this room is a ladder leading up to a long hallway. At the top of the ladder there will be an Imp around the corner to your left, and an Imp ahead of you. Take the Imps out and pick up the Grave Glovewort (3) on the way. There is another Imp on the ceiling halfway through the hallway and one more in the room at the very end. Pick up the Imp Head (Wolf) helm from the corpse bent over the sarcophagus and then turn right toward another room. This is the upper level of the first room with the scarlet rot fluid. Take the Imps out on the balcony if you haven't done so earlier. Check the corpse ahead for 2x Sacramental Buds and head to the left for another Grave Glovewort (5).
From here, you can head back to the second scarlet rot fluid-drenched room and continue to the western corridor and turn left to find the dungeon's boss door.
## Boss: Erdtree Burial Watchdog Duo (Scepter & Sword)

This boss fight is a Duo battle against two Erdtree Burial Watchdogs. One has a Sword, similar to the one encountered in Stormfoot Catacombs while the other has a Watchdog's Staff. It is recommended you focus on the Staff one as it uses ranged magical projectiles. Consider using a Spirit summon to distract one Watchdog while you focus on the other, or Crystal Darts to make them fight each other. Aside from that, the strategies are largely the same as previous encounters. Always be on the move. If you are running, their aerial slam attacks should not hit you. Weave in 1 or 2 attacks max between slams and other weapon attacks. Watch out for when a Watchdog stands on its hind legs. It will slowly walk towards you and slam its weapon down very quickly. Be ready to dodge sideways.
Defeating the duo awards the Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes.
notes: Note that phantoms in your world can pull the lever in this dungeon. If they do, the host will not be able to interact with it. Resetting your game seems to fix this.

title: Greatsword

Near the cellar entrance, next to a fire, you can find a corpse with Great Dragonfly Head x3.

In a window northeast of the middle corpse is a Golden Rune [5].
Unlock the imp seal and loot the Sword of St. Trina from the chest in the cellar.

Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside Gael Tunnel , in the back of the water-logged cavern crawling with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus hanging from the ceiling.

Somber Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. One can be found inside Gael Tunnel . From the entrance, go to the left of the wooden platform and drop down on to the ledge below. Drop down onto the second ledge ahead and enter the small tunnel to find the stone.
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab.
Cross-Naginata: Spear. Found on a corpse inside the Gael Tunnel , in the cavern filled with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus.
Magma Wyrm: Found inside Gael Tunnel . Drops x1 Dragon Heart and Moonveil
Moonveil: Katana. Dropped by Magma Wyrm inside Gael Tunnel .

place.title: Gael Tunnel
walk: If you have entered from Limgrave (not Caelid), there doesn't seem to be a way to open the wooden door from this side. If you have freed Alexander and not gone extremely deep into Caelid, he should be here.

The Site of Grace for this dungeon is found in a very deep pit ahead of the entrance past two Radahn Soldiers. There is no lift to take you down so you will need to do some platforming along the edges of the pit. There is a small room next to the second ledge you drop down to on the left. There is a corpse here with a Somber Smithing Stone [2]. From the Site of Grace, head north through the tunnel archway to a large cavern with wooden walkways. Kill the Radahn Soldier on the right then head down the steps and clear the Miners and Radahn Soldiers on this floor. There is a corpse on the left with a Golden Rune [5].

Head down the steps for more Miners and Radahn Soldiers congregating by the fire and a few more under the walkway. There is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot behind some crates in the very back below the walkway. Look to the east for a tunnel leading to another cavern crawling with Land Octopi and a single Giant Land Octopus hanging from the ceiling in the back. There is a corpse below where the giant octopus was hanging from that contains a Cross-Naginata weapon.

Head back into the main cavern and go west to find a soldier kneeling by a ladder. Take him out and then descend the ladder to find another Radahn Soldier and a Miner. Loot the corpse in the center for 5x Large Glintstone Scraps and the other corpse nearby for a Grace Mimic. Continue along to the tunnel in the south to a room with a large wooden gate to the right which contains the boss arena, as well as a smaller wooden door straight ahead. Go through the small door first which leads to the rear entrance of the tunnel as well as a second Site of Grace which you should activate. Head back to the large gate to challenge the boss of this dungeon.
## Boss: Magma Wyrm

This boss is highly susceptible to magic damage. Use sorcery spells that hit multiple times such as Glintblade Phalanx or Greatblade Phalanx to quickly break its poise and get a critical hit in. Sorcery mains can very easily lock this boss down. If you aren't sorcery focused, however, you will need to watch out for its mad dash attack where it spews lava from its mouth and then dashes around the room, leaving lava trails along the ground that persist for a few seconds. It is also equipped with a very large curved greatsword which it uses to slash in very wide arcs. However, its sword attacks are very slow with a very long wind-up. Take advantage of these animations and get hits in when you can.
Upon defeat, the Magma Wyrm drops a Dragon Heart, the Moonveil katana, as well as 7,500 Runes.

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Found inside Gael Tunnel , at the rear entrance. After talking to him, he sets off to Redmane Castle

title: Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes

Activate the Gael Tunnel grace at the bottom.
Go down a set of stairs for a Golden Rune [5] on a wooden platform.
Loot the 3x Smithing Stone [4] and Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot around the room with the wooden platform.
Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on a dead body sitting on a chair.
Go down the other path for Large Glintstone Scrap x5, Grace Mimic x5, and a Smithing Stone [4] on the wall.
Continue to the boss and pick up the Smithing Stone [4] on the left wall.
Open the shortcut door and talk to Alexander if you didn't earlier. Behind him is a Smithing Stone [4] you might've grabbed already.
Kill the Magma Wyrm for Dragon Heart, Moonveil, and 7,500 runes.
Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes: Ash of War. Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab near the North Fort Gael Site of Grace

title: Starscourge Heirloom, Katar +1
text: Grab the Fort Gael North grace below a ledge in the area with the scarab.
Explosive Greatbolt: Ammunition. Looted from a corpse in the middle of a battlefield in Mt. Gelmir .
Starscourge Heirloom: Looted from a chest in Fort Gael . It's outside the watchtower on the upper-section of the fort, under a canopy tent.

Rune Arc: Consumable. Looted off a corpse next to the locked gate of Fort Gael .

title: Flame, Grant me Strength

Hit the railing at the top of the staircase, then jump to the wooden platform below to grab the gate lever and a corpse with Mushroom x10 down the outer platform.
Drop down to the ledge inside the fort to reach a room with the Katar.
Rune Arc: Consumable. Found in a chest inside the Gaol Cave , next to the Site of Grace.
Flame, Grant me Strength: Found behind Fort Gael , on a body between two Maneuverable Flamethrowers

title: Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist
text: From the fire, head north-northeast down a root in the cliff, then go straight northeast down a slope to find a Somber Smithing Stone [4].
Travel to Smoldering Wall and head southwest toward a campsite with Slumbering Egg x2.
Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist: Ash of War Upgrade. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab near the Caelid Highway.

title: Talk to Wandering Merchant Caelid Highway North
text: Grab the Astray from Caelid Highway North grace on the hillside with the scarab, near a sword monument.
Wandering Merchant Caelid Highway North: Nomadic Merchant. General Goods vendor found sitting by a campfire east of the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace.

title: Pillory Shield, Wakizashi +3
text: Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. 1x Found as a treasure inside a chest in a cell within Gaol Cave.
Pillory Shield: Small Shield. Found inside Gaol Cave .
Wakizashi: Dagger. Found within Gaol Cave
Stonesword Key: Found within the Gaol Cave , near Wakizashi .
Frenzied Duelist: Boss of Gaol Cave in Caelid. Drops Putrid Corpse Ashes .

Regalia of Eochaid: Straight Sword. Accessed by dropping down to this area after progressing through Gaol Cave

title: Meteoric Ore Blade
text: Unlock the imp seal, then grab the Gaol Cave grace and open the chest for a Rune Arc.
Pick up a Golden Rune [2] from the first room.
Continue until the floor collapses, then proceed the only way forward until you find a Golden Rune [4] and Turtle Neck Meat x2 guarded by rats.
In the guard room at the end, you'll find a Golden Rune [5], Somber Smithing Stone [5], shortcut door, and a lever that unlocks all jail cells.
After unlocking all cells, loot the Old Fang x5 and Pillory Shield from a cell next to the shortcut door.
Enter the northeast room and pick up a Golden Rune [2] from the northwest cell.
Drop down the southwest ledge, then grab the Golden Rune [2] in a cell immediately on the right.
Loot the Wakizashi, Stonesword Key, and Golden Rune [4] from a cell on the left.
Enter one of the open cells in the room downhill to pick up a Rainbow Stone and Golden Rune [4].
Hit the planks in the room, drop to the bottom, and kill the Frenzied Duelist for Putrid Corpse Ashes and 6,700 runes.
Go through the tunnel past the boss to pick up the Regalia of Eochaid, then turn south for Glowstone x3.
Poisonbloom: Crafting Material. 4x found on a corpse sitting at the end of the cliffs.

Meteoric Ore Blade: Katana. Found inside a chest in a small room at the back of an underground hall filled with sarcophagi and Prawn Miners enemies. The entrance is found in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins .

place.title: Gaol Cave
walk: Quick walkthrough:
Proceed through the cave until you come to a lever. Pulling the lever will unlock the cells throughout the cave.
Proceed further in, and you will come to a hidden area (behind breakable wooden boards). The boss is at the bottom of a pit behind these boards.
After defeating the boss, DO NOT take the shortcut right away; instead proceed through the tunnel opening on the South-West side of the boss arena to obtain the Regalia of Eochaid sword.

title: Larval Tear
text: Pick up Great Dragonfly Head x5 from a corpse guarded by dogs in one of the ruined buildings.
Next to the dead tree in the middle is a corpse with Rot Grease x3.
At the end of the cliff, south of the tree, sits a corpse with Poisonbloom x4.
Enter the cellar in the lower part of the ruins to grab the Meteoric Ore Blade.
Return to the road and follow it until you notice the Caelid Highway South grace behind a root on the right.
Starlight Shards: Can be found at the southwestern area of Caelid, near the monument that looks like a broken cup.
Golden Rune [2]: Found at the sarcophagi located at South-West Caelid .
Golden Rune [5]: Found at the sarcophagi located at South-West Caelid .
Larval Tear: Larval Tear dropped by a Troll disguised as a regular enemy.

title: Boss: Decaying Ekzykes

Dragon Heart: Dropped by Decaying Ekzykes in South Caelid . Dragon Hearts are used to acquire Dragon Communion Incantations at the Church of Dragon Communion and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion .

title: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3]
text: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [3]: Cookbook item found at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion . Looted off a corpse tucked under the dragon's chest.

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird

Activate the Cathedral of Dragon Communion grace inside the church, then pass time until nightfall.

Death's Poker: Greatsword. Dropped by miniboss Death Rite Bird that appears only at night.

place.title: Cathedral of Dragon Communion

Some players may experience a bug preventing them the use of the altar. If that is the case, you only need to rest in the site of Grace just near the altar, pass time and then go back. Do not fight the knight spawning in the entrance, it seems the altar only works if you haven't performed other action before.

title: Windy Crystal Tear

title: Arrow's Sting Talisman

Beast Blood: Can be found on a dead body guarded by a Lion Guardian .
Loot the two corpses around the lion for Beast Blood x2 and Beast Blood x3.
Return to the road and follow it downhill to a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x3 in the middle of a battlefield.

title: Ash of War: Cragblade

title: Miranda Sprout Ashes, Boss: Cemetery Shade

Pick up a Grave Glovewort [4] in the first corridor, then a Grave Glovewort [3] in the corner past it.

Kill the Cemetery Shade for Kindred of Rot Ashes and 6,800 runes.

place.title: Caelid Catacombs
walk: The catacombs are very straightforward, without any forks. All you'll need is some way to deal with Scarlet Rot and perhaps some fire or frostbite damage to deal with the Rotten Giant Miranda Sprout.
Two secret areas hidden by walls to be on the lookout for:

After descending the staircase that leads onto a swamp, turn to the right, go under the platform where the Archer Skeleton was, and hit the wall on the right corner. There is a Miranda flower enemy there, as well as the Miranda Sprout Ashes and 2x Grave Glovewort [5].
At the end of the dungeon, there will be a locked door. Once you see it, turn 180 and then attack the wall on the column in the middle of the previous room to reveal a switch.

Heading down the stairs away from the Site of Grace, follow the hallway right into a small room covered in Scarlet Rot. Before you enter, be sure to grab the Grave Violet on the left of the hallway. Once you do actually enter, (3) ">Miranda Sprouts will spawn. Take them out while avoiding the buildup of Rot on yourself. Be sure NOT to roll in the sludge on the ground as it will cause the Rot-meter to continue rising, even after leaving the liquid. Sticking to the dry patches on the sides of this room will allow for easier traversal. Here to loot, there is a Grave Glovewort [4], some Root Resin, and whatever drops may come from the killed Sprouts.

Once ready, continue northeast into the hallway. Take caution when approaching the next turn left, as a Heavy Skeletal Swordsman is waiting around the corner to ambush you. Kill it and dispense with its remains before grabbing the Grave Glovewort [3] in the corner here. Head northwest down the stairs and loot the Grave Violet on the left side of the corridor. In this next room, you are faced with a bit of a conundrum. On the platform the hallway lets you out on, a Skeletal Archer will spawn, but only after you go further down the stairs to the left and enter the swampy area below. Doing this however will also trigger the Giant Miranda Sprout that is waiting for you around the corner to the right. My best advice is to watch the platform while going down the stairs until you see the Skeleton forming, then rushing back up the stairs to deal with it. With any luck, this will then cause the Sprout to come around the corner, allowing you to more safely fight it from the stairs without incurring the Scarlet Rot penalty.

As you have probably seen, there is a Grave Glovewort [3] to loot at the bottom of the stairs. Before continuing on, there is a Illusory Wall here found under the platform the Archer was standing on. Turning directly around from the looted Glovewort, keep left of the stairs on the ground floor until you come to the last section of the wall on the right. Hit it in some way to reveal its illusory nature as well as hopefully injure the Miranda Sprout hiding on the other side. Be careful as exploring this small area will cause 3 more Miranda Sprouts to spawn. Within the hidden area, you are able to find 2x Grave Glovewort [5] and the Miranda Sprout Ashes. At this point, one may want to take a small break on the stairs to allow their Scarlet Rot meter to deplete. When ready to continue, head northeast from the bottom of the stairs to the hallway, being sure to grab the Ghost Glovewort [3] and Ghost Glovewort [4] to the right of the hall's entrance.
The Ghost Glovewort [3] and Ghost Glovewort [4] can be found behind the Giant Miranda Sprout, lure it away or kill it and grab them.

Follow the hall northeast and loot the Grave Glovewort [4] within the sludge of the next room next to the central pillar. Keeping to the right, make your way around the central column while being sure to avoid the Scarlet Rot trap that can be triggered by stepping on the rotten debris. In the eastern corner, you can find another Grave Glovewort [4]. Going into the next hall, still heading northeast, you should see a locked door. Turn immediately around and attack the wall of the central column in the previous room that you are now facing. This should reveal a lever which you can pull to open the locked door. This door leads directly into the final boss of this mini-dungeon. The room directly preceding the now-open door contains Root Resin to pick up.

Your final boss through the fog gates is the Cemetery Shade, which can be back stabbed and when cleared gives you Kindred of Rot Ashes. This fight can be challenging as the Shade's ranged attack can paralyze you, leaving you open to its stunlock combo. Summoning of Spirit Ashes is highly encouraged, as the shade is truly only strong against one target at a time.
