title: Nox Flowing Hammer
text: Nox Flowing Hammer: From the Night Sacred Ground Site of Grace in Nokron, go up the stairs to your right. You should find yourself in a room with a Nox Monk and a Silver Tear Ball. Slay these enemies, then ascend a ladder to the back right of the room. Go down the path to the right of the Altar to where you see a Gargoyle Fog Wall. Turn right about halfway down the hallway and you should see a Roof Path out a window with a single Tear Slime. Head to the shingled section of the roof to find a single, unbarred window. Jump through that window to find the Nox Flowing Hammer.

title: Fingerslayer Blade
text: Kill the boulder below to obtain a Larval Tear (first time).
Exit the building and grab the Night's Sacred Ground grace at the cliff.
Celestial Dew: Key Item. Found on a corpse by the side of the road in Night's Sacred Ground
Fingerslayer Blade: Quest Item. Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground
Great Ghost Glovewort: Quest Item. Found in a chest under the massive skeleton statue in Night's Sacred Ground .

title: Ash of War: Enchanted Shot
text: Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse near the cliffs in Nokron, Eternal City .
Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found on one of the corpses at the base of the waterfall by the water's edge in Siofra River .
Light the brazier behind the spire (3/6).
Ash of War: Enchanted Shot: Dropped by a Teardrop Beetle hiding behind a rock near a brazier in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Ancestral Infant's Head
text: Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Ancestral Infant's Head: Key Item. Found in a chest in a submerged ruin in Nokron, Eternal City . Guarded by an Ancestral Follower .

title: Clarifying Horn Charm +1
text: Return to Ancestral Woods and head north-northeast to a small ritual grounds. Pick up Old Fang x4 from a corpse next to the staircase.
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Upgrade Material. Located near one of the Hallowhorn Grounds Altars in Nokron, Eternal City . It can be picked up from the grassy area just at the side of the ruined path.
Light the brazier behind the deer-like carcass (5/6).
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Upgrade Material. Located near the Regal Ancestor Spirit Boss from Hallowhorn Grounds in Nokron, Eternal City .
Next to a pillar down the stairs that lead to the Hallowhorn Grounds, you'll find a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x5.
East of the staircase lies a campsite with Kukri x8.
From the campsite, follow the cliff edge to the final brazier and light it (6/6).
Smithing Stone [5]: Found on a corpse on the ruined supporting structures of Nokron, Eternal City . It is located a level below the phantom in the bridge ruin.
Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting against a column ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Smithing Stone [2]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse slumped under a tree in Siofra River
Celestial Dew: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the corner at the very bottom of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .
Clarifying Horn Charm +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse in the middle and at the lowest floor of a ruin in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Boss: Regal Ancestor Spirit
text: Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting by the edge of the water flowing down the Siofra Aqueduct .

Regal Ancestor Spirit: Found behind a mist door in a special area. This area can only be accessed by touching the horned remains in the Hallowhorn Grounds in Nokron, Eternal City after lighting up all the obelisks.
Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor: Dropped by the Regal Ancestor Spirit upon defeat.

title: Mottled Necklace +1
text: Return to the fifth brazier (at the small ritual grounds). Just north of it is a corpse with Hefty Beast Bone x3.
Mottled Necklace +1: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on top of some ruined arches in Nokron, Eternal City .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head toward the jellyfish north of the stone beams and pick up the Old Fang next to them.

Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse laying by a ledge overlooking the ruined temple in Nokron, Eternal City with the deer carcass. This ledge is a level lower than the cliff with the spirit jellyfish.

title: Crucible Hornshield
text: Head down the ledge to grab Silver Tear Husk x2 and the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace.
Crucible Hornshield: Shield. Dropped by the Lesser Crucible Knight patrolling the bridges of the Siofra Aqueduct .

title: Missionary's Cookbook
text: Missionary's Cookbook: Cookbook Item. Found on a corpse in a circular section of the Siofra Aqueduct .

title: Order Healing
text: Order Healing: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found in the middle of a circular section of the Siofra Aqueduct .

title: Boss: Valiant Gargoyle
text: Golden Rune [13]: Found at the end of the fractured bridge.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the spear-wielding Lesser Crucible Knight in Siofra Aqueduct .
Pick up a Golden Rune [6] in front of the waterfall farther in, then the Smithing Stone [4] in the room below it.
Enter the west room to pick up a Rune Arc.
Talk to D, Beholder of Death and give him the Twinned Set to learn the Inner Order gesture; you can still get it even if you don't have the set.
Valiant Gargoyle: Dual Bossfight. Found by heading down to the lowest level of the Siofra Aqueduct . Spawns alongside the Valiant Gargoyle when it reaches half health.
Gargoyle's Twinblade: Dropped by Vailant Gargoyle (Twinblade) when both bosses are defeated
Gargoyle's Greatsword: Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle when both bosses are defeated

title: Boss: Valiant Gargoyle
text: Dual Bossfight. Found by heading down to the lowest level of the Siofra Aqueduct . Approaching the waterfall causes it to jump down from the ceiling.

title: Talk to Wandering Merchant Siofra River
text: D, Beholder of Death's summon sign can be found at the top of the stairs if you gave him the Twinned Set.
Activate the Great Waterfall Basin grace on dry ground near the waterfall.

Wandering Merchant Siofra River: Wandering Merchant. General Goods vendor found playing music by an unlit campfire in the ruins of Siofra River . The doorway to this area is high up and only accessible by climbing up and around the nearby wooden scaffolding.

title: Talk to Jar Bairn
text: Travel to the Artist's Shack in Liurnia and follow the southeast cliff edge until you see Alexander. Throw an Oil Pot at him and help him out to receive the Triumphant Delight gesture (if not obtained). Talk to him afterward to receive Exalted Flesh x3.
Descend the gravestones in the cliff near Alexander. Once you reach the lowest gravestone, jump to a roof to pick up Smithing Stone [3] x3.
Drop down and grab the Jarburg grace next to a house.
South of the grace lies a cemetery with Golden Rune [1], 2x Golden Rune [2], 2x Golden Rune [3], and a Golden Rune [6].
Jar Bairn: Jar Bairn can be found in Jarburg and will ask you to become Potentate, but deems your hands too rough.
miss: You must help him out before entering Mt. Gelmir or accepting Rya's invitation to Volcano Manor; doing either causes him to relocate there.

title: Talk to Diallos
text: NPC. If players have completed Volcano Manor, after progressing the Jarburg questline he will appear in one of the shacks, tending to a little jar.

title: Cracked Pot, Ritual Pot
text: Note: Don't attack any of the Living Jars in the village; it will anger him and cause him to disappear.
Talk to him and answer that you'll be the new Potentate.
Reload the area and talk to him about picking flowers in the village.
Reload the area and exhaust his dialogue about Alexander (after meeting Alexander).
Reload the area and talk to him about poachers (after speaking to Diallos in Roundtable Hold the second time).

Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. Three can be found in the village of Jarburg : The first is on a corpse in front of the blocked door of a hut north of where you drop down into the village. The second is in a hut northeast of the first. The last Cracked Pot is found on a large headstone in the south along the main road in the village.

Ritual Pot: Crafting Pot. Two can be found in the village of Jarburg : The first is found on a corpse on the roof of a hut in the north, use the cliffs to get on top of the hut and loot the corpse. The second can be found on top of a large decorative jar in the south. Use the boulders nearby or your horse to get on top of the jar.
Living Jar Shard: Crafting Material. Looted from a body inside one of the shacks in Jarburg.

title: Boss: Godskin Noble
text: Field boss guarding the bridge to the Divine Tower of Liurnia . Only accessible after progressing Ranni 's questline and acquiring the Carian Inverted Statue , allowing access to a secret area in Carian Study Hall leading to the bridge.

title: Ash of War: Through and Through
text: Travel to the Grand Lift of Dectus and hoist your medallion in front of the lift. After arriving, grab the Altus Plateau grace on a rocky ledge just north of the lift.
Talk to Melina at the Altus Plateau grace.
Talk to Rya at the Grand Lift of Dectus and accept her invitation to Volcano Manor. Note: If she's not there, you'll find her in the lower Lux Ruins instead.
Note: If she's not there, you'll find her in the lower Lux Ruins instead.
After arriving, grab the Volcano Manor grace for later. Ignore the manor for now to avoid canceling a step in Patches's questline.
Smoldering Butterfly: Material. Found in Gelmir Hero's Grave looted from a corpse near a ledge below a room with a Chariot passing by

Ash of War: Through and Through: Dropped by an invisible Teardrop Scarab . You will see glowing footprints appearing in a set pattern around the area. Stand in front of its path and attack as it approaches you to reveal the creature.

title: Golden Seed
text: Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. One can be found underneath a Phantom Tree.
Smoldering Butterfly: Material. Looted from a corpse sitting near some rocks in Mt. Gelmir , after the Fallingstar Beast

title: Map (Mt. Gelmir)
text: Golden Rune [3]: Looted from a corpse guarded by Fingercreeper in Mt. Gelmir .
On the left side of the slope, on a ledge, you'll find a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Map (Mt. Gelmir): Map of Mt. Gelmir region

title: Stonesword Key
text: Activate the Road of Iniquity grace just past the map stele; you'll start from it later when exploring Mt. Gelmir.
Travel to Roundtable Hold and talk to Corhyn to trigger him to leave.
Talk to Roderika and select "There's something you should know".
Talk to Dung Eater in a newly opened room in the north wing.
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found under a large burnt tree near the cliffs.

title: Ash of War: Shared Order
text: Golden Rune [4]: Consumable. Can be found on a corpse at Mt. Gelmir near the Minor Erdtree.
Ash of War: Shared Order: Dropped by the Night's Cavalry

title: Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: Boss roaming Mt. Gelmir. Drops Leaden Hardtear and Cerulean Hidden Tear

title: Ash of War: Earthshaker
text: Ash of War: Earthshaker: Ash of War. Found by defeating an invisible Teardrop Scarab in the intersection of the road before Altus Highway Junction site of grace.

title: Golden Seed
text: Grab the Altus Highway Junction grace on a ledge between the diverging paths.
Talk to Boc at the grace and select "I'm sorry...". Give him the golden needle, then select "I have a favor to ask" and "You may call me lord" to learn the My Lord gesture.
After giving Boc the needle and selecting "Surely she'd be happy for you?", talk to Melina at the Altus Highway Junction grace.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found right next to the road heading north from the Altus Highway Junction site of grace.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Found at the Altus Highway Junction site of grace

title: Map (Altus Plateau)
text: Follow the road uphill to find Corhyn next to a stele. Talk to him about the noble Goldmask.
Map (Altus Plateau): Can be found near the round, just north of the Altus Highway Junction site of grace

title: Talk to Brother Corhyn
text: Found at the side of the road after he leaves Roundtable Hold .

title: Talk to Nomadic Merchant West Altus Plateau
text: Continue along the road until you reach a bridge. Under a tent just southeast of it, you can find a corpse with a Lump of Flesh.
Nomadic Merchant West Altus Plateau: Found at the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

title: Talk to Finger Reader
text: Found at the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge.

title: Amber Starlight
text: Return to Altus Highway Junction and pick up Old Fang x3 from the stone platform just east-northeast of the grace.
Amber Starlight: Key item requested by Seluvis to progress his quest further.

title: Carian Inverted Statue
text: Give Seluvis the Amber Starlight, then talk to him to receive the Magic Scorpion Charm.
Carian Inverted Statue: Quest Item. Given by Ranni after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade .
miss: Must be done before giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade, which causes Seluvis's death.

title: Talk to Ranni the Witch
text: You can talk to Ranni at the very top of Ranni's Rise in the Three Sisters, northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

title: Talk to Sorceress Sellen
text: Found standing behind two illusory walls in a room. But she doesn't respond.

title: Seluvis's Bell Bearing, Preceptor's Set
text: Note: Completing this step will end Seluvis's questline. If you plan to give Seluvis's Potion to Dung Eater (which requires Seluvis to be alive), do it now or skip ahead to the West Altus section until you complete the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Reload the area, then activate the Ranni's Chamber grace in her room.
Seluvis's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Found on a body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.
Preceptor's Set: Armor Set. Found on a body in Seluvis's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

title: Pidia's Bell Bearing
text: Pidia's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Dropped by Pidia, Carian Servant in Caria Manor upon death.

title: Boss: Glintstone Dragon Adula
text: Great Enemy. Found roaming the sub-region of Three Sisters . The dragon cannot be killed here and will teleport to the Cathedral of Manus Celes in the very south of the region after being brought to about 50% HP.

title: Invader: Preceptor Miriam, Carian Glintstone Staff +2
text: Note: If you gave Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli, he'll drop the Nepheli Loux Puppet instead.
Speak to Iji and select "Talk".
Preceptor Miriam: Found at the hall middle way up the stairs.
Carian Glintstone Staff: Found at the Carian Study Hall.
Magic Downpour: Magic Downpour is a Sorcery dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the Carian Study Hall.
Golden Rune [4]: In a balcony on a dead body.
Cerulean Seed Talisman: Found at Carian Study Hall . look for it at the rafters, next to a body.

title: Lucidity, Mask of Confidence +2
text: Golden Rune [3]: Held by a corpse at inside the tower, west side.
Ascend the stairs and deal with Preceptor Miriam until she disappears.
Pick up the Carian Glintstone Staff from a shrine before the second lift.
Take the lift up and somehow kill Preceptor Miriam to obtain Magic Downpour.
Pick up a Golden Rune [4] from a corpse on the circular balcony.
Climb the ladder on the balcony and grab the Cerulean Seed Talisman from the top rafters.
Lucidity: Dropped by Preceptor Miriam in the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .
Mask of Confidence: Helm . Found on a corpse laying on the walls of the secret area of the Carian Study Hall unlocked using the Carian Inverted Statue .
Holyproof Dried Liver: On the sewers, past the Broken Statue , on the room below there are three items to grab, one of those is this one.
Godskin Noble Set: Armor Set comprised of the Godskin Noble Hood , Godskin Noble Robe , Godskin Noble Bracelets and the Godskin Noble Trousers . Dropped by Godskin Noble Boss .
Cursemark of Death: Key Item. Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .
Stargazer Heirloom: Talisman . Found on a body lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia .
Re-enter the study hall and kill Preceptor Miriam again to obtain Lucidity.
Pick up the Mask of Confidence from a ledge near the underside arch of a bridge.
Descend the chandeliers below to reach the rafters, then loot Holyproof Dried Liver x2 and Glintstone Firefly x8 from the bottom rafters.
Drop onto the lift in the middle and ride it to the bottom (er... top?), then go outside to discover the Liurnia Tower Bridge grace.
Kill the Godskin Noble on the bridge to obtain the Godskin Noble Set.
Enter the Divine Tower of Liurnia and ride the lift inside to grab the Divine Tower of Liurnia grace.
Loot the Cursemark of Death and Stargazer Heirloom from Ranni's corpse at the top.

place.title: Divine Tower of Liurnia
walk: The Godskin Noble fought at the bridge drops the entire Godskin Noble Set upon defeat. The tower itself is a fairly straightforward affair. Through the main doors, ascend the lift and then follow the path along the balconies, grabbing the Divine Tower Of Liurnia site of grace on the way. At the top of the tower, you can loot the Stargazer Heirloom talisman and Cursemark of Death key item from the corpse on the ground.

title: Elden Stars
text: Travel to Great Waterfall Basin grace and rest in the coffin below the waterfall. Grab the Great Waterfall Crest grace after arriving.
Kill the nearby Erdtree Avatar to obtain the Staff of the Avatar.
Grab the Ghost Glovewort [4] in front of a slope behind the avatar, then kill the scarab at the top for Ash of War: Golden Land.
Head toward the roots and climb onto the far-right one. Just above where it connects to the cliff, you'll find a Smithing Stone [6].
Follow the middle branch of the far-right root to a cave in the cliffside. Kill the large-bellied ant inside to receive a Numen's Rune and a Rune Arc.
Kill the four large-bellied ants below to receive 4x Numen's Rune and 4x Rune Arc.

Elden Stars: Head west from the Great Waterfall Crest grace until you reach some roots. From there look to the north-west to see a root going up to a cave and follow it. Enter the cave and fight through the packs of Giant Ant until the end and you'll find Elden Stars on a body facing the cave exit.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar
text: Can be found closeby to the west after just arriving in Deeproot Depths .

title: Map (Deeproot Depths)
text: Climb the branch of the root below, then pick up Holy Grease x3 at the bottom of the root.
Smithing Stone [4]: On a dead body where the Flying Giant Ants are.
From the base of the root, head south to find a Golden Rune [5] on a root extending past the cliff.
Warming Stone: Can be found on a dead body around the Giant Ants after crossing a root to the west.
Smithing Stone [4]: Over a couple of gravestones.
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Around the bushes.
Continue westward to discover the Deeproot Depths grace by the cliff.
Follow the water to a Gargoyle. On the path in front of him lies a corpse with Dragonwound Grease.
Hefty Beast Bone: X5 On the ruins surrounded by waterfalls.
Map (Deeproot Depths): Map for entire Deeproot Depths area. Can be found on a corpse in a gazebo amid the destroyed ruins

title: Talk to Palm Reader
text: After finding the "Deeproot Depths" Site of Grace, the Palm Reader can be seen at the edge of the cliff.

title: Ash of War: Vacuum Slice
text: Smithing Stone [6]: On a dead body in a ruined structure next to the waterfalls.
Ash of War: Vacuum Slice: Inside the ruined temple surrounded by waterfalls.

title: Prince of Death's Staff
text: Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found hidden in the bushes near a Teardrop Scarab in Deeproot Depths
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab behind the ruins
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Behind the ruins close to the underground walls.
Use the spiritspring near the waterfall to reach the Arteria Leaf x5 at the top of the building.
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade material. Found on the stairs near the whirlpool in Deeproot Depths
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Found near the wall close to the waterfall in Deeproot Depths
Climb the root northwest of the bush to pick up a Golden Rune [1] behind a Gargoyle.
Prince of Death's Staff: Climbing on the roots to reach up the towers, it's in one of them.

title: Boss: Crucible Knight Siluria
text: Smithing Stone [6]: Climb up the root to reach it.
Smithing Stone [5]: On the rooftop, jump from the root next to it. Deeproot Depths
Grab The Nameless Eternal City grace just south-southwest of the tower.
Human Bone Shard: X5 Over a couple of gravestones.
Clarifying Boluses: Over a couple of gravestones.
Golden Rune [9]: Over a couple of gravestones.
Golden Rune [8]: In a group of gravestones.
Ghost Glovewort [5]: Around some bushes to the northwest before going down the cliffs.
Nascent Butterfly: In the gravestones.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: At the very edge of the cliff.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Scavenged from a Corpse inside a building at Deeproot Depths .
Use the spiritspring next to the building while facing east to reach the Stonesword Key on top.
Crucible Knight Siluria: Guarding the entrance to the inside of the great Erdtree root.
Siluria's Tree: Dropped by Crucible Knight Siluria

title: Crucible Tree Set
text: Ghost Glovewort [7]: Found near Crucible Knight Siluria in the northwest corner of Deeproot Depths
Crucible Tree Set: The entire set can be found inside a chest guarded by the Crucible Knight Siluria .

title: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
text: Ghost Glovewort [6]: Upgrade Material. Found in the bushes near a corpse in Deeproot Depths

Follow the root on the right all the way to a Wandering Mausoleum. Jump onto it from the closest branch and destroy the skull formations around it until it collapses. Optionally, mark its location on your map.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab .�� Deeproot Depths
Mausoleum Soldier Ashes: Found at the far north cliff, by breaking a petrified tree.

title: Prince of Death's Cyst
text: Smithing Stone [5]: Scavenged on the ground in Deeproot Depths
Continue southwest and pick up a Golden Rune [8] at the end of a root stretching out into the depths.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Found in the ruin near the far north edge cliff.
The root on the right stretches into several branches. Follow the left branch first for a Golden Rune [8] past four Basilisks.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse. Deeproot Depths
Return to the two roots and follow the middle branch to another Golden Rune [8].
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the rooftop of the ruins. Deeproot Depths
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: In a room at the ruins.
Lightning Greatbolt: Ammunition . Found on a dead corpse near the waterfall in Deeproot Depths

Somber Smithing Stone [7]: In a small cave access from the side next to the Walking Mausoleum. Located on the small cliff right behind the rune bear that gives the Prince of Death's Cyst ��in Deeproot Depths
Travel to The Nameless Eternal City and head up the east-southeast root from earlier. This time, follow the same root to a Golden Rune [5].
Jump onto the thin root that stretches around the nearby tower to find Nascent Butterfly x3 on the top ledge of the tower.
Drop down the top end of the root to grab the Across the Roots grace.
Follow the root near the grace back around to loot a Golden Rune [8] from the corpse at the end.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Upgrade Material. It is found close to the sight where you have to jump off inside a hole and pick up Prince of Death's Cyst Talisman within Deeproot Depths
Descend the hole in the area to find a Somber Smithing Stone [7] on a ledge.
Prince of Death's Cyst: Dropped by a Runebear, fiound in a cave behind a waterfall

title: Boss: Fia's Champions
text: Ghost Glovewort [5]: Laying on the ground.

Fia's Champions: Multiple Bossfight. Fia's Champions , are a set of NPC invaders located past the "Across the Roots" Site of Grace. Sorcerer Rogier and Lionel the Lionhearted may fought here with Fia's Champions. This is also the location of Lichdragon Fortissax .
Fia's Mist: Obtained by defeating Fia's Champions in Deeproot Depths . After unlocking the Across the Roots Grace, head north and defeat the boss.

title: Boss: Lichdragon Fortissax
text: Activate the Prince of Death's Throne grace after the fight.
Speak to Fia and answer that you want to be held. Talk to her in secret twice, then give her the Cursemark of Death to receive the Radiant Baldachin's Blessing (no need to get rid of this one).

Lichdragon Fortissax: Multiple Bossfight. Massive four-winged black dragon with powerful lightning attack. Defeating it is required to finish Fia's questline and to unlock the " Age of Duskborn " ending. Fought alongside Fia's Champions , Sorcerer Rogier and Lionel the Lionhearted.
Mending Rune of the Death-Prince: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax
Remembrance of the Lichdragon: Rewarded after defeating Lichdragon Fortissax
miss: Missable if you kill Fia after defeating her champions. Fortissax is unreachable if you kill Fia.

title: Inseparable Sword
text: Loot the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince from Fia's corpse, then reload the area to pick up Fia's Set.
Inseparable Sword: Prince of Death's Throne, after giving D's brother D's Twinned Set
Collect all non-respawning crafting materials in Deeproot Depths.
miss: The Mending Rune is unobtainable if you kill Fia.

title: Talk to D's Twin Brother
text: He can next be found at Fia 's location in the Deeproot Depths if her questline has progressed far enough

title: Snow Witch Set
text: Snow Witch Set: Armor Set. Found in a chest on the upper floor of Renna's Rise after reaching the end of Ranni's questline.

title: Miniature Ranni
text: Miniature Ranni: Key Item. Found in an open stone coffin in the waters of Ainsel River Main .

title: Stonesword Key, Clayman Ashes
text: Rest at the Ainsel River Main grace, and talk to the miniature Ranni three times to get a response from her.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Dropped by the Malformed Star in Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Two found next to each other in the waters of northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Golden Rune [7]: Rune Consumable. Picked up from a Corpse in Uhl Palace Ruins , just before a small set of stairs
Human Bone Shard: Can be found nearby to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins
Next to an unlit brazier south-southwest of the staircase is a Smithing Stone [4].
Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found by the waterfall, next to a Giant Poison Flower in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .

Clayman Ashes: Located on a corpse in Ainsel River, Lake of Liurnia which is south from the Uhl Palace Ruins. Easiest way to reach these is ashes is while doing Ranni's questline (the portal you enter from Renna's Rise will take you near the ashes). After entering Ainsel River proceed south along the tunnel entering into the next main room with enemies, proceed southwest while hugging the edge until you can find some Clayman walking about, after disposing them look for the corpse near the corner of the area by the top of a waterfall.

title: Wing of Astel
text: Northwest of the waterfall, leaning against a ruined wall, you'll find a Golden Rune [7].
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found behind one of the two statues standing by the entrance of a ruin in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Found behind one of the two statues standing by the entrance of a ruin in northern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Found in a ruins in northern Uhl Palace Ruins with two large statues at the entrance.
Stimulating Boluses: Found on a corpse in the tunnel leading to Nokstella, Eternal City .
Golden Rune [10]: Found on a corpse in the tunnel leading to Nokstella, Eternal City near two Flying Ants.
Wing of Astel: Curved Sword . Found in a small chest at the top of the ruins in southern Uhl Palace Ruins . Inaccessible until entering from the Northern, higher level section.

title: Ant's Skull Plate
text: Somber Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in southern Uhl Palace Ruins .
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Found at the base of a dam in Ainsel River Main .
Go through the doorway and drop down to discover the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Talk to Ranni while resting at the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
Magic Grease: Consumable Item. Found in a corpse near the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace.
Ant's Skull Plate: Greatshield . Found in a chest in a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City .

title: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]
text: Pick up Fan Daggers from a corpse on the stair railing.
Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]: Key Item. Found in a chest at the corner of a small room in Nokstella, Eternal City ,

title: Archer Ashes
text: Archer Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse tucked behind a building in Nokstella, Eternal City .

title: Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets
text: Golden Rune [10]: Consumable Item. Found upstairs in Nokstella, Eternal City , on a body lying between two arches.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Found at Nokstella, Eternal City one of the window is open with a chest in it.

place.title: Unsightly Catacombs
walk: The Unsightly Catacombs is a small dungeon found beneath the Perfumer's Ruins in Altus Plateau. The entrance is located in the southwest of the cliff face below the ruins and is barred by an Imp Statue Seal, requiring 2 Stonesword Key to gain entry. These Catacombs are a good source of Grave Glovewort upgrade materials for strengthening your Spirit Ashes (provided you have progressed Roderika's questline).

A few steps from the entrance, you will find a Site of Grace to rest and modify your equipment. Be warned, this is the only Site of Grace for this dungeon and there is a fairly difficult boss fight at the end of the catacombs, with plenty of agile Misbegotten enemies along the way that can easily catch you with their very wide, very quick swings. Small pockets and corridors are lit but it is recommended you equip a Torch for the darker zones.

Head down the steps ahead of the Site of Grace to enter the first set of corridors of the dungeon. There is a Misbegotten laying here that you can ambush with ranged attacks before it can act. Straight ahead is a Summoning Pool just before the turn, should you wish to summon for help. The next hall contains two of the wingless, but larger Misbegotten carrying halberds and patrolling the left and right corridors. If you wait, you can sneak up behind them to perform a critical attack and get a decent amount of damage in. Do not be fooled by their large size and lumbering walk animation. These creatures are incredibly agile and like to perform wide swings and attacks with lots of travel. They can also very quickly roll towards you to close the distance. There is nothing special on this floor so you can head down the steps in the middle after either dispatching the Misbegotten or sneaking past them.

Down the next level, be careful of the Misbegotten hiding in the right corner. There is a Grave Violet near where it was sitting. Look for the path leading east. There is a Misbegotten and Winged Misbegotten at the end of this path. Go to where they were to pick up the Grave Glovewort [5] by the wall then look for the corridor heading south to find the stairs to the next level down. A Grave Glovewort [4] can be found in your path as well as a Winged Misbegotten at the end of the corridor. Note that this corridor leads to yet another lower level with a locked door at the end. That is your goal, but first look to the right of the last glovewort for a pit you can jump down to. If you are a ranged or magic user, you can safely target the misbegotten enemies from up here before jumping down. Otherwise, take them out carefully as you land below. There is a total of 4 Misbegotten in this pit that are lying down. When you get down, check the southern wall for a corpse containing the Winged Misbegotten Ashes so you can summon one of these agile warriors for yourself. A Ghost Glovewort [5] lies in the corner as well.

Look for the lit corridor and pick up the Grave Glovewort [4] along the way. At the bend is a set of steps leading up one level. There is a statue at the center here with a lever in front of it, used to unlock the door leading to the boss. Check the corridors around the statue for a Rune Arc and the Prattling Pate "Apologies" reusable item. If you look at the center of this level, you can jump down the middle to reach the pit connecting to the formerly locked door but before you do, look out for the Ogre now roaming the area. Consider using ranged attacks and spells to safely take it out from up here before jumping down.

When ready, proceed through the locked door and the fog gate behind it to challenge this dungeon's Boss Encounter: Perfumer Tricia. This fight is particularly difficult due to the fact that Tricia is accompanied by an extremely aggressive Misbegotten Warrior who has his own boss health bar. It is highly recommended that you bring along a strong and tanky Spirit Ash summon of at least +5 in order to distract the Misbegotten while you take Tricia out. See the Perfumer Tricia page for details on the fight. Defeating the boss duo awards you with Perfumer Tricia Ashes.

place.title: Sage's Cave
walk: Past the Site of Grace, make your way forward until you reach an apparent dead end. There is an illusory wall here.
Go past until you encounter a skeleton near a waterfall. Passing another illusory wall to the right, you will find two chests containing Lost Ashes of War and Rejuvenating Boluses x5.
Jump down this waterfall, then pick up two Golden Rune (5). To your left is an illusory wall with four skeletons and four chests behind it.
You can get Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot x5, Black Hood, Candletree Wooden Shield, and a Nascent Butterfly.
Four skeletons await you in the next room, among which is one with a large axe and more health. Another one faces a wall which is illusory, hiding a chest containing a Stonesword Key.

The next room holds three more chests with Golden Greatarrow x10, Raptor Talons, and Dragonwound Grease x4. Proceed until you are in an open cave with a waterfall, jump to the left, then hug the left wall and roll into the apparent dead end to uncover two more chests with Raptor's Black Feathers and Skeletal Mask.
Roll through the illusory wall on the opposite side of the room and get ready to fight Necromancer Garris who drops Family Heads.
Make your way back to the waterfall and stay left to face the other boss, the invisible Black Knife Assassin.

If you buy Sentry's Torch from the Hermit Merchant for 7000 Runes, you can put it in your off-hand to make her visible (even if you two-hand your main-hand weapon). One strategy is to fight her (without buying the item) is to simply stand on the patch of dirt, and watch for her footsteps in the water. You'll have to time your swing to hit her -- a weapon with a horizontal attack spread makes this easier.
After defeat, she drops the Concealing Veil.
notes: This location has several secret walls, the Host of Fingers can dispel them with a single attack, jumping or rolling.

place.title: Wyndham Catacombs
walk: Reached by travelling east from the Seethewater River Site of Grace.

Leaving the Wyndham Catacombs Site of Grace the only room at the top of the catacombs is the locked door with the 2 statues, locked by some contraption. Moving past this door is a room with an elevator, beware of the trap button between the rooms as this will fire a row of 3 lightning shots 3 times. The elevator is a simple platform with a button that players can step on to get the elevator to move. At the top and bottom of the elevator shaft are levers that will call the elevator to the player when needed.

Once at the bottom of the elevator shaft hit the button once more to have it rise then roll off onto the ledge above to collect the Grave Glovewort on the ledge above. The first room outside the elevator shaft has 2 imps throwing lightning bombs as well as a large guillotine trap cutting the room in half that raises and drops repeatedly. Past this room around the corner is a room with 2 imps, one on the far wall from where you enter as well as one directly on the right of the entrance. In both rooms, hitting an imp with multiple Crystal Darts will briefly stun them, before sending them into a berserk state. This berserk state will cause the imps to attack the closest target, including other imps, making it ideal for drawing out ambushes and weakening groups.

Following the path down the narrow stairs brings you into the large underground sewer area with watery ground and many Skeletal Slimes and Putrid Corpses. There is a lightning trap hidden in the water in the middle of the room, stepping on the trap will cause lightning to strike down around the trap, enemies do not trigger the trap but the trap rearms quickly so watch out and avoid the damage. Moving forward and around the bend players will find a Leyndell Knight defending the way forward.

At the top of the ladder watch out for the trap on the ground close to the ladder that will fire lightning bolts from behind. There is an imp statue sealing the room ahead and a path leading left, on the crossroad an Imp will attack you so be ready. The sealed room requires a Stonesword Key to open and holds the Lightning Scorpion Charm but otherwise has no enemies or other loot.

The next room in the Catacombs is the room with the spike ceiling and a raising floor platform. If the player is standing on the platform when it is raised to the top, the floor will raise rapidly to stab the player into the ceiling repeating until they are off the platform or dead. This room has 2 imps that throw lightning bombs, one ahead where the player can see is the way forward and one above the entrance. To get across without taking damage from the spikes, step on the platform to make it rise, then turn around and off into the alcove behind you before it reaches the ceiling, taking care not to get staggered by the waiting imp. Kill it and collect the Grave Violet, then quickly jump back on the platform while it's lowering back into place and run straight across to where the lighting pot throwing imp was standing. This gives the player more time to move across the room while the mechanism resets and raises again. In this final room is an imp directly on the right of the entrance holding a large sword, as well as another Leyndell Knight. The lever to open the locked doors are found here. Similar to getting across the first time, to get out, step on the platform to have it raise, jump back off immediately, then jump back on while it's resetting. Use this to reach the hallway you initially entered the room from. Trigger the floor one final time, this time immediately jumping off and waiting for it to rise above you. Jump down to the darkened sewer area below.

From this area a tunnel will lead you to the other side of the barred off area you initially saw while fighting the Putrid Corpses. You will see a body holding the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook (1), but exercise caution while collecting it, as approaching the body will prompt two Giant Crabs to emerge from below you. The rusted gate can only be opened via a lever to its right, so be prepared to fight the crabs or kite them down the tunnel so you can open gate and escape. Remember that there is a lightning trap hidden in the water where you fought the Putrid Corpses.
BOSS BATTLE: Erdtree Burial Watchdog

The boss for these catacombs can be found past the originally locked doors. This is a variant Erdtree Burial Watchdog that has a lightning tail with additional moves and can shoot lightning at the player. The Boss will charge lightning very visibly then fire it at the player giving the player time to move behind a pillar or prepare to time a dodge or block. While in their seated form the Watchdog will float up and towards the player before slamming their sword down, they will also now spin with their sword when close to the player to do damage. As always, Erdtree Burial Watchdogs are immune to all status, but weak to strike damage. You can also briefly stun it by hitting it with several Crystal Darts in a row, which will cause it to enter a berserk state. You can use this to force it to attack a durable Spirit Ash while you keep your distance, or to force it to attack you while a ranged Spirit Ash deals steady damage. This effect can be reapplied whenever it expires, for an easy boss fight.

title: Ash of War: Barrage
text: Head inside and activate the Wyndham Catacombs grace.
Take the lift down while facing west, then walk off to a ledge with a Grave Glovewort [5].

Descend the stairs to a sewage room with a Ghost Glovewort [6] and a Grave Glovewort [4].

Drop down beneath the floor as it's rising, then loot the Magic Grease x2, Golden Rune [5], and Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [1] guarded by Giant Crabs.

Return to the entrance, then make your way down the southwest cliff to grab the Seethewater River grace at the bottom.

place.title: Old Altus Tunnel
walk: These tunnels are located southwest of the Bridge of Iniquity in Altus Plateau. The location may be difficult to find due to the large amounts of similarly jagged, rocky hills in the area. The entrance is barred by an Imp Statue which requires 2 Stonesword Key to dispel the fog. The Old Altus Tunnels are a rich source of Cracked Crystals. There are countless amounts of these items found all over the walls and they respawn whenever you rest at a Site of Grace. Be sure to be on the lookout for these if you need them for crafting. Inside, you will predominantly encounter Miners and Zombie Dogs. There are also a couple of Soldiers guarding the workers.

From the entrance, check behind the wall on the right for a corpse with 3 Explosive Stone Clumps. Descend the lift to find the Site of Grace. Note that this is the only Site of Grace within these tunnels, but the dungeon isn't particularly long either. When ready, head down the first corridor to find a few barrels and a storage shed on the left. Beware the red barrels marked with a white stripe. These are explosive barrels and can be set off with fire damage. However, you can also use these to your advantage if you have any fire spells. Inside the shed is a Miner and Zombie Dog waiting behind the barrels. Look outside the shed and to the right for a Smithing Stone [5].

Continuing on, you will arrive in a large cave with lots of wooden walkways. Follow the closest one to the right and head up the ladder. This leads to a room with a second storage shed on the right and 2 miners chipping away at the crystals while a Soldier guards them. Take out the soldier first and two dogs should come rushing out of the shed. After defeating them, check the shed for a Boltdrake Talisman +1, which is an upgrade to the original talisman. Check around left side of the shed to obtain Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Outside the shed and to its right, you can find Stanching Boluses amongst the crates. In the small alcove right of where the miners were, there is another Smithing Stone [5] behind the barrels. Head back out to where you climbed the ladder and this time, drop down onto the storage shed below to get to the lower level.

Before jumping down, consider taking the enemies below out with ranged attacks from the roof of the storage shed you jumped on. There is a Soldier and two Gold Dragon Cult Knights here who are quite powerful and tanky but can be lured to your location one by one. (Make sure you're standing under the platform above when they jump down, so that they can't do a plunging attack). When you finally drop down, check the shed you were on top of for a Somber Smithing Stone [4]. There is another Smithing Stone [5] between in the small space between the shed and the east wall. The shed on the opposite side has a Troll's Hammer but watch out for the dogs inside. Behind this shed is another Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Check the alcove east of the sheds for yet another Smithing Stone [5]. You can climb up the long ladder here to get to a wooden walkway with two Miners. You will find another Smithing Stone [5] by the walls and a Golden Rune [6] on a corpse in this area. Get back down to the lower level and look for a tunnel in the north side which leads to a small room with a dog and a miner. Defeat them and check the crystals in the room for a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [5]

Finally, go back to the long ladder and head through the tunnel behind it to reach a fog gate that leads to the dungeon's boss: The Stonedigger Troll. This boss is quite simple and is easy to punish at range if you use your Spirit Summons to distract it. Watch out for its roar which can knock you down, allowing the troll to follow up with a devastating smash with its club. Upon defeat, the boss drops the Great Club hammer weapon and 9,600 Runes.

Take the lift down and grab the Old Altus Tunnel grace.

On the walls around the room, you can pick up a Smithing Stone [5] and a Somber Smithing Stone [6].

Somber Smithing Stone [4]: Upgrade Material. Found at the bottom of the main chamber, on a corpse inside the northern storage shed.
Pick up the 2x Smithing Stone [5] and Somber Smithing Stone [6] on the walls in the room.
Kill the Stonedigger Troll for Great Club and 9,600 runes.
Golden Rune [3]: Consumable. Can be found at the cemetery near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite site of grace in Mt. Gelmir .
Use the spiritspring east of the rock while facing northwest, then jump across the gap to the northwest ledge to find a Nascent Butterfly.
Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan: Non-Invader Hostile NPC. Found in the fields west of The Shaded Castle . Drops Antspur Rapier , Marais Mask and Marais Robe upon defeat.
Antspur Rapier: Thrusting Sword. Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan upon defeat.
Near a Golem at the end of the rocky area is a Smithing Stone [5].

Head around the outside of the castle rampart until you see a Golden Rune [3] guarded by four slugs in front of the castle.
In the poison farther east-southeast, you'll find a corpse with Poison Grease.
Climb the slanted rocks near the corpse to enter the castle, then pick up Poisonbloom x4 from the left end of the rampart.
Go up the stairs on the left to grab the Shaded Castle Ramparts grace.

Poisonbone Dart: Offensive Throwable. 5x found on a body in the middle of the poisoned area by the eastern rampart.
Champion's Song Painting: Champion's Song painting found in a small wooden structure on the side of the eastern walls.

title: Valkyrie's Prosthesis

Golden Rune [6] B: Rune Consumable. Found on a body sat in front of a series of tombstones in the inner courtyard.
Drawstring Fire Grease: Found on a body in the corner between some rubble and a sunken building.
Climb the rooftop west of the stone platform to reach a rampart with a Smithing Stone [5] at the end.
Beast Blood: Material. Looted from a corpse on the edge of the second room with a chariot and a lava pool in Gelmir Hero's Grave .
Ghost Glovewort [4]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on one of the rocks near the dead tree at the western end of the outer courtyard of The Shaded Castle .
Grab the Somber Smithing Stone [5] on the corpse near the Revenant.
Neutralizing Boluses: 2x found on a body on the western ramparts of The Shaded Castle .
At the opposite end of the rampart is a small enclosed area with a putrid Miranda Blossom. Grab the Smithing Stone [5] behind it.

Valkyrie's Prosthesis: Key Item. Found by climbing up the ladder in the central-western section of the courtyard that leads up to the top of the inner walls. Follow the walls northwest to find a room with a chest surrounded by statues and guarded by a single Cleanrot Knight .

title: Perfume Bottle
text: Head back along the rampart and drop down to the inner poison swamp. Next to the large tree is a Golden Rune [6].
Go up the stairs in the middle, then climb the ladder on the left to find a Golden Rune [4].
Activate the Shaded Castle Inner Gate grace just past the ladder.
Head back down the ladder and optionally kill the Revenant in the area up the stairs for a Ghost Glovewort [4] (first time).
Pick up Rot Grease x3 from the corpse near the Revenant.
In the wooden structure in the poison swamp, you'll find a Smithing Stone [4].
Climb the ladder in the poison and pick up a Smithing Stone [5] behind some crates at the left end of the rampart.

Perfume Bottle: Key Crafting Item. Found on a body hanging by the edge of the top part of the inner ramparts. You can reach this area by climbing a ladder in the eastern section of the inner courtyard and following the ramparts as it curves to the west.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Stonesword Key: Found on a body on a stone ledge, reached by traversing the rocks leading from the eastern wall all the way to the ledge. A set of slugs can be found underneath looking at the body.

title: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]
text: Perfumer's Cookbook [2]: Found on a corpse sitting on a chair on the roof of the northwestern building. You can reach this area by climbing a series of ladders in the Castellan's Hall building.

title: Boss: Elemer of the Briar
text: Hefty Beast Bone: Found on a body on the walkway up in the castle area, to the right when exiting the first room after the ladder up.

Gold Firefly: 2 Gold fireflies can be found on a body at the end of a room full of statues. There are 2 Page enemies within this room as well, 1 hidden behind the statues and one on top of the stairs.
Grab the Smithing Stone [5] outside the room, then kick the shortcut ladder next to a brazier.
Elemer of the Briar: Found inside The Shaded Castle . Drops Marais Executioner's Sword and Briar Greatshield
Briar Greatshield: Dropped by Elemer of the Briar inside the The Shaded Castle .

Return to Millicent and give her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Tell Gowry that you gave Millicent the prosthesis, then talk to him about Millicent.
Buy Pest Threads from Gowry, then talk to him about Malenia to learn the Desperate Prayer gesture.
Feed Gurranq the Deathroot to receive Beast Claw.
miss: The gesture is missed if not received before completing the final steps in Millicent's questline.

title: Perfume Bottle, Boss: Miranda the Blighted Bloom
text: Beast Blood: Crafting Material. Can be found on a corpse hanging from the upper part of the broken bridge in Mt. Gelmir .
Head up the slope east of the campsite to reach a mining field. In one of the pits lies Gravity Stone Fan x4.
Pick up Gravity Stone Chunk x2 from a pit farther northeast.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: Upgrade Material. Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast .
Smithing Stone [6] 5x: Dropped by Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast .

Perfume Bottle: Crafting Material. One bottle can be looted from a chest inside Perfumer's Grotto . In the second area after encountering the second Giant Poison Flower , turn back towards the corner to find two chests, one of which contains the bottle.
Arteria Leaf: Material. Found on a corpse at a dead end in Altus Tunnel
Miranda Powder: Once you are back inside, roll onto the blocked door, and loot this on your left. You will get x10 Miranda Powder.
Miranda the Blighted Bloom: Miranda the Blighted Bloom is encountered in a Duo Boss Fight with an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Grotto . Defeating them both awards the Great Omenkiller Cleaver .

place.title: Perfumer's Grotto
walk: Once you reach the entrance to the grotto, there will be a Site of Grace to take a rest. Continue through and once you reach a fork in the path where it drops down to the left, take the right tunnel so you wouldn't have to drop off to the left. This will take you to the same area. This is where you may encounter some perfumers and gain a chance to obtain some of the Perfumer Set, such as the Perfumer Hood, Perfumer Robe, Perfumer Gloves, Perfumer Sarong. There will also be a Giant Poison Flower in the vicinity.

Check for loot under the platform on which you entered, there is an Altus Bloom there. Proceed to the next room to the right to find more of the same, there are two chests containing Living Jar Shards and a Perfume Bottle. Proceed to find a Malformed Star. Defeat it and continue over the log path to obtain Arteria Leaves and continue across the branches. If you look down, there is an unreachable section of wooden platforms. This is part of the Altus Tunnel dungeon.
This area seen from the log crossing is accessible from the Altus Tunnel. Elden Ring Map Link

There are various items and two Poison Flowers before the boss. Be prepared to fight an Omenkiller and Miranda the Blighted Bloom simultaneously. There will also be another Giant Poison Flower in the arena.
notes: It makes sense to assume that this location is some sort of hideout for the poachers who attack Jarburg, hence the number of living jar shards the tarnished can find inside.

title: Boss: Omenkiller
text: An Omenkiller encountered in a Duo Boss Fight with Miranda the Blighted Bloom inside the Perfumer's Grotto . Defeating them both awards the Great Omenkiller Cleaver .

title: Sacred Tear
text: Head inside and activate the Perfumer's Grotto grace.
Pick up the Living Jar Shard x5 next to a Miranda Blossom in the first room.
Loot Perfume Bottle and Living Jar Shard x10 from the chests behind a branch in the second room.
Kill the Withered Astel ahead, then pick up the Arteria Leaf x3 on the root.
Golden Rune [5]: Found within Perfumer's Grotto in the area just outside the fog gates at the end of the tunnel.
Kill the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom for Great Omenkiller Cleaver and 8,400 runes.
Return to the Altus Highway Junction and head north-northwest toward an Omen camp. Pick up the Perfume Bottle under a tent.
Just west of the Omen camp, you'll find a campsite with Turtle Neck Meat.
Sacred Tear: Found inside Stormcaller Church

title: Talk to Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
text: Found at the Second Church of Marika.

title: Unseen Blade, Unseen Form
text: In the graveyard behind the church is a corpse with Human Bone Shard x6.
In the lower graveyard farther north is a corpse with Magic Grease.
Drop down the cliff east of the corpse and touch the blue phantom crest in the corner.

Touch the phantom crest east-northeast of the gravestone and examine the book next to it to receive the Mirage Riddle.
Below the ledge south-southeast of the book, you'll find a corpse with a Golden Rune [3].

place.title: Altus Tunnel
walk: Take the lift down to the tunnel. There will be a Site of Grace. Leaving the Site of Grace, the first room on the right is a small cavern with 2 enemies within, 1 Sorcerer Miner and 1 Avionette Soldier. The room being small as it is a large AOE attack such as using Cannon of Haima can quickly clear the space safely. The treasure chest within will reward you with a Rune Arc. Moving past this room and following the main tunnel the next space will have a Sorcerer sat on the left side of the room by some sacks. Defeating these enemies will give you a chance to loot a Large Glintstone Scrap. The room connected on the right has multiple Crystal Snail within as well as a body that will drop Crystal Dart with many Cracked Crystal stored further in the back.

After this first area, you will enter the next section of the tunnels. You will walk into the main part of the tunnels where miners are working away at the crystals found in the walls. This room has multiple and different kinds of enemies so take the fight slowly to not get surrounded and swarmed. The Avionettes move fast to attack the enemies while the Sorcerers stand afar and on the wooden platforms above the main floor of the tunnel. This room has multiple Smithing Stones for the player to collect both on the ground floor and on the wooden platforms. Notice the Crystals embedded into the rocks as these are also lootable. Loot them to obtain Smithing Stone (5).

As you exit this area, you will enter an open space. Arteria Leaf can be found on a body at the end of the wooden platforms. From this room there is a small tunnel leading to a stone ledge with a connecting wooden balcony area where a crystal snail sits next to a body that can be looted for a Golden Rune (7). If you look up, there will be a Malformed Star that can hurl rocks in your direction. It hangs over giant logs with some lootable items on it. You can choose to clear this enemy with your ranged attacks, but this area is more easily accessed from Perfumer's Grotto.
The image above shows the view of the Altus Tunnel wooden platforms where you are standing from the Perfumer's Grotto. Elden Ring Map Link

From this area, you can take the largest log up to the higher wooden platform to loot Arsenal Charm +1. Drop back down, move back into the tunnels and take through until you reach the large wooden doors.
The next room of the tunnel is the final room before the boss fight. Many dormant Crystal Snails can be found here before the two large wooden doors that lead to the final room of the tunnel.
## BOSS BATTLE: Crystalian Spear & Crystalian Ringblade

The two bosses are humanoid enemies made of crystal that are not much larger than the player, making the arena quite spacious. The fight can be made much more manageable by using Spirit Ashes to help draw the attention of the bosses as you work on dealing damage to the bosses. A good strategy is to single out and defeat them one at a time.

The Crystalians take reduced damage from all sources until their poise is broken, when they get up you will see that their bodies are visibly cracked and they start to take normal damage. If possible target the Ringblade boss first as they have a more difficult attack pattern to deal with. The Spear user repeatedly hops towards and stabs their spear at the direction of the player ending with a slower large hop giving players lots of time to kite them and an easily timed window to attack them. The Ringblade user is much more mobile and difficult to deal with, attacking from range as well as having a damaging and moving spinning attack. Defeating both bosses will reward the player with the Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing (2) and 1800 Runes.

place.title: Sainted Hero's Grave
walk: Once you arrive at the entrance of the Sainted Hero's Grave, you will find a Black Knife Assassin waiting for you. She drops the Black Knife once defeated.

Down the lift is a Site of Grace and a fog gate that requires a Stonesword Key to open. Through the door is a Wraith Caller guarding the Crimson Seed Talisman. Head back to the main room once you've dealt with this one.

To the East is an exit. On the ground a half-buried tablet shows the message "Shadow bathes in light and knows weakness." Continue down a staircase leading down. The second right/South exit takes you to a room, where two Wraith Callers perch at the top of a set of stairs. A Revenant spawns out of the ground in the space under where the Wraith Callers are. There is a Ghost Glovewort [4] near its back wall.
At the top of the stairs behind a Grave Violet is an illusionary wall that reveals a ledge above a large hall below.
The hallway area is also accessible by taking the first right/East exit you passed earlier. Two imps, one covered in darkness and a second standing in a light circle can be seen from the ledge.

This is your first hint regarding this dungeon's mechanic - you have to lead the dark covered imps (and any other 'dark' enemies) into the light to be able to damage them. They will be staggered upon walking into it.
The hallway takes a turn and down some steps you come to a room with two Shadow imps and a Wraith Caller under the stairs. The light circle is down the steps to the right.
A Grave Violet and a Grave Glovewort [4] can be found in the space under the entry to the room.

Take the eastern exit down some stairs to the next room. You'll notice the floor in the midst of a set of columns is sandy and has a depression in the middle that would collapse when you walk forward. Instead, walk around the outer edge of the room to the opposite corner to grab the Leyndell Soldier Ashes from the corpse.
With no other path forward, you must walk to the center of the room and trigger the floor collapse.

You'll fall into a circle of light, surrounded by four shadow imps. Once you have fought them off, there is a Grave Glovewort [3] in the alcove South of the light circle as you stand facing the wooden gate. Pull the lever next to the gate to the North. The large wooden gate opens in front of you.

Down the stairs on the other side of the gate are three Rotting Corpses and three active Guillotine traps. Note that further down the hall on a bridge on the second level are two more Rotting Corpses that are going to drop down as you walk below the bridge. An additional four Rotting Corpses stood at the far end of the hall where it takes a turn right/East.

If you get on the second blade and ride up you can land on a platform that leads up to a staircase with four Rotting Corpses. Continue through to a room, where are five Rotting Corpses around the bottom of the steps as well as two Wraith Callers at the top of the steps.

It leads you to a room up some steps with four Rotting Corpses. The path up the stairs behind the Wraith Callers will bring you back to the room with the collapsing floor (if you accidentally fell before collecting the Leyndell Soldier Ashes, you can go grab them now).

Under the stairs is a space blocked off by white fog that requires a Stonesword Key door to dispel. Behind it is a Grave Glovewort [5] and the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1 guarded by two more Rotting Corpses. Assuming you already have the Leyndell Soldier Ashes, return to the guillotine room. After the second trap is a Ghost Glovewort [4] followed by four additional Rotting Corpses. Two more would drop from a overhead bridge as you approach.
Around the corner will be a mounted Wraith Caller, three more Rotting corpses, and another three guillotine traps. Beyond these is the heavy double door leading to the boss.

Before that, however, turn to your right/South to pick up a Grave Glovewort [3]. Climb the ladder visible in that alcove. You are now standing on ledge above a room guarded by another Revenant - see the yellow and black vapour rising from the spot between the Grave Glovewort and the corpse. Drop down, lure it out by getting close to that spawning point and run back up the ladder to the ledge. From here, you can safely use range or the Night Maiden's Mist to kill it. Casting a healing spell while it is in range also deals damage to it. In this room is a Human Bone Shard and a Grave Glovewort [5]. The revenant itself drops a Ghost Glovewort [4].

Note: this Revenant respawns at the same location after some time has passed even without you resetting at the Site of Grace. It is also possible for another to spawn while one is still in place. Beware as you return to the same room during the fight with the Grave Warden Duelist or returning there to collect items.**

Take a right after you drop down, go west across the bridge above the first room with the guillotines. A corpse there can be looted for 3x Root Resin. Continue up some steps to a long room. A little way ahead is a corpse with the Prattling Pate (Let's get to it). A shadow Grave Warden Duelist stands at the far end guarding a Ghost Glovewort [4] and Ghost Glovewort [5].

You must draw him out and back to the light circle, the closest one being the one you dropped onto through the broken floor. Defeating him is required to unlock the heavy door leading to the boss. You have to be in melee range to bait his attack to make him step forward, otherwise he will retreat back down the steps leading to the illuminated circle of light. Alternatively, equip the Shabriri's Woe talisman to easily draw his aggro and have him step into the light.
Go back past the guillotines and to the now open door - head down the stairs. To your right is a final Rotting Corpse and a Grave Glovewort [3].

Finally, enter the Boss room and you will fight the Ancient Hero of Zamor. The boss drops the Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes. After the fight you can collect 2x Root Resins in the back corners of the room. Well done!

place.title: Seethewater Cave
walk: From the Site of Grace, drop down a small ledge to find 2 Leyndell Soldiers, one patrolling and one sitting in a room to the right. Continue onwards and drop down a hole to reach the main area of the cave with a poisonous floor and many Servants of Rot. Watch out for Skeletal Slimes that drip from the ceiling.

From the drop down, there is some loot to the right, loot the body draped over the cliff for Golden Rune (7), then turn left . Ahead, there is another side path to the left which contains some Rats and a Giant Rat as well as some Cave Moss. Go back to the main corridor and proceed to find multiple Servants of Rot walking around a tree. Try to lure them out one by one or sneak/sprint past them and drop down a small poison waterfall into a poison-filled chamber below. To the left is the way back up, along with more rats and servants. You can find the Mushroom Set in a room off this path containing a Giant Miranda Sprout and several Servants of Rot. When facing the creatures in this room, try to lure them out to face them individually. You can go ahead and equip the Mushroom Set, since it gives you high immunity. It will help you get around this cave better without worrying as much about the poison effects.

Head back down and to the right, then drop down to reach the last tunnel before the boss. Head upwards to find a rat guarding a Golden Rune (6), then go the other way to find the boss: Two Kindred of Rot which drop the Kindred of Rot's Exultation talisman. Beware that their projectiles apply poison even if you block.

place.title: Sellia Hideaway
walk: Upon entering the cave past the site of grace, you will encounter a Glintstone Miner. Past the Golden Rune (3) slightly further in, there is another illusory wall you need to roll through. Another Glintstone Miner and illusory wall await you. Past this, there is a large cave with massive purple crystals. Head right to find another miner, then go across the crystals and to the left towards the next miner guarding a Golden Rune (5). Go back by jumping above the crystals to the right, then go across the large crystal again, this time heading right. Turn right again and drop down onto another shorter crystal, the jump onto a longer one and drop down into the pit. You should be able to see the magic barrier associated to Sellen's quest from here. If you have the key, go through and talk to Lusat who will give you Stars of Ruin. Turn around and walk over the crystal where you encounter a Revenant. Loot the Stimulating Boluses, Golden Rune (5), and Lost Ashes of War. Turn around and towards the Silver Fireflies, along the path back upwards is a Somber Smithing Stone (4). When you drop down from the crystal at the end, there will be three Crystal Snails waiting for you. Turn left, where you will encounter two sorcerer miners, one of them has more health and a charging attack. Loot the Glowstone x4, then jump across or onto the crystal below, then head into the corridor on the right, passing a Stake of Marika (where you can respawn at should you die).

You'll enter into quite a large crystal formation cave. Hug the right wall, climbing up and over the rocks and rubble. You'll pass on your left shoulder, two (2) very large crystal shards growing from the floor with the third one at a gentle angle. Walk onto this third massive crystal shard and continue walking until you're a few feet away from the tip.

Walk off to your right, jump onto a little crystal and then floor to face a Preserving Boluse and an illusory wall leading to a chest containing Crystal Spear. Head back and this time, walk off to your left, which will make a very short drop onto another crystal (short drop to the south). From here, head south and take another very short drop onto yet another crystal shard. Follow this up and until you're on solid ground. There is a pit with some light barely noticeable at the bottom, a campfire, and a room full of several Glintstone Sorcerers (a couple will make use of shields and engage you in melee while the third will casts spells at you). Clear this room and you can claim the Crystalian Ashes, among a few other crafting mats. There is only one exit to take, so head out, make a small drop, and you'll come across a single miner. Once dealt with, you'll be at another short drop with two choices: left, going southwest or right, going northeast. You'll want to turn right, after you drop, heading in a northeast direction. This will take back into the room you did your crystal shard climbing/ dropping to reach the Crystalian Ash summons. Make your way back into the large crystal shard room, dealing with Crystal Snails and you can claim Crystal Dart x10. Nothing more to note in here so, head back into the tunnel, moving southwest towards the fog wall/ boss. Before the boss you will be ambushed by four more snails. Prepare for the boss accordingly: Three (3) Putrid Crystalians who inflict Scarlet Rot on hit. There is a mage, one with a ringblade, and the last one with a lance. Per usual with Crystalians, blunt weapons will crack their shell fast, enabling frontal/ rear backstab and for subsequent better HP damage on them. Your reward is the spell: Crystal Torrent.
## Master Lusat's Location

To get to Master Lusat, you'll first need to have talked to Sorceress Sellen and progressed the questline enough to where you will be asked to search for Master Lusat on her behalf (refer to her questline page for more information).
From the room with the overlapping crystals, fall down to the ground and fight the Royal Revenant. In the northwest side of the room, you'll find two small steps leading to a small cavern.

Follow through the cavern, and eventually you'll find yourself walking atop a crystal, with another ledge and a Crystal miner off in the distance. Hop to the other ledge, then head to the leftmost side of the platform.

Looking down off the ledge, you'll see two crystals, connecting you to where a snail sits. Jump down off the ledge, land on the first crystal, then walk along it and jump over to the second crystal, where you can fight the snail. Your goal is to defeat the snail without falling off, then get to where the snail was standing and go a few paces up.
As you walk towards to the snail, you'll notice on the bottom left corner there is a gate guarded by Sorcery. That is the ultimate location you are trying to get to.
Once you get to around where the snail you killed was, it is safe to drop down, and begin your approach to the door -- but note that it is guarded by a Glinstone Sorcerer.
Lastly, walk up to the door and examine it, and the door will open, revealing a short cave.
Proceed through the end of the cave, and Master Lusat will be there waiting for you.
Approach him, and interact to Talk with him.
After "talking" with him (he won't say anything), you'll receive Stars of Ruin.

place.title: Gelmir Hero's Grave
walk: Equip an Ash of War: Quickstep or Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step on your weapon to be able to move quickly through lava. Several claw items, such as the Bloodhound Claws also have this weapon art.
With the right timing, Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists can be used to evade the chariots
Ash of War: Endure skill will give a medium, but better than nothing, reduction in the damage from the chariot.

Once you enter and descend to the main area you will notice one main slope, be careful when lingering on the center slope since this is the chariot's main route. Anticipate the skeletons posted as the save crevices on the sides too that will pop out as you pass. Wait for the chariot to pass you before you advance to the next section until you dip into the last hollow section on the left.

Once the path narrows, you have two options here. The first is to continue dashing down the slope, and dip your feet into the knee-deep lava. The first chariot cannot chase you this far. Use Quickstep or Bloodhound's Step to dart across the lava without burning too much of your HP. At the end of this lava-filled corridor, turn left to get to a room with a chest containing the Ringed Finger. Going right, instead, will get you a Grave Glovewort [7] and a drop all the way to a ledge in front of the boss door.

The alternate, and more thorough route, sees you drop down the empty space to either side of the narrow path. Aim to hug the corners so that you land on the cross-shaped beams above the second chariot, rather than right into its path (which is a lethal drop instead). While on the beams above the chariot, watch its movements, and wait for an opportunity for the chariot to pause for a few seconds. This is your opening to jump onto the flat surface of the chariot itself, letting you ride over the lava to the ledge at the boss door. There's Beast Blood x3 on the corpse in the lava just next to the ladder leading up to the door.

Otherwise, wait for the chariot to clear out and drop onto the clearing below, where you can kill a Lesser Cemetery Shade and obtain a Mantis Blade from it. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] in the alcove. Look to the narrow uphill path, but rather than ascend it, drop to either side. You'll land on a ledge rather than in the lava, and underneath the ramp itself is a remains with Smoldering Butterfly x6. Turn the other way and head into the short arch-topped corridor and before going through all the way, make a right/north into a taller and easily missed corridor. This opens up into a room with a grave violet and 2 exits to the north. Here will be a Lesser Bloodhound Knight who will drop the Bloodhound Knight Set. This is also where you can loot the Gelmir Knight Set off of a corpse. Elden Ring Map here.

When you turn around, there will be a ladder directly behind on the south wall. This leads to a ledge with many pots to break to get to a remains with Root Resin x5. There is are two windows to jump out through and find yourself back on the wooden beams that would let you jump onto the second chariot. Use this path to re-attempt the jump if you miss.

Now, head up the ramp. There is a Stonesword Key at the top of the ramp, and to the side is a fire pillar that needs lowering to grant safe passage. Follow these rooms all the way through, and eventually you'll find yourself near solid footing at the end point of the first chariot. This is a more scenic route that gets you to the Ringed Finger and the shortcut to the boss room without needing to time or dodge around the chariots.

Regardless of how you reach it, the boss room pits you against the Red Wolf of the Champion. Defeating this boss will reward you with Bloodhound Knight Floh Ashes. Loot the remaining chest in the boss chamber to obtain Deathroot.

## Boss: Demi-Human Queen Margot

Margot is a very straight forward fight. Unlike other Demi-Human Queens, she will not be using any magic attacks as she is gripped by a bestial madness. Instead, she will use her staff to smack you and slam the ground. All her staff attacks are highly telegraphed and are easily dodged. You can also maintain your distance as the cavern is large enough. After a certain point, Margot will toss her staff at you and resort to using her limbs to perform swiping and slamming attacks. She will also perform a leap and attempt to bite her target but overall, her speed remains the same and she has lots of openings in between her slow attacks.
Defeating Margot will award the Jar Cannon as well as 8,250 Runes.
