Old Fang: x5 Found in what it looks like a small stable, outside of Fortified Manor, protected by two guards. x3 Found on a body that's being devoured by two dogs. Near the main road.

Lightning Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 4 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel . In the chamber with the exploding Abnormal Stone Clusters near the end of the dungeon, dispel the wall opposite the wooden stairs to reveal a deep pit with roots strewn jutting across the walls. Drop down onto the second root and check the corpse on a ledge along the north wall.
Golden Rune [9]: Rune Consumable. Found inside the Sealed Tunnel , on a corpse at the bottom of the deep pit with roots strewn across, near the end of the dungeon.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Head inside and grab the Sealed Tunnel grace.
Hit the illusory wall next to the campfire, then pick up a Golden Rune [5] from the wooden platform in the middle.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the northeast corner, then loot the chest at the opposite side for the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2].
Hit the illusory wall behind the chest, then do a running jump to the left of the lift to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
Hit the illusory wall at the bottom to reveal a Golden Rune [5].

Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Sealed Tunnel : At the bottom of the lift found halfway through the dungeon, dispel two illusory walls to the south to reveal a large cavern with an Iron Virgin roaming the very bottom level. Lure it to the east end where a statue with a glowing crack can be found. Its attacks can destroy the statue, revealing a set of 3 of the stones.
Rune Arc N: Found inside the Fortified Manor, in the room with the big table in the middle.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: On a side room, you can find this on a body.
Stonesword Key: Found on a corpse below West Capital Rampart Site of Grace . Drop down, jump on petrified dragon foot onto barn, then into 2nd story wooden building.

place.title: Sealed Tunnel
walk: Even though it looks like a "Sealed" Tunnel as its name says, there's a cavity that will open a secret path if you attack it.
There are many Miners that can be easily surprised as they are working. The mine keeps hiding paths, the second one is behind the chest that contains Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (2).

You will find an elevator right after that and you will notice when you go down, that there are some areas to discover middle way down. It's very safe to jump of those areas, as you can jump your way down whenever you need to return to the main way, as there are some platforms and wooden structures that will ease the fall.
Once down, at the end of the path, there's another illusory wall, followed by another one with a Golden Rune (5) in front of it.

This next area is much bigger. Try to stay up on the wooden platforms and take out the enemies there, in the pit below there is an Abductor Virgin waiting. There is a path to the right (south) containing a Stonesword Key. On the roots going across there is a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot. In the pit below, try to lure out the abductor virgin to break the statue which contains three Smithing Stones (6). There is also a Rune Arc, Golden Rune (1), three Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and a Somber Smithing Stone (5) on the wall.

After collecting the items in the pit, return up the ladder & proceed across the roots to the far wall. Walk forward to a low root blocking your path & drop down to the right & be wary of two exploding Lookout Stones at the landing site. The surrounding room is filled with multiple other exploding clusters & a few items that can be collected.
At the very end of the path, there's a Lookout Stone ready to explode behind some debris, in a very dark cavity. Behind it there's another illusory wall.

Follow through and climb over the roots do reach another area to drop down. Be careful and keep easing your fall by falling short distances. As you fall watch for a smithing stone item on the wall, & a Lightning Grease on a corpse next to a large root. Be wary that the landing site holds another group of exploding stones so be ready to roll when landing. Once you have reached the bottom, you will see another corpse with a golden rune & an arena that contains the boss fight against Onyx Lord who drops the Onyx Lord's Greatsword.
In the next area you are able to see the sky again but the path is still linear. Here you'll find the next Site of Grace and the entrance to the Divine Tower of West Altus.

title: Gargoyle's Great Axe
text: Pick up a Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot when crossing the lower root.
After dropping down in the next room, turn around to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the wall.
Grab the Grace Mimic x5 beneath the staircase, then the Smithing Stone [5] on the ground next to it.
Pick up Large Glintstone Scrap x3 and Old Fang x2 from the upper part of the room.
Hit the illusory wall in the room and drop down two roots to reach a Smithing Stone [5].
At the top of the large root, do a running jump to reach a ledge with Lightning Grease x4.
Golden Rune [9]: Can be found near the wheel of a chariot, at the main road.
Kill the Onyx Lord for Onyx Lord's Greatsword and 16,000 runes.
Continue past the boss to discover the Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate grace.
Gargoyle's Great Axe: Dropped by Gargoyle . From the Outer Wall Phantom Tree .Site of Grace go northeast the Slope/long Stairs up until it spawns.

title: Boss: Erdtree Avatar
text: Mini boss that patrols the main road in Leyndell, Royal Capital . Drops Lord's Rune

title: Golden Seed
text: Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Two can be found under the Phantom Tree in the northwestern outer wall section.

title: Boss: Valiant Gargoyle
text: Optional Boss. Located around the Capital Outskirts

title: Talk to Finger Reader
text: Finger Reader NPC.

title: Ash of War: Golden Parry
text: Ash of War: Golden Parry: Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found within the Capital Outskirts .

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: Lost Ashes of War: Key Item used to duplicate Ashes of War. Found by the locked gate in the northwestern Capital Outskirts.

title: Viridian Amber Medallion +1
text: Golden Rune [12]: Rune Consumable. Dropped by a Wandering Noble with a treasure chest upon defeating him. This is a one-time drop.
Turn left at the top of the slope to find a Golden Rune [5] guarded by two bats.
Continue along the left side of the battlefield to discover the Outer Wall Battleground grace.
Talk to Melina at the Outer Wall Battleground grace.

Viridian Amber Medallion +1: can be found in Altus Plauteau, south of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace. You should hear Margit whisper, "I see you, Tarnished..." to you before appearing on the road. Defeat him again and it will drop.

title: Boss: Margit, The Fell Omen
text: Margit can be fought again as a non-respawning miniboss in Capital Leyndell, near the end of the game.

title: Talk to Hermit Merchant
text: On a catapult in the camp northwest of where you fought Margit sits a corpse with Arteria Leaf x3.
Golden Rune [10]: Due East of the Hermit Merchant's Shack on the cliff to the south of the path.
Jump from the cliff edge southwest of the camp onto a gravestone with Old Fang x3.
Golden Rune [4] C: Found right next to a huge stone, on the ground.
Golden Rune [7]: Held by a corpse lying on the open field.
Under a tent farther east sits a corpse with Mushroom x8.
Go up the stairs by the cliff wall, then head south-southeast toward a Sword Monument. If you own the Tarnished Pack DLC, pick up Spectral Steed Regalia: Funereal Night from one of the swords.
From the Sword Monument, continue east to find a Golden Rune [2] by two large gravestones.
Grace Mimic: Consumable. Found on a dead body on the path to the Minor Erdtree .
Pick up the Drawstring Holy Grease x3 behind a large gravestone near the cliff, then grab the Smithing Stone [5] next to the path.
Follow along the path to discover the Hermit Merchant's Shack grace outside a shack.
Hermit Merchant: Merchant within the Hermit Merchant's Shack. Replaced by Bell Bearing Hunter at night.

title: Boss: Bell Bearing Hunter, Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing
text: Bell Bearing Hunter: Field Boss. Spawns at the Hermit Merchant's Shack , but only at night time. Drops the Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing upon defeat.
Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing: Key Item. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades the Hermit Merchant's Shack at night time.

title: Boss: Deathbird
text: Follow the rocky cliff edge east of the grace to a corpse on the cliff with a Golden Rune [10].
Between two large gravestones on the opposite side of the path is a Golden Rune [5].
Deathbird: East of the Hermit Merchant's Shack. It drops the Twinbird Kite Shield upon defeat.
Twinbird Kite Shield: Medium Shield dropped by nighttime spawn Deathbird near Leyndell's Hermit Merchant's Shack.

title: Winged Crystal Tear
text: Winged Crystal Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar surrounded by Skull enemies.

title: Twiggy Cracked Tear, Crimson Crystal Tear
text: Return to the path and follow it downhill to find a Golden Rune [4] beside a large gravestone.
Continue downhill, take a left at the fork, then follow the road east toward some Archer Golems. Pick up Great Arrow x10 from a rock on the right side.
Pick up a Smithing Stone [5] from the rock on the left side of the road.
Twiggy Cracked Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar at the base of the Minor Erdtree in Capital Outskirts . Guarded by enemies.
Crimson Crystal Tear: Crystal Tear for the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Found on an altar at the base of the Minor Erdtree in Capital Outskirts . Guarded by enemies.
miss: Disappears if not picked up before killing Maliketh.

title: Golden Epitaph, Stonesword Key +2
text: Golden Rune [6]: Held by a corpse next to the water, south of the Minor Erdtree .
Talk to Blackguard near the moat. Select "You should probably know...", then talk about the Dung Eater.

Golden Epitaph: Straight Sword . Found on a corpse in a room locked behind an Imp Statue Seal just past the Site of Grace. Use a Stonesword Key to unlock the seal and beware the Basilisk guarding the treasure.

Grave Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp and then check the eastern wall in the bottom room. Beware the multiple Basilisks that emerge from the ground as you approach. From the first glovewort, head west and up the steps and then turn right in the next corridor. Follow the path towards a second Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. The second glovewort can be found shortly after exiting into this hall, right down the middle before the second ramp. In the same large hall, head all the way to the bottom where there is a large pit. Look down to find some wooden beams you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards an archway with a ladder in the back. Head up the ladder and you will end up in another hall with a single Chariot. Wait for it to run down the ramp and then head up and turn right into a chamber with a flamethrower pillar. The third glovewort can be found behind this pillar. From the flamethrower pillar, head back into the last Chariot hall and head all the way down to the bottom. Enter the corridor on the left and then take another left to find a lift which will take you up to a chamber where the flamethrower pillar is raised (if you have previously hit it). If the pillar is active, it will be spewing flames into the northern corridor. Wait for breaks in between spews and head inside. There is an alcove on the right where you can safely wait for another break before heading to the end of the corridor. Turn left at the end to find the final glovewort just before the path leads back to the large double Chariot Hall.

Ghost Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps. The glovewort can be found at the very end of the following corridor.

Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right to find the first glovewort in the next corridor. Continue on from the previous glovewort to the large Chariot Hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down to the bottom where there is a large pit. Looking down, you will see several wooden beams you can jump onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading to the north where you can find a hidden area with a statue to the right. Enter the corridor behind the statue to find a small room where the second glovewort can be looted from the back wall.

Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps then turn right to reach a second Chariot hall where two chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find the key on a corpse between two ramps.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Auriza Side Tomb : Precise location to be added
Grave Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 4 can be found inside the Auriza Side Tomb : Precise locations to be added

Golden Rune [7]: Rune Consumable. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. The rune can be found on a corpse by the edge of this pit.

Holy Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down to. Align yourself with the closest one and drop down, then drop down once more to a second beam below where the items can be looted off a corpse.

Vulgar Militia Ashes: Spirit Ashes found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the large Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them, head all the way down to the large pit behind some pillars. Looking down, you can find several wooden beams you can drop down onto. Navigate your way across the beams, heading north to find a hidden area on the right with a statue. Head into the corridor behind the statue and to the right to access a small room where a corpse holding the ashes can be found.
Grave Glovewort [5]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Auriza Side Tomb : Precise locations to be added

Crucible Feather Talisman: Talisman found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave . Reaching it is quite complex: From the first Chariot Hall, drop down through the opening on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps, then turn right into the next corridor that leads to a large hall with two Chariots running almost side by side, with a short delay between them. Head all the way down towards the pit behind the pillars. Looking down, you will see several wooden beams that you can drop onto. Navigate your way to the lowest beam and then head south towards the archway with a ladder at the back. Climb the ladder to reach a third Chariot Hall with a single Chariot. Head all the way down this hall, using the alcove on the left about halfway through to avoid the Chariot (unless you've previously destroyed it). At the bottom, turn left into a corridor and head straight to find a small room guarded by an Omen . The talisman can be found on a corpse behind the Omen, sitting by a statue.
Great Dragonfly Head: Material. Found on a corpse at the stairs of a secluded room in Auriza's Hero Grave .
Ordovis's Greatsword: Greatsword . Obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and his regular Crucible Knight companion in their Duo Boss Fight inside the Auriza Hero's Grave .

Crucible Axe Set: Armor Set comprised of the Crucible Axe Helm , Crucible Axe Armor , Crucible Gauntlets and the Crucible Greaves . Dropped by Crucible Knight Ordovis upon defeat inside the Auriza Hero's Grave .

place.title: Auriza Hero's Grave
walk: Before heading here, make sure you have one Stonesword Key ready to use on an Imp statue. Upon arriving, you'll find the Site of Grace for this location. On the left side of an altar, you'll see an arch doorway that is blocked by a white fog. Use the Stonesword Key on the Imp Statue and inside that room, you'll encounter two Basilisk enemies. There's a corpse here that you can loot to find the Golden Epitaph weapon.

From the site of grace, head west where you'll need to traverse some slopes that head down to the lower section of this location. As you move towards the slope, a large environmental hazard, a Chariot, will appear. This isn't the only Chariot that will appear; there will be multiple ones as you progress.

On this first slope sprint down and about halfway, move to the alcove on the left or right to take cover. The alvcoves are located just past the third torch down. There will be two Skeleton enemies that will reanimate when enter the alcove if you chose the one on the right. Wait for the Chariot to move past you and run all the way down till you reach the first set of pillars and arches. Stand directly under this arch for now.
Next, you'll have to go up a second slope. The two Chariots won't hit you if you're standing in between the pillars on the right or left side.

Wait for the second Chariot to go up, run up along with it to the alcove on the right or left near the top. It's a close sprint, you may want to roll into it. From here, wait for the chariot to move down, then run up into the far corner of the flat area where you can stand safe from both chariots on this slope.

Run down the slope on the right side, ducking into cover as needed. Wait for the Chariot to pass then run and jump down into the gap on the right side. You will have to fight some Basilisks. Proceed through and you will come to the double wide slope.
## Clearing the Chariots

For the third slope, you'll notice that this slope is wide compared to the first two. There are two Chariots on the third slope that move up and down on both sides of the slope. You have to zig-zag down between them as they pass. Examine how both Chariots move so that you know which way to move.

In the middle of this large ramp, you'll notice that there is a gap that you can drop to. Use this to take cover. You'll find a body here that can be looted to find x1 Stonesword Key and x1 Ghost Glovewort [6] that is guarded by a single Skeleton enemy. As you continue heading down, if you need to take cover, Half way down there's another alcove on the left side, but there's another Skeleton enemy here that will ambush you. Here the chariots start behaving a little more inconsistently, sometimes moving all the way up or down, sometimes stopping here to turn around. There's a Grave Glovewort [6] in the middle of the ramp. An archer Skeleton will appear in an alcove on the right on way down. Killing him now will give you a chance to freely enjoy the chariot wreck later, but you can ignore him if you just keep running. You'll have a chance to kill him later.

Make your way to the next row of pillars, sprinting in a zig-zag direction to dodge the chariots. Stand in between the pillars so that you won't get hit by the Chariot that will spawn ahead of you. Notice as well that there is a body hanging by the edge of the slope on the left, loot it to find x1 Golden Rune [7]. You should still be near the row of pillars.

Use the body as an indication of where to drop down. Before jumping, you'll notice the thin wooden plank structures over the large drop. This is is where you'll be dropping. Drop down the first short plank then onto the lower longer one directly underneath where you'll find 2 Holy Grease. Then you'll want to drop to the perpendicular plank and walk along it. You'll find another lower plank at the end perpendicular to the one you're on. Drop down one last time and make your way into the next area that it leads to. You should see a statue with a Basilisk facing it, but beware that two more will come rushing in from the halls when you approach. Clear the basilisks, and beware of a fourth one waiting in ambush on the left as you pass the statue. You'll come to a room with a corpse where you can loot Vulgar Militia Ashes., as well as a Grave Glovewort [5] One more Basilisk will spawn out of the floor here. The ladder to the right leads back up to the chariot crossroads where you dropped down and a Grave Violet, if you need to go back up for some reason.

Return to the wooden beams over the large drop. You should be able to drop down one more level onto the narrow stone arches. Follow the narrow route all the way to the end. The left one will have a skeleton waiting at the end, so if you want a little room to maneuver, take the right one. This area will have one large archway and a ladder. Ascend the ladder and you'll find yourself with another Chariot at the end of the tunnel. There's only one short slope left that goes up. You need to take cover by using the corner on the left side and then run up the slope to the right side into the chamber.

Collect the Grave Glovewort (6), then hit the fire-breathing pillar so that it's breathing fire out the way you came in. You can time things such that you can dive back into the safe spot on the left of the ramp without taking any damage. Alternatively, you can wait in the tunnel and time for the chariot to hit the wall, then hit the pillar with a ranged attack and run down to the alcove. Then race to the bottom of the slope, taking cover in an alcove to the left near the bottom. if needed Continue down, clear the skeletons, then continue straight to take out the Omen guarding the Crucible Feather Talisman. (If you die on the way, don't worry, you've already done the step you need to destroy the chariots. Return to the wide ramp with two chariots and watch the carnage unfold!) Take the elevator up from the branch in the path, and then navigate around the fire-breathing pillar that you've already raised. Collect the Grave Glovewort (6) and 3x Great Dragonfly Head on the way and drop into an alcove that's right next to the wide ramp with two chariots (you'll find the skeleton archer in the alcove you drop into if you ran past him before). You'll notice that raising the pillar has created a sigil that will summon a third chariot in this area causing the chariots to crash into each other, breaking and leaving you with Ash of War: Holy Ground and the Tree Sentinel Set. Go north further to open the door leading to the boss area. You are also free to explore the area without interruptions from this point forward.

(Alternate solution: As soon as you've reached one of the safe spots in the wide ramp with two chariots, use either Margit's Shackle or Mohg's Shackle. The range of these items can pass through walls, and it causes the fire-breathing pillar to be raised from your current location. This then places the summoning sigil right in the middle of this ramp, causing all three chariots to be destroyed and leaving you the freedom to explore the rest of the area without the tedium of navigating around the chariots.)
## Boss Area

Beyond the door, simply head down the steps. This section is guarded by a few Skeleton enemies, it should be easy for you to fight and pass through them. At the bottom-section is a large archway that is covered with a gold mist. Beyond it serves as the arena for the bosses of this location, the Crucible Knight and Crucible Knight Ordovis. We suggest that when you are fighting them, to take out the spear-wielding Crucible Knight first and to use any of your upgraded or strong Spirit Ashes. This way, you won't have to fight the bosses on your own.

Successfully defeating them both yields 28000 Runes and rewards the Ordovis's Greatsword, as well as the Armor pieces for the Crucible Axe Set. There are some Root Resin materials that you can get in this boss arena - simply use the portal here to return to the entrance.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Take the lift down and grab the Auriza Hero's Grave grace.
Unlock the imp seal to access a room with the Golden Epitaph.
Run past the chariot and pick up Fan Daggers x5 from the opposite side of the hole. Standing between the pillars is safe.
Drop down the hole for a Grave Glovewort [6] guarded by multiple Basilisks.
Pick up the Ghost Glovewort [5] and Grave Glovewort [5] on the way to a larger room with two chariots.
Stonesword Key: At Auriza Hero's Grave , one can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.
Ghost Glovewort [6]: At Auriza Hero's Grave , can be found while passing the third part of the giant chariots, on a small platform in the middle.

title: Cracked Pot, Perfumer's Cookbook [3] +2
text: Note: You can just use Margit's Shackle in this spot to destroy all the chariots, bypassing the entire challenge of the dungeon.
Head down, alternating between the two chariots, and pick up the Grave Glovewort [6] in the middle.
Golden Rune [7] B: Found inside Auriza Hero's Grave , at the edge of the path where the lone chariot passes.
Holy Grease: Over The main road, at the top of the wrecked chariot.
At the top of the slanted beam below is an area with the Vulgar Militia Ashes and a Grave Glovewort [5].
Head back and drop onto the stone beams, then climb a ladder to an area with a chariot. At the top is a room with a fire-breathing pillar and a Grave Glovewort [6].
At the bottom of the area, enter the room straight ahead to pick up the Crucible Feather Talisman.
Take the lift in the other room to a pillar and hit it until it stretches tall and shines light through the window. Grab the Great Dragonfly Head x3 and Grave Glovewort [6] around the corner.
If you aligned the pillar correctly, all chariots should be destroyed, giving you Ash of War: Holy Ground and the Tree Sentinel Set.
Kill the two Crucible Knights for Ordovis's Greatsword, Crucible Axe Set and 28,000 runes.
Return to the entrance and bait the Runebear by the cliff into attacking the statue near the path to obtain Smithing Stone [6] x2.
Cracked Pot: Held by a corpse next to a column, above the water level.
Perfumer's Cookbook [3]: Auriza Side Tomb , open the transporter chest in the room with many benches. The room you'll be teleported to will have a corpse with Perfumer's Cookbook [3] on it.
Golden Rune [7]: Just in front of the Broken Statue . You can kill it from behind if you take an alternate route, allowing you to grab this item without much of a hassle.

Ghost Glovewort [6]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. One can be found inside the Auriza Hero's Grave : In the first Chariot Hall, drop down the openings on either side just before the second ramp. In the room below, head west and up the steps and then turn right into the next corridor. Follow the path to a second Chariot Hall where two Chariots are running side by side with a short delay between them. As you exit into this hall, turn left to find two ramps. In between them in the back is a small opening where the glovewort can be found.
Cracked Pot: Crafting Pot. Found inside a room in the northern area, where you fight the Leyndell Royal Guard.
Grave Warden Duelist: Field Enemy located inside Auriza Side Tomb .
Soldjars of Fortune Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist boss at the end of the Auriza Side Tomb .
miss: The Runebear and the statue disappear after killing Maliketh.

place.title: Auriza Side Tomb
walk: Auriza Side Tomb's gimmick is its teleporting chests sending you between inaccessible areas. Furthermore, these catacombs contain two copies of the same set of rooms, arranged only in slightly different configurations.
## Walkthrough directions
From the grace, the first room has a couple of small jars and a window to the left.
Jump through that window. Head down the stairs there are 3 Fanged Imps. Take care of them and go into the next room with water, and then into a cathedral.

Watch for an imp above you as well as the one on the floor. You will see a chest a ways out in front of you where an altar might be, an alcove to your left and an elevated walkway to your right. The door to the room with the chest in it is locked, but proceed through the walkway.

Go forward to the chest in front of you, looking out for the Imp to your left. Open that chest, it is a transporter trap that takes you to a room with 2 large jars, the Perfumer's Cookbook (3), and 2 Cracked Pots.
The only way back is via the same chest you came in from, so this is a dead end.
Go back, and in the cathedral room you just vacated, there is an alcove on the left as you enter the room with a hidden wall with a chest.
There is a glovewort in the hallway of this chest, which can help you keep track of which room you are actually in, since the other version of this room does not have it..
There are also two exploding jars in this room. Open that chest and it ports you up on a walkway with 2 Imps. This area looks the same but it is not.

Drop down and proceed backwards like you are going back to the starting grace, going through the water room and up the stairs. When you go up the stairs at the end you will see a large jar and in front of him is a Ritual Pot.

After looting, backtrace your steps, through the water and back into the cathedral and take the alcove to your left again. Opening this chest takes you again up on a walkway, but this time staying up on the walkway and to your left you will find a ladder.

Following the ladder up, you'll reach a prayer room -- there'll be a chest, and a coffin on both the left and right wall, with a small statue flanked by two blue lanterns in front. As anticipated by now, the chest is another trap.
Enter it, and you'll be transported to what looks like the area shortly after the starting site of grace.

Go straight, then turn right, and proceed up the stairs to a room similar to the starting room, but instead without any living jars, it is a large room with cubic arches, there'll be a small wall (formed between two pillars) with a lantern on it in front of you. Go right around the wall, and then up the stairs. Once you reach the stairs' threshold, you'll be able to see loot a few feet in front of you, which is this dungeon's second Ritual Pot. There is be a large Living Jar to your left, though, so watch for the ambush.

As you exit the room (coming down the stairs), to your left will be a window -- just like before, jump out of it, then head all the way back to the cathedral room and use the chest in front of the room.
This will take you to a water room with 2 small living jars, 2 Cracked Pots and a ladder in the right side of the room.
Climb the ladder, then proceed forward -- on your left will be a statue with a lever in front of it; this opens the boss gate.
With the boss gate open, jump off the platform, and run back up the stairs to the chest (do NOT go down into the water room's chest).

When you exit the chest, you'll be in the stage similar the starting configuration, where you can go forward, then turn right, and then you'll see the cubic arches with the wall in front of you.Going straight (around the wall), and up the stairs will lead you to the entrance to the boss gate.
There are also Ghost Gloveworts throughout the dungeon.
The boss of this Dungeon, Grave Warden Duelist, also has a few living jars in his arena that will attack you. Kill him to acquire the Soldjars of Fortune ashes.

text: From the Underground Roadside, pick up a Golden Rune [11] and two pieces of the Bloodsoaked Set in the first room.
Descend the nearby ladder to find Freezing Grease on a wooden platform.
Jump onto the pipe for a corpse with Serpent Arrow x10.
Continue up the pipes to pick up Fire Grease x5 (you'll be ambushed by several Imps).
Follow the pipe down to a Somber Smithing Stone [6], then pick up the Smithing Stone [7] hanging off the wooden ledge at the end.
Drop onto a lower pipe below the wooden ledge to reach the bottom, then pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [7] and Smithing Stone [7] x2 from the long side of the room.
Pick up Glass Shard x5 in front of a tube, then kill the scarab inside it for a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Grab the Smithing Stone [7] x2 and Mohg's Shackle at the end of the room.
Sacramental Bud: Material. Can be gathered near the cliffs behind to the right of the Hermit Village at Mt. Gelmir .
Esgar, Priest of Blood: Esgar, Priest of Blood is a Boss found in Leyndell, Leyndell Royal Capital .
Lord of Blood's Exultation: Drops from Esgar, Priest of Blood in Leyndell Catacombs .

title: Shadow Bait
text: Turn right before the lift to grab the Leyndell Catacombs grace.
Pick up a Ghost Glovewort [6] from a corpse up two sets of stairs.
Deactivate the fire-breathing pillar and use it to reach a room with the Crucible Scale Talisman.
Head up the other path to find a Grave Glovewort [9] next to an Omen.

Pick up a Golden Rune [11] from the ledge at the end, then drop down for a Grave Glovewort [8] on top of a coffin. Note: There may be a bug where the Golden Rune doesn't appear consistently for some players. If it's missing, try reloading the area or coming back later.
Note: There may be a bug where the Golden Rune doesn't appear consistently for some players. If it's missing, try reloading the area or coming back later.
Head northwest first, then up some stairs to reach a room with Root Resin x4.
Go through the boss door to pick up a Ghost Glovewort [8] and a Golden Rune [11].
Head back and follow the other path. Ignore the fire-breathing pillar this time and go up the stairs instead for a Grave Glovewort [8].
Drop down at the end of the room again, then go up the stairs to pick up a Grave Glovewort [8].
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [8] in front of a statue, then a Grave Glovewort [9] where the pillar usually is.
Jump through the window and ride the pillar you ignored earlier to reach a ledge with Sacramental Bud x2 and the boss lever.
Kill Esgar, Priest of Blood for Lord of Blood's Exultation and 30,000 runes.
Use the lift outside the catacombs and pick up the Haligdrake Talisman +1 beside a Spiritcaller Snail past two illusory walls below the staircase.
Grab the Golden Rune [11] up the stairs, then pull the shortcut lever.

Shadow Bait: Can be found on a corpse at Subterranean Shunning-Grounds , after going through the pipe room to a room with the corpse sitting at the center, next to a not very well hidden Ogre ready to strike.

place.title: Leyndell Catacombs
walk: These catacombs are three loops of very similar paths and enemies, designed to be confusing.

On the first floor right after the Leyndell Catacombs site of grace is a sealed room containing the Esgar, Priest of Blood boss fight. Continuing past the sealed boss room is a coffin in the center of a pool of water. As you continue on, there will be a few rooms with enemies and a hall with a flame statue. Jumping onto the flame statue will take you to a balcony with a dead end room containing an Omen and the Crucible Scale Talisman.

Backtrack a bit, then follow the hall that split off just before the flame statue. Up the stairs you'll see a Grave Glovewort (9) and an Omen with a sword. Keep going, and you'll end up overlooking a coffin in a pool of water once again. This is the second floor, and the start of the loop.

Jump down and grab the Grave Glovewort (8) on the coffin, being wary of the zombies that will wake up when you do. Run towards where the site of grace would be if this were the first floor, and you'll see an opened set of doors leading to a fake boss room with two Omens and a Grave Glovewort (8) inside. Up the stairs where the grace would be, there is a corpse with 4 Root Resin.

Head back to the room with the coffin and go up the stairs. As you continue on there will be a few rooms with enemies and a hall with a flame statue, including another Grave Glovewort (8). Jumping onto the flame statue will take you to a balcony connected to a room that resembles the alternate boss rooms in these kinds of dungeons (a chapel). It's not a real boos room, though, so you can safely enter and then turn right to see a hallway and two Imps.

Continue along this path, and you will end up overlooking the coffin in a pool of water on the first floor. There will also be a lever here, so pull it to unlock the real boss room's door on the first floor of the Catacombs. Do not jump into the pool if you want all the loot in this dungeon, though, as there is a third floor to explore if you backtrack a bit.

On the second floor, if you climb the stairs that are just before the flame statue, you'll see a third Grave Glovewort (8) before climbing more stairs and running into another Omen. Past that, you'll be overlooking yet another coffin in a pool of water. This is the third floor, so jump down and climb the stairs out of the room, which leave to a Ghost Glovewort (6). Further down the hall you'll pass the fourth Grave Glovewort (8) on the way to where you'd expect to find a fire statue. That room instead contains just a Grave Gravewort (9), but there's also an Omen waiting to ambush you from above. Continuing on, you will come to a window overlooking the set of double stairs on the second floor.

Jump down there, go back up the second floor's flame statue to reach the jump down to the first floor's coffin pool, and then head to the grace to prep for Esgar, Priest of Blood in the now-unlocked boss room.

Those looking for the Haligdrake Talisman +1 will find it up the elevator from the site of grace, on a corpse near a Lesser Spirit-Caller Snail in the opposite direction of the dungeon proper. This is the path that leads to the shortcut back to the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

title: Lost Ashes of War
text: Drop down the hole at the end of the first room to find a corpse with Preserving Boluses.
Pick up the Furlcalling Finger Remedy in the corner, then climb the ladder past the Miranda Blossoms for a Rune Arc.

Lost Ashes of War: Lost Ashes of War. Found in the room before Dung Eater's cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital. Beware the Giant Spider Hand that emerges as you loot the item.

title: Stonesword Key
text: Unlock the cell and tell Dung Eater to leave his gaol.

Stonesword Key: Stonesword Key . One found in the Aqueducts section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds . From the Underground Roadside site of grace, head northeast and drop down into an opening in the ground to enter the aqueducts. From here, head northwest past the rats and look for a tunnel on the right. Follow this tunnel until you see slimes and drop into the hole in front of them. Follow the path all the way to the end to grab the key on a corpse.

title: Nomad Ashes
text: Go through the tunnel past the door to end up on the other side of the hole. Pick up the Glass Shard in the corner.
Drop down a second hole, then kill the Revenant in the room for a Ghost Glovewort [6] (first time).
Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. One found in the Aqueducts section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds .
Take the first right as you go through the tunnel to pick up Rainbow Stone Arrow (Fletched) x10 next to the second hole.
Past the barred doorway, take the first right to find a corpse with Fireproof Dried Liver.
At the end of the pipe, pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] guarded by three Omens in succession.
Climb the ladder to grab a Smithing Stone [7] in front of the statue. Pull the lever to unlock a shortcut gate back to the first room.
Open the door to a circular staircase with a Grace Mimic at the bottom.
Drop down from the top of the staircase, then kill the scarab to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Pick up the String down the stairs and the Warming Stone in the corner.
Go through the corridor to find a ladder and a corpse with Fire Grease x2.
Guarded by three Basilisks behind the Miranda Blossom is a corpse with Poisoned Stone x8.
Nomad Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the capital. This is in a large, multi-level section in the east.

title: Talk to Boc the Seamster
text: Boc appears in the East Capital Rampart site of grace. You have to rest at this Site of Grace for him to appear. He offers his sewing services as well as makes some conversation regarding the Erdtree.

title: Boss: Mohg, the Omen, Bloodflame Talons
text: Head back up the ladder past the Miranda Blossom to find a corpse with Preserving Boluses next to the stairs.
Go through the pipes until you come to a room with an Omen. Kill it to obtain Omen Bairn (first time).
Loot Glass Shard x4, Golden Centipede x2 and Dappled White Cured Meat from the four corpses.
Climb the ladder to reach a corpse with Poisoned Stone x3 and a shortcut back to the first room.
Climb the pipe opposite the shortcut door, then drop down at the end to pick up the Golden Rune [10] on a wooden ledge.
Kick down the ladder in the next room. Jump down the hole in the pipe below, then head southwest until you reach a Golden Rune [8].
Continue northwest toward the end of the pipe to find a corpse with Smithing Stone [7] x4.
Retrace your steps and follow the tunnel with a Cerulean Tear Scarab near a barred doorway. Take the first left to find an Eye of Yelough at the end.
Smithing Stone [8]: Upgrade Material. One found at a dead end tunnel that slopes downwards, inside the central Aqueduct section of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital.
Return to where you dropped down and explore the other part of the pipe to find a corpse with a Golden Rune [11].
Don't drop down past the corpse. Go down the left tunnel instead to drop down the hole there, then turn around to pick up a Smithing Stone [5] and open the shortcut door.
Descend the ladder ahead and pick up the Ritual Pot guarded by several Living Jars.
Ride the lift to the bottom and grab the Forsaken Depths grace.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] on the way to the boss.
Mohg, the Omen: Located at the end of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.
Bloodflame Talons: Dropped by Mohg, the Omen in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds , Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, under Leyndell .

title: Erdtree's Favor +1
text: Dung Eater can be summoned if you released him from his cell and haven't dealt with his invasion yet.
Rest at the Cathedral of the Forsaken grace and talk to Melina.
Erdtree's Favor +1: Found inside a chest, in the room where you fight Mohg, The Omen

title: Nomadic Merchant's Set
text: Hit the altar behind the chest to reveal a secret path. Cross the plank to find a corpse with Grace Mimic x5.

Nomadic Merchant's Set: Full Armor Set. In the hidden tunnels behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room at the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell, Royal Capital. After opening the secret passage behind the altar and taking the stairs down, after crossing the narrow fallen rafter, directly to the left is a tent and in the far corner you can find the full Nomadic Merchant's set. To get access to the set, you need to destroy tent by either aggroing the enemy close by, leading it next to the tent and baiting its frenzy attack onto it or quit-outing while standing very close to tent itself.

title: Frenzied's Cookbook [2]
text: Note: The tents can also be destroyed manually by standing next to them, then quitting and reloading the game.
Go down the stairs and pick up Eye of Yelough x5 from a breakable tent.

Frenzied's Cookbook [2]: Is found nearest to the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds below Leyndell, Royal Capital. Behind the altar in Mohg, the Omen's boss room is a hidden path which can be opened by attacking the altar behind the chest after the boss fight. Following the the hidden path, there are stairs down and will lead to collapsed rafters that you can cross; you can cross the path and follow the stairs down for a safer route, or drop directly below on second set of collapsed rafters. On the second set of rafters, you will need to drop down to the lowest set of them, and you will find Frenzied's Cookbook [2] on a sitting corpse

title: Inescapable Frenzy
text: Pick up Hefty Beast Bone x3 from the corpse next a coffin.

Inescapable Frenzy: After making your way past Subterranean Shunning-Grounds and defeating Mohg, the Omen , attack the altar at the front of the boss room. It should lower revealing a new area. Continue through here until you are forced to parkour downwards using stone coffins as platforms. Near the bottom you will see a corpse that has Inescapable Frenzy on it.

title: Fingerprint Stone Shield
text: Fingerprint Stone Shield: Subterranean shunning grounds. Past the Altar you Fight mini boss version of Mohg. After defeating him you can roll/attack the altar behind the chest and it will move down out of the way revealing a path. If you have not defeated Morgott, the Omen King a seal will be blocking further progress. Following this path will lead you to the hardest part which is jumping from coffin to coffin to make your way down to the area. NOTE it is slightly above the bottom floor so do not jump off even if you will survive. If you miss that coffin, you will have to start from the beginning of the coffin descend all over to obtain the shield.

title: Iron Ball, Blackguard's Iron Mask
text: Head down the stairs, then drop to the bottom to discover the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace. Note: Don't interact with anything here, as doing so can lock you into a bad ending. It's better to return when choosing an ending after beating the game.
Note: Don't interact with anything here, as doing so can lock you into a bad ending. It's better to return when choosing an ending after beating the game.
Talk to Melina at the Frenzied Flame Proscription grace.
Roll through the illusory wall near Hyetta to reveal a chest with a Rune Arc.
Behind the chest is another illusory wall, which leads to the Root-Facing Cliffs grace.
Numen's Rune: Dropped by the Queen Ants, within the small cave you can access by one of the branches.
Smithing Stone [6]: Upgrade Material. Found up on a tree on the right.
Make your way down the roots to pick up Formic Rock from a corpse next to an ant.
On a lower root northwest of the corpse is a Golden Rune [8].
Continue down the roots, then double jump to a higher up root with a Golden Rune [8] at the tip.
On the ground below the three ants to the south lies a Golden Rune [5].
Drop onto the large root and pick up Golden Arrow x10 from the second branch on the left.
Talk to Roderika about the spirit's voices.
Read the message at Dung Eater's location in the library.
Talk to Blackguard near the outer moat about the Dung Eater.
Iron Ball: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart .
Blackguard's Iron Mask: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart ..
His weapon is equipped with Ash of War: Braggart's Roar. Remove it to make it available for compatible weapons.
Kill Dung Eater after he invades to obtain the Sword of Milos.
Return to Roderika and select "Please take care".
Exhaust Dung Eater's dialogue in the library.
Reload the area and talk to Roderika about the spirits' voices.
miss: Blackguard's Seedbed Curse cannot be obtained if you join Volcano Manor before hearing Rya's request.

title: Talk to Blackguard Big Boggart
text: Merchant who sells an item for Rya's quest and can also be summoned for the Magma Wyrm boss fight.

title: Flamedrake Talisman +1
text: Open the large door at the northeast end of the main street in Leyndell. Explore the area covered in ash to find Beast Blood x3.
Behind a building in the ash-covered area lies a Golden Rune [9].
Pick up Lightningproof Dried Liver from the corpse behind a carriage.
At the end of the ash-covered area, you'll find a Perfume Bottle.
Take a left when going up the stairs to find a corpse with Soporific Grease x2.
Behind a statue down the slope is a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Pick up Exalted Flesh and Nascent Butterfly x3 from the corpses by the stairs.
Flamedrake Talisman +1: Found on the ground, against a column. The path is a blocked by a magic barrier if Morgott has not been defeated. You can still reach it by going slightly
miss: Must be picked up before killing Maliketh. Must be picked up before killing Maliketh. Must be picked up before killing Maliketh. Must be picked up before killing Maliketh.

title: Boss: Fell Twins
text: Invigorating White Cured Meat 2x: Found on a body in the middle of the bridge.
Kill the scarab behind a broken statue to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [6].
Instead of using the lift at the end, explore the southeast bridge. When the area turns dark, grab the Golden Rune [9] in front.
Fell Twins: Field Boss encounter. A couple of bulky ogre-like beasts wielding flaming armaments. Drops the Omenkiller Rollo spirit ashes upon defeat.
Omenkiller Rollo: Spirit Ashes. Dropped by the Fell Twins bosses.
miss: Can only be picked up during the Fell Twins boss fight, as there is no way to return to the arena afterward.

title: Official's Attire
text: Activate the Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate grace outside the tower, then grab the Divine Tower of East Altus grace at the top.
Interact with the rune at the top of the tower to restore the power of Morgott's Great Rune.

Official's Attire: From the Forbidden Lands Site of Grace , turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Official's Attire is on the corpse in this hidden hallway alongside Blade of Calling .

place.title: Divine Tower of East Altus
notes: There is a Two Fingers on a mound of earth at the top of this tower, in the centre of eight meteorite fragments.

The door entering this divine tower faces south-southeast and the entrance to the top faces east-northeast, an angle of 90 degrees off entering the tower. The tower is covered with what appears to be molten rock on its east-northeast face (to the left as you enter it).

title: Blade of Calling
text: Blade of Calling: From the Forbidden Lands site of grace, turn back and head towards the elevator. Face southwest before activating the elevator, and then watch for an opening to jump off into. The Blade of Calling is on the table in the room at the end of this hall

title: Boss: Night's Cavalry
text: Drop down and head outside to grab the Forbidden Lands grace, then pass time until nightfall.
Drawstring Fire Grease: Turn back from the Forbidden Lands site of grace, head to the body to obtain x2 Drawstring Fire Grease
Follow the cliff edge on the right to find a Golden Rune [7] on top of a fallen pillar.
Climb the nearby rock wall with a giant skull to find Dragonwound Grease on a pillar.
Night's Cavalry: Roams the Forbidden Lands at night time, along the path to the Grand Lift of Rold . Drops the Ash of War: Phantom Slash upon defeat.
Ash of War: Phantom Slash: Ash of War. Dropped by the Night's Cavalry boss that roams the path towards the Grand Lift of Rold at night.

title: Golden Seed
text: Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material. Found in the Forbidden Lands on a corpse inside the giant skull on the hill before the encounter with Black Blade Kindred.
Golden Seed: From the Forbidden Lands Site of grace, move towards the Grand Lift of Rold . You'll eventually come across the Golden Seed.

title: Boss: Black Blade Kindred
text: Black Blade Kindred: Field Boss guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold . Drops the Gargoyle's Black Axe and Gargoyle's Black Blades upon defeat.
Gargoyle's Black Axe: Greataxe. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .
Gargoyle's Black Blades: Twinblades. Dropped by the Black Blade Kindred guarding the path to the Grand Lift of Rold .

title: Talk to Finger Reader
text: Finger Reader found at the base of the Grand Lift of Rold.

title: Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West
text: Millicent can be summoned if you gave her the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.
Pick up Freezing Grease from the area to the left of the large staircase.
Head up the stairs and grab the Grand Lift of Rold grace.
Hoist the medallion at the grand lift, then turn around after arriving to find Beast Blood x2 behind the lift.
Map Mountaintops of the Giants, West: As you leave the Grand Lift of Rold, take the path forward until you reach a stone monument on your right, interact with it to obtain the map Fragment.

title: Ronin's Set
text: Grab the Zamor Ruins grace on the ledge just ahead.
Ronin's Set: Dropped by Shabriri .
Talk to Melina at any grace after exhausting Shabriri's dialogue.

title: Talk to Shabriri
text: Npc that looks exactly like Bloody Finger Hunter Yura. He tells you about "a righteous path to ascension"

title: Zamor Ice Storm, Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Invigorating Cured Meat: Consumable. Found on a corpse on the eastern side of the ruins.
Zamor Ice Storm: Snow Witch Sorcery . Found on a corpse in the southern section of the Zamor Ruins , by a stone archway.
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3]: Key Item. Found in an underground area beneath the Zamor Ruins . The entrance is in the southwest section of the ruins.

title: Briars of Punishment
text: Pick up Invigorating Cured Meat from the lower end corner of the ruins.
At the upper end of the ruins is a corpse with Zamor Ice Storm.
Open the chest in the nearby cellar to obtain Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3].
Climb the rocky wall next to the cellar and follow the downhill path to a corpse with Sliver of Meat x2.
Next to a tree on the cliff overlooking the grand lift, you'll find a Golden Rune [10].
Return to the path and kill the scarab hanging behind a thorn totem on the left to obtain a Somber Smithing Stone [7].
Continue ahead until you reach a corpse with Smoldering Butterfly x4 next to a tree.
Pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from the ledge next to a Fire Prelate.

Briars of Punishment: Sorcery. Found at the leftmost dead tree next to three Lesser Fire Monks just before the long stone bridge with the Golem Archer at the end in the Mountaintops of the Giants region

title: Fire Monk Ashes, Ritual Pot +2
text: Grave Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : The first one is found by heading straight west from the Site of Grace, in the back wall of the room at the end. Back in the main path from the first lift, head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Continue along the path and then turn right in the room with the statue. Proceed through the hall with the guillotine traps and then take the first left in the next corridor to a room with several Land Squirts . Keep moving forward until you reach a small room at the end of the path with a large Living Jar . The second glovewort can be found pressed against the right wall here. From the last glovewort, backtrack into the previous hall and look for an opening in the alcove in the right. Drop down this opening and you will end up in a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you previously passed. Head west from the statue and follow the identical pathway through another set of guillotine traps, another room with Land Squirts and another small room at the end with a Living Jar . The final glovewort is found behind the door frame of this room, on the right.

Grave Glovewort [8]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. From here, continue east to a room with a set of stairs on the right and a Lesser Burial Watchdog . Check underneath the stairs for the first glovewort. Continue north from the first glovewort to a narrow corridor with a frost breath trap at the end. Turn left halfway through the corridor and pick up the second glovewort at the end of this path. Get back on the first lift and ascend back onto the main path. Head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Turn right in the room with the statue and you will wind up in a hall with guillotine traps. Past the guillotines, turn left in the next corridor and go through the room with several Land Squirts . In the next hall, you will see a small room in the back with a Living Jar guarding it. Ignore that room and instead, look for an alcove on the left that you can drop down through. You will end up on a balcony overlooking a room with a statue that looks identical to the one you have previously passed but this is an entirely different floor. Head west from the statue and you will end up in another identical hall filled with guillotine traps, except this time, you can see another statue in a room in the distance. The final glovewort is found next to this statue.

Grave Glovewort [8]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . One found in the large hall locked behind an Imp Statue barrier. This is directly above the flamethrower pillar and there is a hole in the ground where a section of the pillar can rise through. Upon reaching the lift, take it to the lower level and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When it's fully raised, you can find an opening in the lift column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and go inside the opening in the lift column to descend further down. At the bottom level, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn right to find the second glovewort behind a second Lesser Burial Watchdog . Directly after picking up the second glovewort, climb the long ladder in the alcove to the right to reach an otherwise inaccessible area far west of the Troll hall. You can find the third glovewort on the north wall up here.

Fire Monk Ashes: Spirit Ash. Found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Descend the first lift you find and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When fully raised, there is a second platform on the lift that will take you to the lowest levels of the catacombs. Continue through this path past two frost breath traps. The spell is found in a chest behind the second trap.

Ritual Pot: Crafting Pot. One found inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs : Head left from the Boss Doors and descend the dungeon's second lift. Continue along the path and then turn right in the room with the statue. Proceed through the hall with the guillotine traps and then take the first left in the next corridor to a room with several Land Squirts . Keep moving forward until you reach a small room at the end of the path with a large Living Jar . There is a corpse by the back wall holding the Ritual Pot .

Grave Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 2 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . By a set of steps opposite the first Lesser Burial Watchdog encountered. Upon reaching the lift, take it to the lower level and then step on the plate again to send it back up. When it's fully raised, you can find an opening in the lift column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and go inside the opening in the lift column to descend further down. At the bottom level, sprint past the Lesser Burial Watchdog and turn right. Climb the long ladder to the right of a second Lesser Burial Watchdog to reach an otherwise inaccessible area far west of the Troll hall. You can find the second glovewort on the west wall up here.
Nascent Butterfly: Material. Found atop a crumbled wall in Zamor Ruins
Root Resin: Consumable item. 4x Found on a corpse on the first trap room.

Grave Glovewort [9]: Upgrade material. 6 in total. First is found within the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs, in a room filled with imps. Another one is found in the room before taking the stairs to the second floor of the frost trap. Third is on second floor by the trap. A fourth is guarded by two Cleanrot Knights in a room in the second floor by the trap. A fifth one can be looted on the third floor by the lever to open the boss door. Final one is in a room in the second floor, guarded by a Burial Tree Watchdog.
Ulcerated Tree Spirit: Found within the Giant's Mountaintop Catacombs located in the Mountaintops of the Giants region. Droprs Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2] ,
Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2]: Bell Bearing. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit Boss fought inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs .
Deathroot: Key Item. Can be found inside a chest after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit Boss inside the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs .

title: Golden Seed
text: Head inside and grab the Giants' Mountaintop Catacomb grace.
Enter the room straight ahead for a Grave Glovewort [7].
Grave Glovewort [8]: Upgrade material. One is found in the first room with a frost trap.
After taking the new lift down, pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] below the stairs.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] from the room in the corridor with a frostbite pillar.
Hit the illusory wall on the right side of the corridor past the first pillar to reveal a Ghost Glovewort [7].
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Fire Monk Ashes.
Return to the lift and proceed forward until you reach a room with a Ritual Pot and a Grave Glovewort [7].
Grab the Stimulating Boluses in the previous room, then drop down the shaft to pick up a Nascent Butterfly from the ledge.
Drop down and follow the west path to a room with a Grave Glovewort [8] behind a Living Jar.
Pick up a Grave Glovewort [7] from the room at the end.

Grave Glovewort [9]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. A total of 3 can be found inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave . One is found behind the first Lesser Burial Watchdog encountered, in a room under the circle of light. When you reach the lift, take it down and then step on the plate again to send it up back up but jump off immediately. Once it's fully raised, you will see an opening in the column. Pull the lever in the nearby alcove and enter the opening in the lift. It will take you further down. At the bottom, check behind the lift column for the second glovewort.

place.title: Volcano Manor
walk: ## How to get to Volcano Manor
## Rya's Questline
## Abductor Virgin

Alternate route directly into Volcano Manor Hall: Right after you are captured by the Abductor Virgin, look to your right over the waterfall. The drop is non-lethal; it will take about 665 of your health (ignoring lava damage) instead. Go as far southeast along the cliff edge before jumping down into the lava below, then wade southeast down the lava (healing off any damage) until you reach a wooden platform with a cage lift. Ride this lift up, then look to your right to take a second lift up. Travel up the stairs, past the Blackflame Monk, but before you enter the church ahead (contains a boss fight with the Godskin Noble), look to your left for another flight of stairs going down. Descend it, push the lever to raise a metal bridge, then cross it to reach the Prison Town Church Site of Grace to enable fast travel out of this area. You can travel up the hidden back passage from behind the altar and hit an illusory wall at the end of a dead end which leads into a room in the Volcano Manor, but you'll be behind a locked door that can only be opened with the Drawing-Room Key, received on the other side.

Go back onto the bridge, then carefully hop onto one of the studs on the left side. From that, hop onto the wheel that hoisted up the bridge, and finally make a running (but difficult) jump onto the opposite balcony. You'll pick up a Somber Smithing Stone (7) from the corpse. Run for the door you see, past the Iron Virgin, and from indoors, head down the stairs to a room with a corpse holding a Seedbed Curse. Cross the long large room to pick up an Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve, then head up the stairs to open a door that leads into the Volcano Manor main hall.
## From Altus Plateau

Near the Corpse-Stench Shack, rather southeast of it, is a ladder which leads up the mountain. Ascend it and turn left to get to the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace. Dash through the camp full of frenzied soldiers, go past the Mad Pumpkin Head and go northwest along the narrow path. (This is where your route will merge with the other route highlighted in green in the diagram further above.)

Jump down to a ruined campsite, fight off a Grafted Scion and ascend the next ladder you see. Take the next ladder on your left which leads you to another merchant, then keep going up the mountain from his location. You'll reach a plateau with several frenzied Soldiers and a Knight. After you fight them off, look for a ramp that lets you descend to the plateau below. Look west for a bridge that leads you to the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace. Take either the ladder or Spiritspring Jump to the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast, go northwest and jump the gap going downhill, then keep descending downhill, making a U-turn and rushing past the Marionettes and Troll guard to reach Volcano Manor.
## Volcano Manor Assassination Quests

Before following her instructions and heading to the drawing-room, turn left and head up the stairs, where you'll find yourself in a grand dining hall. On your way to the far end of the hall, you'll get invaded by Inquisitor Ghiza. Defeat him for his weapon, Ghiza's Wheel, and collect the Smithing Stone [6] on the corpse where he spawned.
If you do not have access to Mountaintops of the Giants yet, keep reading to use the manor's illusory wall to proceed.
From here, you can continue reading on to navigate your way through the Volcano Manor's actual dungeon area, but if you'd rather take up Tanith's offer to skip ahead to the boss click here.
## Going through Volcano Manor's Illusory Wall

Follow the path through a room full of Serpent Snails and you'll end up with a room with two ways forward - one down a flight of steps, another through an open doorway to your left. Head left first, being wary of Serpent Snails that may ambush you and continue until you reach a dead end. The corpse at the end of this passageway has the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook (21) on it, and to the left of it, reveal another hidden door that opens up into a room with the Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes.

Go back to the room where you saw that flight of stairs and descend them to fight a Lesser Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Claws. Make sure you pick up the Fireproof Dried Liver here too, it may come in handy. Continue moving forward to get to a church with the Prison Town Church Site of Grace.
## Prison Town Church

Head back out of the building and turn right to cross the bridge where there's a Man-Serpent at the end. The building behind it is inaccessible from the front door, but ther are two ways in. Circle around the left side of the building and jump over the railing to find remains with Albinauric Bloodcot x1 and an open door to the right. Head inside, defeat the Albinaurics in chairs, and loot the Beast Blood. Open the door back to the bridge and circle around to the right. There's a Man-Serpent guarding a Smithing Stone [4] and a ladder. From up the ladder you can jump into an open window and land back in the room, but instead we're going to get a few hidden items. From the top of the ladder to used to reach the roof, run straight to the opposite edge of the roof and look down. You'll see a narrow balcony with a door in it. Jump down and carefully enter the dark room, which has the Albinauric Mask and Albinauric Staff, along with a powerful Lesser Omenkiller. The Lesser Omenkiller should have its back turned to you, allowing for an easy sneak attack. The first time you kill it, it will drop a Great Omenkiller Cleaver. Once you're finished in this room, look to the right of the door you first came through to find a side room that leads to a ladder down. Take the ladder, looting a Golden Rune [10], then continue forward to find yourself back at the entrance to the church. Enter it again and run to the south-eastern end of the church, opposite the bridge entrance, being careful of the fast moving crawling Albunauric on the stairway. Make your way down the stairs to the lower floor, then look behind them for a Golden Rune [9] guarded by four Crawling Albinaurics. Loot the Golden Rune [9], then head down the hallway. Beware the hanging Albinauric, who will summon a Crawling Albinauric, and the patrolling Man-Serpent. Make two rights and you'll find the Guest Hall Site of Grace.
## Guest Hall

Defeat it and take the lift directly to the north up. Turn right to pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [5] from a corpse then turn back around to ascend the flight of stairs. Don't enter the temple just yet! Right before you do, turn left to find the incomplete bridge you saw across the way earlier. On this side, there's a lever you can turn to lift the bridge piece from out of the lava, making a shortcut to this area from the Prison Town Church.
## Taking a Detour for Items

Scale up the roofs again to drop onto a wooden platform on which a Facing back toward the gate, there is a small courtyard to the left guarded by two dogs that leads to a broken staircase along the outer wall. Get a running start & jump across the broken segment to reach a corpse with a Stonesword Key (trying to drop down from the roof above the item is a fatal fall). After collecting the key, drop down & follow the path around the wall until you get to the place where a bunch of gravestones sit in cooled lava and loot the corpses in this area to collect items such as a Golden Rune [9], Smithing Stone [6] and the Smoldering Shield. Be careful of the living jars as several of the small jars will explode upon death causing heavy damage.

Teleport back to the Prison Town Church Site of Grace and cross the shortcut bridge. Head back down the stairs and the cage lift you took previously. Turn left and into the other cage lift in the area. This one takes you back down to lava-level and if you walk forward, a Magma Wyrm will pop out of the lava, which when defeated, will drop a Dragon Heart. In the far end of the cave, you'll be able to spot a corpse with a Smithing Stone [7] on it.

Head back off that small island, and enter the small opening in the wall to the west. Continue forward towards the building ruins, following the Burning Slugs along the way, and you'll find yourself back at the stairs that take you to the cage lifts. Take the northern cage lift back up to the temple and now we can head in.
## Miniboss: Godskin Noble

After reaching about 50% health, the Godskin Noble rises and explodes in a small area around him. He now has attacks that have wide AoEs and an unpredictable roll attack. His skills are still widely telegraphed, so time your dodges well. Defeat him and you'll be rewarded with his weapon, the Godskin Stitcher, and the Noble Presence Incantation.
## Completing the rest of the Dungeon

Head back and go to the balcony. If you look down, you'll be able to see a mountain ledge you can safely jump down to. Follow the Burning Slugs northeast until you get to a corpse sitting on the mountain's edge that has a Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Turn left and you'll see another ledge you can safely jump down to. Follow the path until you see a Abductor Virgin in front of a building with an open window. Fight it or run through the window. At the southern side of the room, you'll find a ladder you can descend. There will be a Drawstring Fire Grease on the corpse here. Follow the stairs down and you'll find the Missionary's Cookbook (6). Backtrack back up the stairs and the ladder. There's a door on the west side of this room that opens up to a bridge.

Jump into the left side to get Crimson Tear Scarab. Jump once more and move counter-clockwise to come back where you were before. Go back to the bridge and head up the stairs but before going into the building, turn right and jump off the stairs, where you'll find a Teardrop Scarab that drops a Somber Smithing Stone [5]. If you have been doing doing Rya's quest, look west and you can find a room where she can be found, you can make your decision on whether or not to kill or spare her here, visit her page to read up on her quest line. Back out of the room, hug the wall and follow the cooled lava further to the north (be careful of enemies along the way), you will then encounter a room rife with Basilisks, five to be exact, kill them quickly, and do not stay in one spot as you can be caught in their breaths and be turned to stone. If needed, kill one or two, run out of the room and back south, wait until your petrification buildup goes away, then return and repeat the process until they're all gone. Grab a Somber Smithing Stone [6] and head back south to the entrance to the room where you found Rya. In front of Rya's room, look southeast and you will find an open window next to the lava waterfall, go through it and grab a Stonesword Key. Head through Rya's room to find a ladder that takes you back up to where you're supposed to go. Head right first to activate the elevator to make a shortcut to Temple of Eiglay site of grace.

You'll come across a Man-Serpent with a fiery whip. Before fighting it, don't forget to get a Commoner's Headband lying on one of protruding stones on your right. Head through the door behind him and then through another set of closed doors on your right. On the altar protected by some enemies is the Man-Serpent Ashes. Head up the first set of stairs and before going up the second set, turn around to go up the flight of stairs behind you.

Through the doorway found on this floor is an imp statue that has to be unlocked with two Stonesword Keys. You'll find cages here you can jump down to, but before doing that, turn right and drop down to the platform below. Follow the path, head up the stairs, and in the next room, you'll find the Dagger Talisman. You will see some cages which you can jump atop, do so and drop further down onto the wooden platform, kill the enemy here, and look down to the northeast to find more cages to drop onto. After dropping down a few cages, you'll be on stable grounds again, look southwest for a room full weak enemies and a Seedbed Curse on a corpse, be careful as they can overwhelm you. After grabbing the item, turn left to ascend a flight of stairs and after defeating the Abductor Virgin here, you can collect a Somber Smithing Stone [7] off of a corpse draped over the broken part of the banister. Head back into the building and continue north-east where you'll a corpse with the Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve.

If you continue on this path, you'll eventually make it back to the entrance of the Volcano Manor, unlocking the door in front of Patches. Teleport back to the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace and retrace your steps back to the room with the Man-Serpent Ashes. Climb up both flights of stairs and you'll find a waygate. This takes you to the Site of Grace right outside the fog door to the God-Devouring Serpent/Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy boss fight, the same place Tanith teleports you to if you complete all three assassination requests. Rest at the Site of Grace and when you're ready, head through the fog door.

If you've been following the walkthrough, and for completion, it's recommended you finish the Royal Capital to get access to the Mountaintops of the Giants to get to the final assassination, the Red Letter, before facing Rykard. The NPCs of Volcano Manor will be forever changed after killing the following boss, so be sure to check their quest lines before doing so.
## Facing Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy

Upon Rykard's defeat, you will receive the Remembrance of the Blasphemous and Rykard's Great Rune. The Eye Surcoat can also be picked up from the right side of the arena and the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace will be accessible.
## Returning to the Inhabitants of the Volcano Manor

At this point, if you teleport back to Rykard's boss arena, you'll find Tanith feasting upon his remains. You can choose to attack her, and if you do so her knight, Tanith's Knight, will invade you. Upon his defeat, he will drop the Aspect of the Crucible: Breath Incantation, and Tanith's clothing set consisting of the Consort's Mask, Consort's Robe, and Consort's Trousers. Doing this too early prevents you from completing Patches' quest however. With this, the Volcano Manor Legacy Dungeon is complete.
