Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse inside a room at the northern end of the ring walkway in the east. Guarded by a Crystalian .
Pickled Turtle Neck: Consumable. Found on a corpse in a dark building in the northeast, guarded by 3 Crystalians. This room is in the bottom level of the area.
Pick up Beast Blood x3 from a room on the side of the road.
Pick up the Aeonian Butterfly x4 behind a tower and the Golden Rune [12] in front of an imp seal.
Marika's Soreseal: Talisman . Found on an altar in a room requiring 2 Stonesword Keys to unlock. This room is in the southeast, on the lower levels.

title: Rotten Crystal Sword
text: Rotten Crystal Sword: Straight Sword . Found in a chest guarded by 3 Crystalians . From the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, head down the steps and jump over the rubble on the left. You can engage the Crystalians one by one by luring them to the hallway.

title: Golden Seed
text: Hero's Rune [5]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a large decorative chalice at the end of the hallway after the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.
Head up the root and turn left where the rot begins to find a corpse with Rot Grease.
Follow the roots past the rot, then go through the doorway for a Golden Rune [10].
Descend the ladder and grab the Drainage Channel grace just ahead.

Great Grave Glovewort: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in the center of the second lake of rot, past a second set of branches inside the inner walls. Beware the Ulcerated Tree Spirit lurking beneath.
Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit lurking beneath the second lake of rot, past a second set of branches within the inner walls.

region: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree · meeting 6 of 6
title: Talk to Millicent
text: NPC. Millicent will be available at the Prayer Room Grace at�� Elphael Brace of the Haligtree . She will not move from this spot until the player has defeated a�� Ulcerated Tree Spirit ��mini-boss just before the Drainage Channel Grace. Go up the slope, up the stairs, up the hill, and then across the branch to reach the boss arena.��

title: Millicent's Prosthesis
text: Ask Gowry why he's crying, then select "Become a flower?".
Millicent's Prosthesis: When you are given the choice between assisting Millicent and challenging her, choose to challenge her. When you kill her, you will automatically receive this talisman.

title: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
text: Challenge Millicent: Note: By choosing this option, you lock yourself out of being able to remove the frenzied flame. Use the red summon sign and kill Millicent for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Millicent's Prosthesis. Loot the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing from Gowry's corpse.
Note: By choosing this option, you lock yourself out of being able to remove the frenzied flame.
Use the red summon sign and kill Millicent for a Rune Arc, Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and Millicent's Prosthesis.
Loot the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing from Gowry's corpse.

Assist Millicent: Use the gold summon sign and help Millicent kill her sisters to receive the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia. Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the pond. Reload the area and loot the Unalloyed Gold Needle from her corpse. Kill Gowry for the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing.
Use the gold summon sign and help Millicent kill her sisters to receive the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.
Exhaust Millicent's dialogue next to the pond. Reload the area and loot the Unalloyed Gold Needle from her corpse.
Kill Gowry for the Flock's Canvas Talisman and Gowry's Bell Bearing.

Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman: Talisman. Found in a chest on an elevated platform inside the large building in the northeast, guarded by several Pests. This platform can be reached by heading through the eastern exit from the Drainage Channel site of grace and then navigating across the branches and concrete beams to reach the roof of the building. While there are many branches and beams to traverse, the path is fairly linear. Once on the roof, drop through one of the holes onto the wooden beams below and then carefully make your way onto the platform after killing the Pests from range.

title: Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Drop to the lower ledge on the east side to pick up a Nascent Butterfly from the top balcony.
Pick up Aeonian Butterfly from a corpse on the bottom floor balcony.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in a cluster of graves far to the northeast.
Ghost Glovewort [8]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the southwest end of the graveyard in the northeast of the city.
Ghost Glovewort [7]: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found on a grave in the western section of the graveyard northeast of the city.
Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]: Key Item. Found on a corpse in the western section of the graveyard in the northeast of the city.

title: Traveler's Set
text: Head back and explore the graveyard on the opposite side to find a corpse with Arteria Leaf x3.
Hero's Rune [5]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse under a large tree in the eastern graveyard.
Return to the building and ride the lift down to discover the Haligtree Roots grace.

Traveler's Set: Armor Set comprised of Traveler's Clothes , Traveler's Manchettes and Traveler's Boots . All three pieces are found deep underground in a side room with a large orange flower, adjacent to the Haligtree Roots site of grace. This area can be reached by taking the lift from the large building in the northeast.

title: Boss: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
text: Grab the shortcut lift back to the rampart with an Erdtree Avatar.
Malenia, Blade of Miquella: Demigod. Found past a fog door southwest of the Haligtree Roots Site of Grace.
Malenia's Great Rune: Great Rune. Dropped by Malenia, Blade of Miquella upon defeat.
Remembrance of the Rot Goddess: Key Item. Dropped by Malenia, Blade of Miquella upon defeat.

title: Omen Set
text: Activate the Malenia, Goddess of Rot grace and rest at it to reload the area.
If you assisted Millicent, return the needle to Malenia's scarlet bloom to receive Miquella's Needle and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
Use the sending gate at the Divine Bridge in Leyndell, then ascend the tower to grab the Isolated Divine Tower grace.
Restore the power of Malenia's Great Rune at the top of the tower.
Return to Dung Eater in his cell and use the five Seedbed Curses to receive the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
Omen Set: Drops from Dung Eater if defeated in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds .
Talk to Gideon Ofnir about the Haligtree roots to receive Lord's Divine Fortification.
miss: Unobtainable if you join Volcano Manor before hearing Rya's request AND don't loot the Seedbed Curse in the collapsed-roof building in Leyndell before killing Maliketh.

title: Talk to Dung Eater
text: Quest NPC. Found in a cell in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds beneath the Royal Capital. To reach his cell, head northeast from the Underground Roadside site of grace and enter a grate in the floor to access the aqueducts. Continue north past the Rats and Giant Poison Flower and climb up the ladder. You can find the cell door in the next room past the ladder. It is unlocked using the Sewer-Gaol Key given by the same NPC but in his non-corporeal form at the Roundtable Hold .

title: Boss: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
text: Can be found in the 2nd Lower Floor, in Leyndell Royal Capital.

title: Ancient Dragon Prayerbook
text: At the Four Belfries, unlock the imp-sealed belfry marked by the message "Crumbling Lands". Use the sending gate, then grab the Pearldrake Talisman on the bottom platform.
Travel to Fire Giant and cross the chain to the forge. Activate the Forge of the Giants grace at the north end of the forge.
Talk to Melina at the Forge of the Giants grace and tell her that you're ready. If you bear the frenzied flame, listen to the sounds of flame.
Grab the Smithing Stone [8] at the end of the bridge and a Golden Rune [9] from a platform below it.
Pick up the Old Fang x3 near an unlit brazier in the room with several Azula Beastmen.
A corpse with Lightningproof Dried Liver lies in the corner of the next room.
Head left in the corridor to grab the Crumbling Beast Grave grace.
Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the Farum Azula Dragon that swoops in to attack as you make your way along the curved platform.
Smithing Stone [6] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse along the middle of the curved bridge/platform.
Smithing Stone [8] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse along the curved bridge/platform. Before reaching it, a Farum Azula Dragon will swoop in and attack.
Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. On a corpse hanging off the edge of the curved platform.

Smithing Stone [8] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a roofed section on the left as you reach the end of the curved platform. Directly opposite the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.
Smithing Stone [7] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a sarcophagus closest to the balcony in the next room after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. A set of 3 found on a sarcophagus in the upper level of the large building. To reach this area, head out of the balcony of the room after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and jump up onto the roof right next to it. You can enter the building's upper level from here.

Smithing Stone [6] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a crumbled section of the upper floor of the large building northwest from the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. To reach this upper level, head out of the balcony of the next room from the site of grace and jump up onto the red roof right next to it. You can enter the building's upper level from here.

Great Grave Glovewort: Spirit Ash Upgrade Material. Found in a recess in the northeastern-most wall of the upper level of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths . To reach this upper area, head out of the balcony of the room next to the site of grace and jump up onto the red roof right next to it. You can head into the building's upper level from here.

Lightning Greatbolt: Ammunition. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse on a small upper balcony connected to the rotunda structure northeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. To get up here, drop down the large roof south of the gazebo and then down to the walkway in the east. Check the northeast edge of this walkway to find a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda's lower balcony where you can ride the lift to the top level. The corpse is guarded by a Beastman .

Golden Rune [12] E: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse at the edge of some floating debris in the northern section of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Look for one of the chunks facing southward to find the corpse holding the rune.
Ancient Dragon Prayerbook: Incantation Tome. Found at ground level in the middle of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

title: Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]
text: Hero's Rune [2]: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse sitting by the wall next to the staircase to the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace.

Smithing Stone [8] F: Found on a corpse at the edge of the large stone platform behind the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. To reach this platform, head into the terrace southwest of the building and take the lift to the cliffs below. Navigate the floating debris north of the lift. Beware as a Farum Azula Dragon will swoop in and ambush you from behind as you pick up the item.

Fulgurbloom: Crafting Material. A set of 4 can be found on a corpse by a tree behind the western-most broken bridge along the southern cliffs. This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs.

Somber Smithing Stone [9] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse under a tree by the cliffside south of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the building.

Smithing Stone [8] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse sitting at the edge of the broken bridge atop the arch ruins, guarded by a Lesser Wormface . This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs. There is a ladder that you can climb on the back side of the arch to get on top.

Rejuvenating Boluses: Consumable. Found on a corpse in the center of the shallow pond infested with Lesser Wormfaces . This area can be reached by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

Smithing Stone [8] E: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on the eastern edge of the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces . You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [3]: Key Item. Found inside a gazebo by the shallow pond infested by Lesser Wormfaces . You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the southern cliffs.

title: Boss: Wormface
text: Boss. Located in Crumbling Farum Azula

title: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]
text: Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse far to the east of the southern cliffs. You can reach this area by taking the lift in the terrace southwest of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace and then navigating the slopes and pathways by the cliffs.
Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]: Key Item. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs by the Tempest-Facing Balcony .

title: Stonesword Key
text: Golden Rune [9] B: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse behind a stone column after dropping down the floating platforms north of the Tempest-Facing Balcony .

Somber Smithing Stone [7] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris, on the eastern edge of the heavily-ruined section between the Tempest-Facing Balcony and the Dragon Temple .

Golden Arrow: Bow Ammunition. A set of 14 found on a corpse at the edge of a floating platform adjoined to a long chunk of debris as you traverse the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple .

Golden Rune [10]: Rune Consumable. Found by dropping into a pit in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple . This pit leads to a narrow hallway below. Turn around as you drop into the hallway to find a corpse sitting along the edge which contains the rune.

Golden Rune [12] F: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple , right next to where Alexander is standing if you followed his questline. To get up here, you need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section.

Great Grave Glovewort: Upgrade Material. After dropping down the pit into a narrow hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple , head into the first archway on the left and up the stairs heading northwest to a ruined balcony where you can navigate across a series of floating debris to reach a second balcony with a ladder. Head up the ladder to reach a hidden tomb with the glovewort sitting on the main sarcophagus in the back.
Gravel Stone: Crafting Material. A set of 3 found on a corpse in the roofed hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple .
Somber Smithing Stone [9] B: Upgrade Material. Found under a leaning pillar in the heavily-ruined section just before jumping towards the Dragon Temple .
Continue across the gap to grab the Dragon Temple grace.
Golden Rune [11] A: Rune Consumable. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, go through the archway ahead and immediately turn left to collect the rune on a corpse by a collapsed pillar.
Smithing Stone [6] C: Upgrade Material. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, take the path on the right to find the rune on a corpse hanging off the edge of the broken passage.

Stonesword Key: Key Item. Found on a corpse in a semi-open area in the back of the temple to the east. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the temple and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right when you can and then another left into a long hallway. The said area is to the left at the end of this hallway and the corpse can be found in the crumbled edge past the pillars.

title: Azula Beastman Ashes
text: Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 on a corpse near the center of the Dragon Temple which can only be accessed by circling around the back of the temple in the east. From the site of grace, head inside the archway and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right and another left into a very long hallway. At the end of this hallway is a semi-outdoors area with pillars and a set of stairs on the left. Head up the stairs and follow the hallway to find a corpse holding the item on a ledge on the left in the crumbled section at the end.

Golden Rune [12] C: Rune Consumable. Found on the broken spiral staircase in the center of the Dragon Temple . Requires circling around the back of the temple in the east to reach it. From the Dragon Temple site of grace, head inside the archway and turn right then down the stairs on the left. Take another right and then a left into a long hallway that leads to a semi-open area with pillars and a set of stairs on the left. Head up the stairs and follow the hallway to a crumbled section where you can jump onto the aforementioned spiral staircase. The rune is found on a corpse on the top end of it.

Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on a corpse near a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

Azula Beastman Ashes: Spirit Ashes. Found at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. The ashes can be found on the sarcophagus in the back.

title: Boss: Godskin Duo
text: Somber Smithing Stone [9] C: Upgrade Material. Found in the southwest at the bottom level of the Dragon Temple accessed by turning around to face west from the Site of Grace and then jumping down the crumbled ledges below. From here, head into the central archway and then turn right to find a crypt with several sarcophagi. Go through the archway in the west to an outdoor area where you can find a corpse holding the stone between two pillars.
Head through the east corridor to discover the Dragon Temple Transept grace.

Godskin Duo: The Godskin Apostle and Godskin Noble are encountered once again in a simultaneous boss encounter in the center of the Dragon Temple . Drops Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (4) and Ashes of War: Black Flame Tornado upon defeat.
Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado: Ash of War. Dropped by the Godskin Duo upon defeat.
Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4]: Key Item. Dropped by the Godskin Duo upon defeat.

title: Golden Seed
text: Bernahl's summon sign can be found at the entrance near the grace.
Activate the Dragon Temple Altar grace after the fight.

Golden Rune [11] B: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge north of the Dragon Temple . After defeating the Godskin Duo bosses and unlocking the Dragon Temple Altar site of grace, head directly north through the stairs and then drop down one level below from the edges. Head through the archway in the west which connects to the platform where the corpse holding the rune can be found.
Old Fang: Crafting Material. A set of 5 can be found on a corpse hanging off the crumbled floor of a ruined building north of the Dragon Temple .
Hero's Rune [5] B: Rune Consumable. One found on a corpse by an outer ledge behind a wall. You can get to the ledge by carefully walking on the broken section while hugging the wall.

Smithing Stone [7] C: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper cliff east of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple. From the lift, head east and down the stairs past a tree. Climb up the ledges to reach the top of the cliff and collect the stone.

Lightning Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 5 can be found behind the narrow path laden with dragon statues. Traverse the length of the path and then turn left at the end to get to the backside, behind the wall. The items are found on a corpse near the southern end of this area.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a floating platform north of the Dragon Temple , guarded by a Beastman . From the north end of the temple, navigate your way through the floating debris to a narrow path laden with dragon statues, at the end of which you will find a spiral staircase on the right. Head up these stairs and then turn towards the south to find a floating pillar adjoining the aforementioned floating platform. Use the pillar to get up to the platform and collect the stone.

Somber Smithing Stone [9] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on an upper level balcony in the northern section past the Dragon Temple . From the north end of the temple, navigate your way across the floating debris to a narrow path laden with dragon statues, at the end of which you will find a spiral staircase on the right side. Head up these stairs and continue west to a balcony with a sealed Imp Statue barrier and several fallen pillars. The corpse holding the stone can be found behind one of these pillars.
Unlock the imp seal and take the lift up to reach the Dragon Temple Lift grace.
Lord's Rune: Rune Consumable. Found atop the fountain located just outside the Dragon Temple Lift , after ascending the lift into the plaza.
Nascent Butterfly: Crafting Materia. A set of 2 found on a corpse under a tree east of the fountain plaza. This area is accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.
Smithing Stone [7] B: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse behind a fallen pillar in the northern section past a narrow path laden with dragon statues.

Golden Rune [12] D: Rune Consumable. Found on an upper level east of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple. From the lift, head east and down the stairs past a tree. Climb up the ledges at the end of the path to reach the upper level and head south. The rune is found on a corpse under a tree in this area.

Smithing Stone [8] H: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse at the edge of the cliffs southeast of the fountain plaza, past a gazebo and a tree. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

Rune Arc: Consumable. Found on the northeastern edge of the Dragon Temple , at the bottom level. To reach this, turn around from the Dragon Temple site of grace and face west. Drop down by using the crumbled ledges below and then head north to find the corpse holding the item by one of the crumbled pillars.

Golden Seed: Flask Upgrade Material. Found under a Phantom Tree by some pillars south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

title: Golden Lightning Fortification
text: Golden Lightning Fortification: Incantation . Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab by the cliffs south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

title: Shard of Alexander
text: Smithing Stone [8] G: Upgrade Material. One found on a corpse in front of a sleeping dragon, far south of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

Dragonwound Grease: Weapon Coating. A set of 2 can be found on a corpse by the very edge of the cliffs southwest of the fountain plaza. This is in an upper area accessed after ascending the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple.

Golden Rune [12] B: Rune Consumable. After dropping down the pit into a narrow hallway in the heavily-ruined section leading to the Dragon Temple , ignore the first archway on the left and enter the second one instead. The rune is on a corpse at the edge of the crumbled section here.
Note: If you haven't progressed his questline, you'll see a sleeping dragon instead of Alexander.
Shard of Alexander: Drops from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline.

title: Talk to Iron Fist Alexander
text: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula. From the Dragon Temple Lift grace (can be accessed by using two Stonesword Keys), go past the plaza full of undead up the flight of stairs, turn right and you'll see two square bracket shaped archways. Jump on the archway on the left (closest to the dragon) to get over to the other side. Alexander can be found directly on the flat arena after crossing the crumbling tower. He will challenge you to a warrior's duel, and if you win, he will reward you with Alexander's Innards and Shard of Alexander. If you lose, he will continue letting you challenge him until you win.

title: Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4]
text: Smithing Stone [7] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse in the second large segment of the upper crumbled section west of the Dragon Temple . To get up here, you need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section.

Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4]: Cookbook found in a gazebo-like structure high above in the heavily-crumbled section in the northwest. To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to the gazebo where the cookbook can be looted off a corpse.

title: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2
text: Somber Smithing Stone [8] A: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple . To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to a gazebo-like structure. Head slightly north from the gazebo to find the corpse that holds the stone, hanging off the right edge.

Smithing Stone [8] I: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse hanging off a ledge in the upper crumbled segment west of the Dragon Temple . To get up here, you will first need to ascend the Dragon Temple Lift northwest of the temple and then head south from the fountain plaza until you reach the Phantom Tree surrounded by pillars. From here, head west and use the top of another group of pillars to make your way to the start of the upper crumbled section. You will need to traverse the massive floating chunks of debris, heading further west. Once you get to the second large chunk, look in the northwest section of it for a series of makeshift stone bridges that will lead you to a gazebo-like structure. Head slightly north from the gazebo to find a corpse holding a Somber Smithing Stone [8] and then drop off the edge onto a small floating platform below to pick up the Smithing Stone [8] .
Talk to Jar-Bairn and give him Alexander's Insides. Exhaust his dialogue, then reload the area to find the Companion Jar on the porch.
Talk to Enia now that you've burned the Erdtree.
Talk to Roderika in front of the fireplace.
Exhaust Hewg's dialogue about the god-slaying weapon and ask him why he's still making weapons.
Talk to Roderika about Hewg.
Return to Hewg and ask him what happened to her.
Talk to Gideon Ofnir and exhaust his dialogue option.

Golden Rune [12] A: Rune Consumable. Found on a corpse hanging off a crumbled ledge outside of the large building next to the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths site of grace. This can be reached through an exit in the northwest section of the building.

Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2: Upgraded Talisman. Found on a corpse on a chunk of floating debris in the north of the region. From the Dragon Temple Lift site of grace, take the lift back down and then head east and down the spiral staircase. Around halfway down the steps where you see some broken railings, jump off the edge to a series of floating debris below. Once you reach the lowest platforms, turn around and look for a small platform underneath one of the upper ones to find the corpse with the talisman.
miss: Becomes unobtainable if you kill Alexander before dueling him in Farum Azula.

title: Drake Knight Set
text: Turn right up the stairs to find a corpse with Dappled Cured Meat.
Smithing Stone [8] J: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse on a floating section of the plaza with the fallen dragon statue, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace.
Grab the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace on the rooftop below.
Smithing Stone [6] D: Upgrade Material. Found on a corpse northeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace, in front of a large rotunda building in the rooftop gardens.

Drake Knight Set: Armor Set comprised of the Drake Knight Helm , Drake Knight Armor , Drake Knight Gauntlets and the Drake Knight Greaves . This set can be acquired once you reach the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. Use the red roof below the grace to reach the rooftop garden-like area in the northeast which has a rotunda structure with a lift inside. The lift can't be used initially so drop down onto the large red roof to the south, then down the walkway to the east. Check along the northeast edge of this walkway for a platform you can jump onto to reach the rotunda building's lower balcony. The armor set can be found in a chest at the northeast end of this balcony.

title: Golden Seed
text: Ride the lift to the top to find Lightning Greatbolt x5 next to the balustrade.
Drop off during the ride back down and pick up Arteria Leaf x3 from a patch of flowers down the ladder.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: Upgrade Material. Dropped by the stationary Farum Azula Dragon sitting at the back of the plaza southeast of the Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace. The dragon is constantly raining red lightning around the area.

title: Frenzied Flame Seal
text: Frenzied Flame Seal: Weapon. Reward from completing Hyetta's Questline. Hyetta can be finally found at Frenzied Flame Proscription, Leyndell, Royal Capital. Upon accepting the Three Fingers flame, return to Hyetta and talk to her once more. Exhaust her dialogue, and she will give you the Frenzied Flame Seal, completing her questline.

Ending 1: Touch the fractured Marika and select one of the four options: A: Mend the Elden Ring to achieve the Age of Fracture ending. B: Use Mending Rune of Perfect Order to achieve the Age of Order ending. C: Use Mending Rune of the Death-Prince to achieve the Age of the Duskborn ending. D: Use Mending Rune of the Fell Curse to achieve the Blessing of Despair ending.
A: Mend the Elden Ring to achieve the Age of Fracture ending.

C: Use Mending Rune of the Death-Prince to achieve the Age of the Duskborn ending.
D: Use Mending Rune of the Fell Curse to achieve the Blessing of Despair ending.
Ending 2: Summon Ranni to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.
Ending 3: Touch the fractured Marika while bearing the frenzied flame to achieve the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.

To get all three endings in one playthrough, it's required to make backups of your save file: Note: Look up how to create backups on your specific platform, as blindly messing with save files can result in losing all your progress. If you don't have Miquella's Needle, you must pick the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending last. Otherwise, it will lock the other endings. This means you'll have to grab the other endings first using backups in between before finishing Hyetta's questline. The following steps assume that you pick the Frenzied Flame ending first and tame it afterward. Talk to Hyetta at the Frenzied Flame Proscription. Unequip your armor, then open the charred door to inherit the frenzied flame. Touch Hyetta with the flame and exhaust her dialogue until she catches fire, dropping the Frenzied Flame Seal and Frenzyflame Stone x5. Before choosing an ending, quit the game and make a copy of your save file. With your copied file ready, touch the fractured Marika to become the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Replace your save file with the copied one, then use Miquella's Needle (Inventory -> Tools) in Dragonlord Placidusax's arena to tame the flame of frenzy. Make a new copy of the save file, then go with either of the two remaining endings. Replace your save with the new copy and complete the game with the last ending.

The Belurat Gaol is a location situated under the Belurat Tower Settlement, to find the entrance of the prison area, head west from the Abandoned Ailing Village or the Greatbridge, North Site of Grace. You'll easily identify when you're near the entrance when you arrive at the area that is surrounded with water and prison cages. As you enter the depths of the prison, you will find the Belurat Gaol Site of Grace and a Summoning Pool on the right side of the Site of Grace.

This area has enemies such as Shadow Undead enemies, large and small variations of the Living Jar, and Jar Innards. This area is also a good place to farm or find Frozen Maggots The objective is to reach the bottom-most section of the gaol where a mini-boss is waiting.

Continue until the floor collapses, then follow the only path forward in the maze to find Lost Ashes of War in front of some boxes.

place.title: Fog Rift Catacombs
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Fog Rift Catacombs Walkthrough Video Guide
ER Shadow of the Erdtree Death Knight Boss Guide

Fog Rift Catacombs is located west of the Church of Crusade and north of Fog Rift Fort. The entrance of the catacombs leads to an elevator that goes down. You'll immediately find the Fog Rift Catacombs Site of Grace and a tunnel path straight ahead. Head through the tunnel entrance and prepare yourself for an Imp that will ambush you. At the upper right side of the room is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [1].

After retrieving that item, turn left through another tunnel entrance which leads to a large open room. Upon exiting the tunnel, immediately turn left towards a safe spot because half of the room is rigged with a spike trap that descends from above. Wait for it to come down, and once it goes up, immediately run to the other side where a Lion Head Goblin is waiting for you. Take out the Goblin and head straight to the next tunnel entrance leading to a large hallway. Turn right and head straight towards the stairs going down, but before heading down, pick up the Yellow Fulgurbloom to your left.

After collecting the plant, head down the stairs and turn right into another tunnel in the catacombs. You'll see a corpse that gives you the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] along with a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant. Head back to where you turned right earlier, and this time, turn left down another set of stairs. This will lead you to what looks like a dead-end ledge, but wait a few seconds for the spike trap from earlier to fall down. Once it falls, hop on top of it, and it will lead you to a secret platform with a Lion Head Goblin, a corpse that gives you x3 Knot Resin, and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

After looting the platform, hop on the spike trap again, but don't go back yet. Instead, wait for the spike trap to take you back up again, and this time, look for a tunnel entrance to the left that you can drop onto. Once you enter the tunnel and the room, turn left again until you cross a bridge and a set of stairs going up. Here, you'll encounter Messmer Soldiers guarding a room. Head inside the room after defeating the Messmer Soldiers, and you'll face a Black Knight. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the Great Ghost Glovewort. Go outside the room, then turn left to jump on top of a spiked platform, then go through a hallway. Follow the pathway and you will find the Black Knight Commander Andreas summon at the end.

Make your way back to where you first saw the spike area from a ledge. Instead of hopping back on, wait for it to drop and go up. Then immediately drop down and enter the tunnel entrance behind you. The small room here contains a Yellow Fulgurbloom. Inside the room on the left side is a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and follow the tunnel path with three Yellow Fulgurblooms.

After looting the plants, walk to the right and drop down to the area from earlier where you saw the spike trap. Drop down again and stand at the tunnel entrance behind you from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, then immediately run to the other side where a set of stairs goes down. Here, you'll find a corpse that gives you x2 Dragonbolt Grease.

Head down the stairs to find another elevator that goes further down. Upon reaching the ground, head straight towards a room with two Lion Head Goblins and loot the corpse and plant under the stairs to get x4 Rada Fruit and a Yellow Fulgurbloom. From under the stairs, head straight towards the tunnel entrance on the other side of the room, but loot two more Yellow Fulgurblooms to the left.

Inside the small room, clear out the two enemies and loot the corpse on the upper right for a Grave Glovewort [2]. After looting the corpse, head out of the room and turn right towards another tunnel entrance with stairs going further down. This leads to an open hallway with spike traps covering half of the hallway. Just as before, run to the left towards a safe space, kill the imp waiting for you there, and wait for the spike trap to drop. Once it drops, hug the wall and run straight until you see a hole to the left where you can drop down into what appears to be a sewage area. Once you land in the sewage, head straight for the tunnel entrance ahead and loot the corpse for a Ghost Glovewort [4].

On the left side of the first sewage room is an entrance to another room. Enter and turn left towards another room containing five Yellow Fulgurblooms and a corpse that drops an Electrocharge. Exit that room, turn left towards a ladder going up. Climb the ladder and drop down from the platform to find yourself near the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run towards the other end of the hallway. Get to the second safe spot to the left, past the hole you dropped into earlier, and loot the corpse there to get a Glass Shard. Wait for the spike trap to drop again, then run towards the stairs leading to a casket above that you can loot for a Shadow Realm Rune [3].

Once you're done looting, stay on the ledge of the platform you're standing on in front. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and you'll see a small square space on the side of the spike trap that you can hop onto. Hop onto the square platform and let the spike trap raise you to a secret platform above with a chest containing the Ash of War: Blinkbolt. After looting, hop on top of the spike trap again and run to the other side until you see a small platform to the right to drop onto. You'll see an altar that changes the Stone-Sheathed Sword to the Sword of Darkness.

To the left is a ladder going down. This ladder leads to a secret room with a corpse that gives you a Ghost Glovewort [5]. Loot it, then immediately look to the left to see another hole to drop into. This hole will drop you back to a safe spot from the hallway spike trap from earlier. Wait for the spike trap to drop, and once it does, run to the other side this time instead of the platform from earlier. Be careful in the safe area here as it connects to another spike trap area.

Wait for the spike trap on the other side to drop, then cross towards a tunnel entrance. Loot the corpse in the middle first for a Broken Rune. Head through the tunnel entrance to find another elevator that goes down. Drop here and head straight until you reach the yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss. For a comprehensive boss guide on the Death Knight, you may go to this page.

Reach the room with a Bigmouth Imp firing at you from a ledge, then grab the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [1] from the east corridor.
Trigger the impaling mechanism down the opposite room without dropping, then jump onto it to reach a ledge with Knot Resin x3.
Go through the corridor on top of the mechanism to reach a room with a Great Ghost Glovewort.
Approach the closest arch outside the room without dropping to trigger the impaling mechanism, then jump across it to reach a coffin with Black Knight Commander Andreas.
Return to the room with the Bigmouth Imp on a ledge, then pick up Dragonbolt Grease x2 from the west room floor.
Take the lift down, then pick up Rada Fruit x4 from the corpse below the staircase.

Anvil Hammer: Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Use the column you have lowered with the lever as a bridge and climb it until the end. Beware of the fire blob, and then at the top, turn right and jump to reach the stairs. Climb them up and interact with a furnace to obtain this weapon and an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

Beware of the fire blob, and then at the top, turn right and jump to reach the stairs. Climb them up and interact with a furnace to obtain this item and the Anvil Hammer.

place.title: Ruined Forge Lava Intake
walk: Ruined Forge Lava Intake Video Walkthrough

The Ruined Forge Lava Intake location can be found southeast past the Ellac Greatbridge See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. By the entrance is where you'll find the Ruined Lava Forge Intake Site of Grace. Head down the stairs, turn right, and then climb down the ladder (or jump down). Go forward and turn left into a dead-end room where you'll encounter a Golem Smith enemy. Kill the enemy and then check the floor of this room to find items such as x1 Gas Stone, x1 Smithing Stone [4], and x1 Smithing Stone [1]. There is also a corpse in this room, sitting against the wall from where the Golem was standing. You can loot the body to obtain x4 Smithing Stone [5]. Proceed to the opposite side where you'll encounter a Lava Slime.

Continue going straight until you enter another room where you'll spot a body lying on the ground, near the railings. Loot the body to find x7 Smithing Stone [2] and also x1 Smithing Stone [1], x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the floor, near the corpse. Proceed to the next section on the left side of the body, then walk to the end, and climb down the ladder. On this floor, you'll encounter more enemies, some smithing stones, and x2 Gas Stone that you can pick up. From the ladder, if you look to your right, you'll see some shabby stairs. If you check below, you'll find a corpse that can be looted to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [2].

Head up the stairs and you'll find more smithing stones that you can pick up on the ground, including another body that you can loot to acquire Greater Potentate's Cookbook (13). Around the cookbook item, you can also pick up x1 Smithing Stone [3] on the ground. If you look behind, you'll find a broken pillar that you can use to walk on. Reach the other side and walk around the narrow pathway where you should find x3 Smithing Stone [7] that you can pick up from the floor.
Turn around and jump across to reach the narrow sides of the platform. You should spot another corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow sides. Loot it to acquire x2 Smithing Stone [4].

Go back to the narrow platform and approach the broken pillar that you used to cross, you should find a path that leads to a ladder that you can climb down. On this section, you'll find more smithing stones you can loot, x1 Glass Shard from a body, and a lever that you can pull. Pulling the lever will bring down a large pillar that you can use to cross and reach an upper section of the forge. Next, climb back up the ladder to go back to the previous room, jump down, and proceed west towards a doorway. But before you go through that doorway, look to the left and you'll find another path leading to a dead end. You should find another Golem sitting in front of a corpse that can be looted. This body holds x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6]. Retrace your steps and head to the doorway, towards the next section.

As you enter the next section, you'll spot another body ahead, next to another Golem, and on the right, is another ladder you can climb down. Before climbing down the ladder, kill the Golem enemy and pillage the body nearby to acquire the Smithscript Dagger and a Smithing Stone [4] near it.

Now jump onto the large pipe and walk to the end. Be wary of the Lava Slime that will drop from the ceiling when you're about midway to the top. Look to your right and you'll find a small room with an altar inside. Jump across and interact with the altar to receive x1 Anvil Hammer and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. You can fast travel to the entrance by interacting with the white teleporter that appears next to the altar on the right.

place.title: Rivermouth Cave
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Rivermouth Cave Video Walkthrough

As you enter Rivermouth Cave, you will immediately discover the Rivermouth Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. If you go to the cavern going east, you will encounter 4 wolves in an area. In the northeast side of the room, you can pillage a body for x2 Hefty Beast Bone.

As you head deeper, the path will fork. The path on the right will have two hostile wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x3 Sliver of Meat. This leads to a dead-end, so return to the path and follow the other path. This path will lead you to an area with an upper level and three wolves.

If you climb up the opening on the east side of the area, you will find a body containing loot. When you get closer to loot the body, the ground will collapse, making you fall. You can then loot the body to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [1]. The path going northwest will be a dead-end, so go down the path east. As you are traversing the eastern path, you can gather x1 Sanguine Amaryllis along the way.

The path will lead you to an area full of Bloodfiends. If you want to go back up, go to the path on your right, and you will encounter a Bloodfiend. After disposing of the enemy, follow the path west going up, in which you will encounter two wolves. Keep following the path, encountering two more wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x1 Sacred Bloody Flesh. Keep following the path, which is going north, and you will be back in the area before you fell.

If you wish to continue, you can clear the area by sneaking up on the ogres and backstabbing them. They are also easy to deal with, as you can kill them in around two hits. If you aggro them all at the same time, you can fight one of them at a time by dragging the enemies away from the area. After clearing them, you can gather a few Sanguine Amaryllis around the edges of the blood pool. On the altar, you can pick up x3 Sacred Bloody Flesh. In the northern corner of the area, near the ramp where you came from, you can pick up x6 Sanguine Amaryllis. There will be a boss fog nearby.

When you enter the boss room, you will be facing the Chief Bloodfiend. It is a more aggressive version of the Bloodfiends that you encountered earlier. It can jump towards you from afar, while also using its club more effectively than the ones you encountered earlier. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat the Chief Bloodfiend, you can go refer to this page. Once you have defeated the Chief Bloodfiend, it will drop x1 Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes. You can find the exit on the southeastern side of the room.

Grab the Ellac River Downstream grace on dry land near the tall rock.

Mushroom-Seller's Bell Bearing [2]: Ellac River Downstream: Obtain this key item by shooting down a pot hanging from the side of the waterfall south from Ellac River Downstream site of grace. You can see the pot when traversing the large rock to descend from above across the river.

title: Forager Brood Cookbook
text: Forager Brood Cookbook: Acquired from a pest who hands it to you if you interact with it at the north-east corner of the forest of lightning rams near the Furnace Golem on the Ellac River. Closest Site of Grace is Cerulean Coast.
miss: Missed if you kill the Forager Brood before interacting with it or fail Moore's questline. If you tell Moore to 'Remain sad forever' after Miquella's charm breaks, the Forager Brood disappear and their cookbooks become unobtainable.

title: Lightning Perfume Bottle
text: Lightning Perfume Bottle: Located on a corpse in the middle of a big puddle of water guarded by a rolling lightning ram enemy.

title: Viridian Hidden Tear
text: Viridian Hidden Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem roaming around Ellac River.
Furnace Visage: Crafting Material dropped by the Furnace Golem upon defeat
Note: This one can also be killed from above in Charo's Hidden Grave if you're struggling.
Follow the wooded path on the other side of the river to the Cerulean Coast grace.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem
text: The Furnace Golem is located roaming around Ellac River. Defeating it drops the following item/s: x1 Viridian Hidden Tear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1]
text: Grave Glovewort [9]: Cerulean Coast: Can be found atop a broken down stone coffin.
Grave Glovewort [9]: Cerulean Coast: Can be found atop the broken-down stone coffin.
Grave Glovewort [7]: Cerulean Coast: Can be found on a corpse near a gravestone. Be wary of multiple Gravebird enemies in the area.
Spiritgrave Stone: Found in the small gravesite north east of the Scorched Ruins. Guarded by shadows and dogs.
Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1]: Can be found on a corpse beside a giant tree guarded by an enemy.

title: Spirit Sword
text: In the area northwest of the dead tree, you'll discover the Cerulean Coast West grace.
Pick up the Grave Glovewort [6] next to some graves just north-northwest of the grace.
Grave Glovewort [8]: Cerulean Coast: Can be found on a corpse on top of the broken stone coffin.
Head through the nearby ravine and pick up the Smithing Stone [6] x4 in front of a large gravestone, guarded by a Demi-Human Swordsman that drops Starlight Shards (first time).
Spirit Sword: Cerulean Coast: Located on a corpse lying next to some gravestones guarded by demi-humans. You can access this area by following the path East from Cerulean Coast West

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Scadutree Fragment: x1 Fragment dropped by the Undead Hippo found in this area of Charon's Hidden Grave.

title: Boss: Hippopotamus
text: A miniboss Hippopotamus is found here. Drops 1x Scadutree Fragment

title: Boss: Demi-Human Queen Marigga
text: Demi-Human Queen Marigga: The Demi-Human Queen Marigga is located in Cerulean Coast
Star-Lined Sword: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga, who can be found in Cerulean Coast's Demi-Human Valley.

title: Perfumed Oil of Ranah
text: Great Grave Glovewort: Cerulean Coast: Can be found on a corpse atop the broken structure near the area where you fought Demi-Human Queen Marigga.
Return to Cerulean Coast West and head southeast back to the large dead tree. Descend the cave below the tree, then follow the tunnel east to a Somber Smithing Stone [6].

Great Grave Glovewort: Looted from the bow of a large stone coffin, accessed only by following the underground path from the cave found alongside the shore just south of the Cerulean Coast West site of grace
Crab Eggs: 2x Looted from the ground in the underground cave connecting the Southern Nameless Mausoleum to the mainland, by a Giant Lobster.
Perfumed Oil of Ranah: Tool looted from a corpse atop the island where you emerge from the cave connecting to the mainland.

title: Boss: Dancer of Ranah
text: Dancer of Ranah: Found at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum Drops: Dancing Blade of Ranah , Dancer's Hood , Dancer's Dress , Dancer's Bracer , and Dancer's Trousers

Dancer's Set: The following armor pieces of the Dancer's Set can be obtained after defeating the Dancer of Ranah found inside Southern Nameless Mausoleum . Dancer's Hood Dancer's Dress Dancer's Bracer Dancer's Trousers
Dancing Blade of Ranah: Dropped by defeating Dancer of Ranah at the Southern Nameless Mausoleum

title: Map: Southern Shore
text: Kill the Ghostflame Dragon south of the Cerulean Coast grace for Dragon Heart, Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and 120,000 runes.
Loot the Human Bone Shard, Smithing Stone [7] x4, and Grave Cricket x6 on the outer edge of one of the islands.
Grab another Grave Cricket x6 from the corpse in front of a large gravestone on the last island.
Map: Southern Shore: From the Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace, follow the path northwest and you'll find this map.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: From the stele, head south-southeast and up the hillside with the cross to discover the Cerulean Coast Cross grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace.

title: Hefty Cracked Pot

Follow the road near the coffin southwest to find a corpse with Whiteflesh Mushroom x4.
Hefty Cracked Pot: From the Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace, head east and continue following the coastline, you'll find a Troll throwing pots along the way. Drops a Hefty Cracked Pot upon defeat.

title: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2]
text: Grave Glovewort [8]: Lying in front of a bull statue at the top of a wrecked stone coffin southwest of Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace.

title: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1]
text: Shadow Realm Rune [1]: Slowly descend down the area and you'll find a corpse with this item.
Continue down the hole to reach a corpse with Deep-Purple Lily x3, then activate The Fissure grace at the bottom for later.
Return to Cerulean Coast Cross and head north to reach the top of a coffin with a Grave Glovewort [9].
Drop down from the east end of the coffin, then drop down the cliff below it to reach a stone coffin with a Great Grave Glovewort.

St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1]: From the Cerulean Coast Cross site of grace, head north to a hill with a large wilted tree being guarded by a Cemetery Shade. There will be a sitting corpse under the tree, which holds the Cookbook.

title: Boss: Ghostflame Dragon
text: The Ghostflame Dragon is a boss located South of Cerulean Cross, Site of Grace. It can be found patrolling the blue field of flowers. Drops Dragon Heart and Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

text: Great Grave Glovewort: Lying in front of a bull statue at the top of a Stone Coffin northeast of Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace.
Head east-southeast toward the beach until you see a corpse with Arrow x10 in the shallow water.
Go up the zigzag slope with cerulean flowers to find Smithing Stone [6] x3 next to two large gravestones.
Shadow Realm Rune [2]: Can be found on a corpse lying along the coastline.

Follow the path from the stone coffin to discover the Finger Ruins of Rhia grace.
Going down the slope, you'll come to a fork. The upward path leads to a coffin that can duplicate any remembrance. Optionally, mark it on your map for later use.

Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1]: Can be found at Finger-Weaver's Hovel. Accessible via Finger Ruins of Rhia following the path to the left and heading straight underneath the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.
Talk to Ansbach about the cross at the coast.

text: Travel to the Dragon's Pit Terminus grace and exit east-southeast. At the edge of the cliff overlooking the drake, you can find a message left by Igon.
Jagged Peak Drake: The Jagged Peak Drake is located in an empty plain between the Suppressing Pillar and Finger Ruins of Rhia .
Dragon Heart: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake .
Dragonscale Flesh: Dropped by the Jagged Peak Drake .

title: Igon's Cookbook [1]
text: Go through the ravine south of the dragon and pick up Red Fulgurbloom x3 from the upper east ledge near the end.
Igon's Cookbook [1]: Can be found on a corpse in the broken tower just before the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

title: Talk to Dragon Communion Priestess
text: Approach the massive dragon corpse and grab the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion grace next to it.
Dragon Communion Priestess: Can be found near the exit of the Dragon's Pit towards the south, standing next to the Dragon Communion altar.
Ancient Dragon's Blessing: Given by Dragon Communion Priestess located near the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion.

place.title: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion
walk: From the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace at the end of Dragon's Pit, head east until you reach a body of water where a sleeping Jagged Peak Drake lies. Be careful not to disturb the Drake unless you are ready for a fight. The path will split into two at this point; take the southern path to reach the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. The Dragon Communion Priestess will be standing next to the altar (see that page for more info on her questline).

title: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2]
text: Talk to Florissax again and ask her about Bayle.
Examine the altar behind her and buy any dragon communion incantations you need.
Dragon Communion Harpoon: Consumable looted atop the wing of the giant dead dragon.
Dragon Communion Grease: Can be found on one of the dragon corpses in the area.
Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2]: Charo's Hidden Grave: Can be found on a corpse in the sourthern area

title: Tibia's Cookbook
text: Tibia's Cookbook: Dropped by Tibia Mariner upon defeat, located west of Finger-Weaver's Hovel.

title: Boss: Tibia Mariner
text: Drops Tibia's Cookbook upon defeat.

Rings of Spectral Light: Looted from the altar by the giant bird statue after defeating several birds

title: Boss: Death Rite Bird
text: Call of Tibia: Looted from a grave by a skeleton ambush
Head back down and grab the Charo's Hidden Grave grace past the water.

Great Grave Glovewort: From Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace, continue down south and follow the path sticking to the cliff's edge, drop down to the stone coffin below and you'll find this material in front of a bull statue.
Death Rite Bird: The Death Rite Bird Boss is located in Charo's Hidden Grave
Ash of War: Ghostflame Call: Dropped by the Death Rite Bird .

text: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [14]: Can be found on a corpse on top of a dilapidated structure behind a Giant Miranda Sprout.

title: Spirit Glaive
text: Pick up Ghostflame Bloom x4 from the corpse in the water.
Spirit Glaive: Charro's Hidden Grave: This Halberd Can be found on a corpse surrounded by gravestones in the northeastern edges of the area.

title: Gaol Upper Level Key, Prattling Pate "Lamentation" +5
text: If you didn't kill the Furnace Golem in Ellac River, you can do it now by throwing Hefty Furnace or Fire Pots into its basket from the ledge below.
Grave Glovewort [9]: Charro's Hidden Grave: Can be found con a corpse surrounded by broken tombstones past the Death Rite Bird boss battle.
Follow the water down to an area with multiple cages, then continue along the trail to find a Ghost Glovewort [8] guarded by Spirit Eels.

Gaol Upper Level Key: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. When you enter, proceed until you reach a fork in the path. Take the left turn, and after a short walk, enter the room on your right. Inside, you'll find a chest containing the Gaol Upper Level Key.
Prattling Pate "Lamentation": Lamenter's Gaol. Climb up the long ladder, cross the connecting stone bridge, and enter the room on the left, you'll find this key item on a corpse.
Chilling Perfume Bottle: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. In a small room at the lower floor area, the first room to the right after exiting the ladder room.

Clarifying Horn Charm +2: Lamenter's Gaol. After dropping down the small cave infested with rats, continue following the path and go straight. You'll find this talisman on a corpse on the right side once you enter the area.

Call of Tibia: Can be found within Lamenter's Gaol. After dropping down the destructible path, exit the room and head up the stairs. Take the path on the right and you'll find a small room with a corpse with this item.
Gaol Lower Level Key: Lamenter's Gaol. Can be found on a chest in an area full of Living Jar enemies.

Shadow Realm Rune [4]: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol, hidden behind an illusory wall. In the area you fall through the floor, go up the stairs and into the the first doorway. Roll into the end of the passageway, and use the Gaol Lower Level Key to open the door.
Lamenting Visage: Inside a room on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol , you'll need to obtain the Gaol Lower Level Key to gain access.
Lamenter: Can be found inside Lamenter's Gaol. Drops Lamenter's Mask and 160,000 Runes.
Lamenter's Mask: A stone mask twisted into an expression of rapturous grief. Use while disrobed to transform into a lamenter. Dropped by Lamenter at Lamenter's Gaol.

title: Glovewort Crystal Tear
text: Head inside and grab the Lamenter's Gaol grace.
Loot the Gaol Upper Level Key from a chest in the room just before the stone bridge.
Go across the stone bridge and pick up the Prattling Pate "Lamentation" at the end.
Unlock the door at the start and descend the ladder inside. Grab the Chilling Perfume Bottle from the first room on the right.
Drop down the hole opposite the first room, then turn around to pick up Innard Meat x2.
Follow the tunnel to a fork, then enter the room straight ahead to find the Clarifying Horn Charm +2.
Climb the ladder in the other room, then explore until the floor collapses. Enter the first cell up the stairs to find a Call of Tibia.
Hit the illusory wall outside the room to reveal another cell, but you don't have the key for it yet.
Go through the second cell up the stairs to reach a large room. Pick up the Hefty Cracked Pot on a mountain of corpses.
Loot the Gaol Lower Level Key from a chest farther in and pick up Living Jar Shard x6 from the nearby corpse.
Unlock the cell behind the illusory wall to reach a room with a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and the Lamenting Visage.
Head through the top cell and unlock the door in the room below. Kill the Lamenter for Lamenter's Mask and 160,000 runes.
Ghost Glovewort [9]: Can be found on a corpse surrounded by Gravebird statues, at least two of them are enemies.
Fireproof Pickled Liver: Can be found on a corpse near at the wall.
Glovewort Crystal Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located around Charo's Grave.

place.title: Lamenter's Gaol
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Lamenter's Gaol Video Walkthrough

The entrance to Lamenter's Gaol is just southeast of the Gravesite Plain site of grace on the map, and directly east of the Artist's Shack. Head northwest behind the huge dead dragon at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion site of grace. Keep going above the Cerulean Coast and you'll eventually find the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol. Look for fences and metal cages outside the cave entrance. At the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, keep following the path going southeast until you arrive near a locked gate. Before the locked gate, there will be an opening on the left side of the wall. Go through the path on your left, then keep following the path.

You'll find two rooms with an open gate on the right side as you are traversing the path. The first room will only contain a Putrid Corpse. In the second room, you will encounter two Putrid Corpses. After dealing with the enemies in this room, open the chest to receive x1 Gaol Upper Level Key, which will be used to open the locked gate that you encountered earlier. Return to the path then keep following it until you cross a bridge. Enter the room across the bridge, in which you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse. The room will be filled with numerous cages. On the northern side of the room, you'll find another room with three cages. On a dead body by the middle cage, you can pick up x1 Prattling Pate Lamentation.

title: Gravebird Ashes
text: Note: This one has armored legs, which means you'll have to throw Hefty Furnace or Fire Pots into its basket to kill it.
Gravebird Ashes: Use the spiritspring to reach the area, you'll find this item surrounded by gravestones.

title: Boss: Furnace Golem
text: The Furnace Golem is located around Charo's Grave. Defeating it drops the following item/s: x1 Glovewort Crystal Tear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Milady
text: Travel to Castle Front and grab the Black Pyrefly x3 on the bridge to the castle bridge.
Royal Magic Grease: 3x Dropped by the nonrespawning troll guarding the main bridge entrance of Castle Ensis
Shadow Realm Rune [4]: x1 Shadow Realm Rune [4] can be looted off a body inside an armory room.
Somber Smithing Stone [6]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6] can be looted off a corpse. The body is found on a broken watchtower that is guarded by a Page enemy.
Somber Smithing Stone [5]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] can be looted off a corpse. The body can be found lying on the floor of a watchpoint of the bridge. The area is guarded by soldiers and hounds.
Broken Rune: Consumable. Looted from a corpse hanging from a grassy ledge near the entrance to Castle Ensis Bridge
Milady: The Milady Light Greatsword weapon can be found inside a chest. The chest is located at the top of a watchtower.

title: Loyal Knight's Cookbook
text: Pick up Flight Pinion x2 from the corpse on the ground past the short tunnel.
Loyal Knight's Cookbook: The Loyal Knight's Cookbook can be found inside a chest. The chest is located inside an armory room.

title: Boss: Ghost Troll
text: A Ghost Troll elite enemy can be found here. It drops x9 Somber Smithing Stone [8] upon defeat.

title: Castle Cross Message, Scadutree Fragment
text: Drop down the cliff west of the building to reach a corpse with Bolt x10 on a lower ledge.
Glintslab Firefly: 3x Glintslab Firefly can be looted from a body.
Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot: x1 can be looted off a body. The body can be found in a dark alleyway.
Castle Cross Message: The letter can be found next to a Miquella's Cross and the Castle Ensis site of grace.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found beside Miquella's Cross of the Castle Ensis Checkpoint Site of Grace.

title: Invader: Moonrithyll, Carian Knight, Moonrithyll's Knight Sword
text: Activate the Castle Ensis Checkpoint grace and grab the Somber Smithing Stone [5] behind it.
Knot Resin: x3 Knot Resin can be looted off a body.
Drop to the bottom and pick up Arrow x10 from the corpse guarded by three dogs.
Starlight Shards: Consumable found only by dropping down into the castle from the Scadu Altus side and platforming to the higher area above the bridge entrance.
Follow the cliff up the waterfall, then continue upstream to find Drawstring Royal Magic Grease x3 below the waterfall at the end.
Knot Resin: x4 Knot Resin can be looted off a corpse. The body is found inside a cave near the waterfall.
Climb the ladder near the waterfall and push the lever to open the gate back to the grace.
String: X3 Can be lootedd off a body. The body is found passing the bridge protected by soldiers.
Glintslab Firefly: Can be looted off a corpse. The body is found lying by the edge of a cliff.
Somber Smithing Stone [7]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [7] can be found in the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past location. Loot from a corpse at a dead end after opening the first gate
Moonrithyll, Carian Knight: This hostile NPC Invader can be found by the chapel's entrance.
Moonrithyll's Knight Sword: The weapon drops from defeating the hostile NPC Invader, Moonrithyll, Carian Knight.

title: Rellana's Cameo
text: Rellana's Cameo: The talisman can be looted on top of an altar inside a chapel.
Shadow Realm Rune [2]: x1 Shadow Realm Rune [2] can be looted off a corpse. The body is located in a corridor, lying on the floor.

title: Glintblade Trio
text: On the staircase up ahead lies a corpse with a Glintslab Firefly.
Dewgem: x3 Dewgem can be pillaged from a corpse. The body can be found sitting by the edge of a cliff.
Somber Smithing Stone [8]: 1x is dropped by a Teardrop Scarab found clinging to the outside pillars of the Forge of Starfall Past.

Glintblade Trio: The Glintblade Trio spell is found by looting it off a corpse. After passing through the iron gate just beyond the chapel in the midpoint of the castle, then dropping off the side of the bridge and climbing up the ladders to the rooftop of the chapel. You can then drop down on the north side of the roof to get to the corpse hanging over a ledge that has the spell.

title: Imbued Sword Key
text: Somber Smithing Stone [6]: x1 Somber Smithing Stone [6] can be looted off a corpse. The body can be found lying on the floor of a watchpoint of the bridge. The area is guarded by soldiers and hounds.
Imbued Sword Key: The Imbued Sword Key item can be found inside a treasure chest. The chest is located inside a tower's armor room.

title: Ash of War: Wing Stance
text: Take the lift up and activate the Castle-Lord's Chamber grace.
Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the balcony near the grace.

Ash of War: Wing Stance: Inside a chest in the tower that you can reach by jumping over the edge just outside Castle Lord's Chamber Site of Grace, and following the cliffside down to the tower before climbing up two ladders to reach it

title: Boss: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
text: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight: This Remembrance Item is acquired upon defeating the boss, Rellana, Twin Moon Knight .
Leda's summon sign can be found next to the entrance.
Grab the Ensis Moongazing Grounds grace after the fight.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found by Miquella's Cross of the Highroad Cross Site of Grace.

text: Monk's Missive: Looted off the ground just behind where Hornsent is standing. You'll also acquire the May the Best Win gesture alongside this key item.

title: New Cross Map

title: Carian Sorcery Sword
text: Talk to Leda and ask her about the hornsent.
Smithing Stone [8]: Dropped by the Ghost Troll elite enemy upon defeat.
Shadow Realm Rune [2]: Looted from the top of a small tower atop Castle Ensis Cross. This is only accessible by coming down the river from Scadu Altus area.
Carian Sorcery Sword: In a chest after dropping down into Castle Ensis from Scadu Altus.

title: Verdigris Discus
text: Starlight Shards: x1 Starlight Shards can be looted off a corpse. The body can be found on the roof of the first building seen to the right when entering from the bridge. Access this roof by progressing past the cross and dropping down then going right before the waterfall.
Head west-northwest from the Highroad Cross to the wooded area across the water to find the Scadu Altus, West grace near the cliff.
Unlock the imp-sealed belfry on the island southeast of the grace. Take the sending gate to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Verdigris Discus: Ancient Rauh Ruins: Can be found in front of a giant statue in a lower area only accessible by jumping down from the second Divine Beast Lion encounter, or by teleporting to this platform from the waygate in Scadu Altus

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [3], Serpent Flail +2
text: Behind one of the pillars south of the statue lies a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom.
Return to Scadu Altus, West and drop down the ledges near the waterfall to find a gravestone with a Grave Glovewort [8].
Greater Potentate's Cookbook [3]: Past the first small tower, turn right and defeat the soldiers that are on the bridge, cross to the other side to find the cookbook on a body.

Serpent Flail: Head down using the ladder past the first tower, and defeat the enemies. Beware of the flamethrowers. Use spells or arrows if you have them. Reach the end of the area to find a chest that contains this item

Black Steel Greatshield: This shield item drops as a reward upon defeating the boss Black Knight Garrew .

Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman: Found on top of a tower at Fog Rift Fort . From within the door of the tower where Black Knight Garrew was, go through a gap between the tower and the rock wall to the right of the door. Take the stairs going up around the cliff, then at the top take the ladder to the right going up the upper level of the tower. On reaching the top turn left to take another latter leading to the uppermost level of the tower, where a treasure chest resides that holds the Talisman.

title: Map: Scadu Altus
text: Pick up the Fire Arrow x10 in front of some explosive barrels.

Descend the ladder at the end of the rampart and grab the Messmerfire Grease in front of two flamespitters.
Open the chest at the end to obtain the Serpent Flail.

Pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] on the rampart southwest of the building.

title: Invader: Fire Knight Queelign
