If you don't make the choice before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off. His bell bearing can then be found where he usually sits.
Talk to Thiollier, then talk to him again after reloading the area twice to hear that he's heading south.
Exhaust Leda's dialogue and suggest the hornsent.
Exhaust Hornsent's dialogue until he leaves the Highroad Cross.
Talk to Leda after Hornsent has left.

title: Invader: Moore
text: From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Moore as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Travel to The Fissure and enter the now open tunnel to grab the Stone Coffin Fissure grace.
Instead of heading down the first stone coffin, follow the upper right path across two gaps to find Congealed Putrescence x5.
Drop down some ledges and grab the St. Trina's Arrow x10 back near the first stone coffin.
Continue until the ground collapses, then go north for a corpse with Deep-Purple Lily x2 on the cliff's edge.
Pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [3] from a ledge with two Bloodfiends.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 can looted from the ground by Miquella's Cross of the Fissure Cross Site of Grace.

title: Velvet Sword of St Trina
text: Grave Glovewort [7]: From the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace, head south and turn left, you'll find a corpse sitting on a ledge with this item.

Velvet Sword of St Trina: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. The sword is in a small cave network there and guarded by several putrescent oozes.

title: Mass of Putrescence
text: Grave Glovewort [8]: From the Fissure Cross site of grace, walk north to the brick platform that's tilted nearly vertical. Climb down to a ledge that passes underneath the brick platform nearest the site of grace. Descend the area and head northwest, you'll find this material on the ground guarded by multiple Abnormal Stone Clusters.
Go up the slope as it curves left, then continue upward to the top end of a stone coffin for a Grave Glovewort [5].
Head down the coffins to the other side, then take the first left to a Grave Glovewort [8] surrounded by explosive stone sentries.
Pick up the Smithing Stone [6] x3 between the two coffins higher up.
Drop down the overturned coffin at the end to reach the Fissure Waypoint grace.
Around the corner southeast of the grace, on the edge of the coffin, is a corpse with a Grave Glovewort [7].

Mass of Putrescence: From the Fissure Waypoint site of grace, head northeast. Just after hopping over the little gap, drop down on the left (north) side and make your way north where you'll find the spell on a corpse.

title: Multilayered Ring of Light
text: Congealed Putrescence: Stone Coffin Fissure: x2 looted from a corpse where the skeletons throw firebombs at you before the Leonine Warrior
Continue to the top and kill the large mound of putrescence for Smithing Stone [8] x7 and Congealed Putrescence x8 (first time).
Pick up the Dewgem x3 next to the mound of putrescence.
Multilayered Ring of Light: Drops from the Misbegotten Crusader in Stone Coffin Fissure.

title: Boss: Misbegotten Crusader
text: From the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace, head east and continue following the path, go through the small cave with a giant putrescence, and turn left. As you exit the room, you'll find a Misbegotten Crusader in the area. Drops the Multilayered Ring of Light upon defeat.

title: Boss: Putrescent Knight
text: Make your way to the last stone coffin and activate the Fissure Depths grace.
Putrescent Knight: Legend Type boss. Grants 220,000 Runes upon defeat and drops Remembrance of Putrescence
Remembrance of Putrescence: Dropped by Putrescent Knight

title: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3]
text: Thiollier's summon sign can be found in the arena if he has left the Pillar Path Cross.
Activate the Garden of Deep Purple grace after the fight.

St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3]: Can be found on the ground, surrounded by Nectarblood Burgeon flowers. From the Garden of Deep Purple Site of Grace, head west and enter the narrow path and you'll come across this item.

title: Talk to Thiollier
text: Thiollier only moves here if you pursue St. Trina and his quest line. You must clear the Stone Coffin Fissure location first to find St. Trina at the very end of the Stone Coffin Fissure. Imbibe St. Trina's deadly nectar once. Then Tholier moves in. Otherwise you may have to travel to Thiollier's initial location to tell him about St. Trina. Fast travel back to the Garden of Deep Purple checkpoint at the Stone Coffin Fissure and you'll find Thiollier in St. Trina's chamber.

title: St. Trina's Smile
text: Interact with St. Trina and imbibe her nectar six times (until she tells you to kill Miquella).
Exhaust Thiollier's dialogue and attempt to pass on St. Trina's words twice.

St. Trina's Smile: Obtained as a drop upon defeating Thiollier. Thiollier only becomes a hostile enemy if you pursue Thiollier and St. Trina's NPC quest. Please visit the Thiollier or St.Trina 's page for the NPC quest guide.
Talk to Thiollier again and pass on St. Trina's words.
miss: This item must be obtained before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Crimsonburst Dried Tear
text: Crimsonburst Dried Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located around the army campsite, outside of the Shadow Keep.
Furnace Visage: Dropped by the Furnace Golem upon defeat

title: Boss: Furnace Golem
text: Furnace Golem is located around the army camp. Defeating this elite enemy drops the following items: x1 Crimsonburst Dried Tear x1 Furnace Visage

title: Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3]
text: Drawstring Messmerfire Grease: Found on a body, just outside a large tent.
Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [3]: The item can be looted from a corpse, located inside an army tent.
Shadow Realm Rune: In the last tent on the left side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep's front entrance.

title: Golden Vow
text: On the right side of the encampment is a corpse with Ember of Messmer x6.
Golden Vow: At the end of the room, hanging from a body.

title: Black Steel Twinblade
text: Black Steel Twinblade: Drops from Black Knight at the top of the hill encampment. He is guarded by many Messmer Soldiers along the way.

title: Ash of War: Rolling Sparks
text: Head toward the elevated part of the camp on the other side to find a corpse with Shadow Sunflower x2.
Ash of War: Rolling Sparks: Dropped by a flying scarab southeast of Shadow Keep, where the Perfumers are. It's high in the air and tough to see if you don't look up

title: Furnace Keeper's Note
text: Somber Smithing Stone [7]: Upgrade Material looted from a corpse along the riverbed under the waterfall.
Furnace Visage: Looted from a destroyed Furnace Golem
Furnace Keeper's Note: On the tent at the left side of the dead Furnace Golem.

title: Boss: Golden Hippopotamus, Scadutree Fragment
text: Enter the castle and take the lift up to the Shadow Keep Main Gate grace.

Golden Hippopotamus: This boss can be found resting at the foot of the giant Marika Statue in the plaza. Use the elevator in the Main Gate of Shadow Keep to access this area. Drops 200,000 Runes, Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns , and x2 Scadutree Fragments upon death.
Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns: This item is obtained after defeating the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep .
Scadutree Fragment: Obtain x2 Scadutree Fragment after defeating the Golden Hippopotamus found in Shadow Keep .
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace in the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep.

title: Main-gauche
text: Freyja and Hornsent can both be summoned if you've spoken to them at least once.
Activate the Main Gate Plaza grace after the fight.
Pick up Festive Grease from a corpse next to a staircase.
Take the first right up the stairs to a room with Smithing Stone [7] x3.
Main-gauche: Midway through the Stairs, turn right and enter the room. Enter the room on the right, and defeat the enemies to find the body that contains this weapon on the other side.

title: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
text: Return to the stairs and continue to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x7 draped over the edge.
Shadow Realm Rune [6]: Shadow Keep, in the dining room. Cross the bridge and enter the room to find it, Beware of the black knight on the left side.
Smithing Stone [8]: x3 Upgrade Material looted from a corpse found on a small balcony in Ruins of Unte. Use this vantage point to activate the nearby Furnace Golem
Talisman of Lord's Bestowal: Can be found beside the big golden tree.

title: Domain of Dragons Painting
text: Go through the doorway close to a corner to find Smithing Stone [8] x2 on a wooden platform.
Return to the tree and pick up the Golden Vow x3 guarded by a Black Knight.
Grab the Smithing Stone [8] x2 behind a weapon rack in the nearby room.
Climb the ladder in the room and open the shortcut back to the dining hall.
Holyproof Pickled Liver: Head to the western wall ships area, and turn right to find the item on a corpse.
Messmerfire Grease: Can be found on a corpse near one of the ships.

place.title: Darklight Catacombs
walk: ER Shadow of the Erdtree Darklight Catacombs Video Walkthorugh
ER Shadow of the Erdtree Jore Elder Inquisitor Video Walkthorugh

The Darklight Catacombs is located south of the Scadu Altus region, directly south of the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. To get there, go to the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then go traverse the cliffs going south. As you get to the bottom, keep going south. By going in this direction, you will stumble upon the door leading to the Darklight Catacombs. Open the door to gain access inside the catacombs.

Once you are inside the Darklight Catacombs, follow the path leading to a lift. After arriving at the bottom, you can activate the Darklight Catacombs Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. After activating the Site of Grace, head north to pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [5]. A lionhead Imp will jump on you as you approach the item, so take caution. Once you have picked up the Grave Glovewort, go to the eastern hall right before picking up the loot. Grab x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom right as you head down the path. Turn left, and you'll find another path going down, with x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom in the middle of the stairs.

You will arrive on a ledge area with two Fanged Imps. Defeat the enemies, then drop down the ledge or walk down the ramp. Immediately on the west of where you dropped is a passageway leading to a lever that will turn on the lights when pulled. Go back to where you dropped, then head southeast, passing through the archway. As you turn the corner to the archway, a bigmouth Imp will attack you.

In the room overlooking the lit area, you can drop from the railings onto a ledge, then drop from the broken section of the ledge to a room with a chest containing the Viridian Amber Medallion +3. Afterwards, drop down to a bridge. The room on the south connecting to the bridge contains x1 Grave Glovewort [1] on the east side, and x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom right by the western wall. After clearing the area, follow the path going north leading to another lift. Use the lift to go down.

Follow the path north, going through the ramp on the right side to progress. A Fanged Imp will be waiting for you at the bottom of the ramp. Keep heading north, and you'll find x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom along with a bigmouth Imp opposite of it. After dealing with the imp, go back a few steps and you'll see a ladder going up. Climb the ladder, then turn right through the tight passageway, dropping to a room with a lever. Pull the lever, and you will activate the lights in another area. By the lever, you can drop down safely into a staircase below containing x4 Thin Beast Bones. Follow the path going up the stairs.

Once you have arrived at the top of the second set of stairs, look down by the opening, then drop down to the ledge. Follow the ledge going west, then climb up the ladder in the corner. In front of you, you can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5] from a corpse, and you will encounter an Inquisitor. You can safely drop to the room below with a body that has x1 Ghost Glovewort [2]. A Fanged Imp will attack you from behind after dropping. You can exit through the archway to the east. You'll be back in the area where you climbed up a ladder to the lever room.

You'll find a broken section of the railings. Drop down to the ledge bellow it, and you'll find a hallway with an Inquisitor on the southeastern corner. In this hallway, you can obtain the Death Knight Set from a dead body by the ledge on the north. South of the hallway, you can find an opening with a ladder going down. Climb down the ladder then head east through the archway. On your left, you'll find x1 Ghost Glovewort [9]. On your right, a Inquisitor will be attacking you. Defeat the Inquisitor, then drop down the ledge.

After dropping down, you can pick up x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom just where you dropped. Go east, then go through the archway going down, leading you to another lift. After arriving at the bottom of the lift, keep heading east. You will encounter a giant Bigmouth Imp which shoots fireballs towards you. Run through it, then turn left to head north. There will be a section here that has a pillar that can serve as a safe spot for you. As you are in the safe spot, a Fanged Imp will approach you. After dealing with the Fanged Imp, sprint to the area where it came from, then pull the lever in the room. Afterwards, kill the giant Bigmouth Imp, then defeat the Fanged Imp that spawns after it.

NOTE: Do not kill the Giant Bigmouth Imp before pulling the lever, or else the Great Ghost Glovewort that it drops will be stuck in the air. If you do kill it and then pull the level, return after respawning at a Stake and you can kill it again to get its item.

Go back to where you dropped, and you can pick up x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom and x1 Ghost Glovewort [8]. Afterwards, head to the pathway that the giant Bigmouth imp was blocking, then enter the room to loot a chest containing x1 Bigmouth Imp Ashes. Head up the ladder on the eastern wall, then keep heading east through the hall. You will encounter a Fanged Imp at the end of the hallway. You can safely drop, then head north. In the northernmost wall, you can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [4] from a dead body. Head back south going down the ramps, and you'll find another lift which leads you to a boss fog.

Once you head inside the boss fog, you will encounter Jori, Elder Inquisitor. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you can visit this page. After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will obtain the Barbed Staff-Spear and the Forsaken Graveyard Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map will be unlocked.

NOTE: The Abyssal Woods can be accessed after defeating the boss of the Darklight Catacombs. After you have defeated Jori, you can follow the path going south to get to the Abyssal Woods region. You can't use your mount in the area, so you will get kicked off of your mount as you approach the region. Keep going south, and you can activate the Woodland Trail Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. To unlock the map for the Abyssal Woods region, you can keep following the path going south, and you will come across a glowing column with an item. Pick it up to get the Map: Abyss. Nearby, you can activate the Abandoned Church Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

Somber Smithing Stone [9]: On top of the branch from where the enemy is casting spells at you.
Go up the stairs and take the lift to the Viaduct Minor Tower grace.
Spirit Calculus: Found on a body on a broken column, in Ancient Ruins of Rauh . To the left side of the first site of grace of the area.
Take the lift down, then pick up Sacred Bloody Flesh x3 and a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the room around the corner.
Head out the narrow passage while keeping to the right to find Thin Beast Bones x8 at the end.
Scadutree Fragment: Defeat the Lesser Golden Hippopotamus to obtain the fragment. The enemy drops 11960 Runes and x1 Scadutree Fragment .

title: Boss: Golden Hippopotamus
text: From here, face the southwest direction and exit through the small hole. Go to the right side and go past the bloodfiend. There's a corpse near the edge and you can pick up 8x Thin Beast Bones from it. Now look behind you; you should be facing southeast here and go towards the edge and jump down on the steps below you. Look to your right and fight the lesser Golden Hippopotamus.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Golden Horn Tender: Past the Spider-Scorpions after entering the tunnel, move forward, and turn right. Locate the Shadowpot Enemy and kill it to obtain x1 Scadutree Fragment and x1 Golden Horn Tender.
Revered Spirit Ash: Dropped by a Shadowpot Enemy in the ruins west of the Viaduct Minor Tower Site of Grace.

title: Bondstone, Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook
text: Climb the root at the start of the room to reach a Somber Smithing Stone [9].
Head left at the giant door to find a Fire Spritestone on a ledge.
Shadow Realm Rune [5]: You will see a shadow realm rune guarded by a group of Spider-Scorpions, and in front of it is a hidden wall.
Bondstone: Can be found behind an illusory wall inside a tunnel area guarded by scorpions
Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook: From the entrance of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh , head north towards the edge, and head west, you will find an area with an item below in which you can jump.

title: Spider Scorpion Ashes
text: Broken Rune: In the area filled with shadows, before the big door.

Spirit Calculus: Pay attention to the glimmering one carrying a jar and make sure to eliminate them to get 3x Spirit Calculus from them. You can also pick up a Broken Rune in front of this square hole to the southeast.
Rauh Burrow: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead in the area, along with x1 Revered Spirit Ash, x1 Silver Horn Tender, and x1 Dewgem.
Ignore the path behind the door. Instead, go through the narrow passage in the earlier room. Pick up a Somber Smithing Stone [8] from a heap of rocks in the sand.
Heading into the large room, pick up Throwing Dagger x5 from the second corner on the left.
Next to the corner is a corridor that leads to a corpse with Glass Shard on the left.
Spider Scorpion Ashes: In the area where the spider-scorpion hangs from a ceiling and there are a bunch of items on the ground. One of them is this.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Dewgem: Droped by a Shadowpot Enemy.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.
Golden Horn Tender: From the entrance to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh location, step outside of the building and head north, and border the building to the east, until you will find the item.

title: Fine Crucible Feather Talisman
text: Shadow Realm Rune [6]: Fall to the Spiritspring inside the cave, there are a few Fly-Man guarding the item.
Fine Crucible Feather Talisman: Climb up on the first tree branch and jump on the second one on the left to find the talisman.

title: Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind
text: Shadow Realm Rune [7]: On top of the branch, guarded by 2 Fly-Man.
Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind: Found on the edge, besides a column and near a waterfall by Rauh Ancient Ruins, East site of Grace

title: Ancient Ruins Cross Message, Scadutree Fragment
text: Ancient Ruins Cross Message: Located in the area where you find Devonia, Crucible Knight.

Scadutree Fragment: Temple Town Ruins . From the entrance through the gap in the wall, take the stairs on the right and climb up until you reach the cloth-like part of the structure at the top. Before heading down, check on the right side to see a small opening that will lead to the middle platform. Fall there and defeat the two enemies, In the middle of the bridge you will find a body that has x1 Scadutree Fragment.

title: Devonia's Hammer, Crucible Hammer-Helm
text: Devonia's Hammer: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .
Crucible Hammer-Helm: Devonia, Crucible Knight, Grants 16289 runes, and drops Devonia's Hammer , and Crucible Hammer-Helm .

title: Boss: Devonia, Crucible Knight
text: Devonia, the Crucible Knight, is located on a rock next to a broken structure in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh area. Defeating him yields the Crucible Hammer-Helm and Devonia's Hammer.

title: Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear
text: Dewgem: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead in the area, along with x1 Revered Spirit Ash, x1 Silver Horn Tender, and x1 Rauh Burrow.
Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear: The item drops from the Furnace Golem located in the west section of Rauh Ancient Ruins.
Furnace Visage: Dropped by the Furnace Golem upon defeat

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Go south up a short hill to find the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace by the cliff.
Head into the ruins and pick up Kukri x6 from the first flight of stairs.
Spirit Calculus: From the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace, descend the stairs and turn right, you'll find this on a corpse sitting at the edge of a cliff.

Scadutree Fragment: Upon reaching a large room on the northwest side with the 2 large Spider Scorpions in it and the Bone Bow , jump over the rubble on the right side just before the doorway to this room. There's another doorway just behind the rubble, and following the path beyond will lead to a small room with the fragment, next to a Miquella's Cross

title: Talisman of All Crucibles
text: Head through the southwest corridor to find a corpse with Spiritgrave Stone x2.
Take the lift up, then drop down twice to the left of it to reach a corpse with Four-Toed Fowl Foot x3.

Talisman of All Crucibles: Start at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Starway Site of Grace, and head southwest to the elevator. At the bottom of the elevator looking south west, there are 2 paths of floating platforms, go to the left one, follow it around and it loops to the chest with this talisman.

title: Boss: Divine Beast Dancing Lion
text: Return through the next passage, then take the lift up to the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway grace.
Going down the stairs, hug the right side until you see a corpse with Spirit Calculus at the cliff's edge.
Return to the stairs and grab the Smithing Stone [7] x3 guarded by two dogs.
Shadow Realm Rune [7]: Can be found on a corpse just across the summoning pool in the area, guarded by two enemies.

Divine Beast Dancing Lion: The field boss version of the Divine Beast Dancing Lion is located near the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace. Head northeast down the grand stairway from the Site of Grace and you'll find the Divine Beast Dancing Lion roaming in a small area that looks like an open temple. Grants 180,000 Runes and the Divine Beast Tornado upon defeating it.
Divine Beast Tornado: Dropped by the Divine Beast Dancing Lion located North East from the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace.

title: Pest-Thread Spears
text: Travel to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace and return to the altar. This time, head outside and pick up the Revered Spirit Ash in a gazebo.
Continue to an area with scarlet rot, then take the lift on the left side. Pick up the Scarlet Bud x6 to the right of a staircase.

Pest-Thread Spears: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the elevator to reach the upper level. Still within the scarlet rot swamp area, head to either side of them before going up the stairs, and at the back you'll find this incantation guarded by a couple of Kindred of Rot

title: Falx, Hornsent Set
text: Falx: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.
Hornsent Set: Dropped by Hornsent when he is defeated in the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh after invading you.

title: Invader: Hornsent
text: If you have followed Hornsent's questline and done Messmer, he will invade at the top of the staircase leading to the Church of the Bud in Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Drops Falx and Hornsent Set upon defeat.

title: Divine Bird Feathers
text: Activate the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance grace up the stairs for later.
Go back down the stairs and out the southeast exit, hugging the left wall until you see some stacked stones. Destroy them to unseal the spiritspring below.

Divine Bird Feathers: Can be found the corpse in the middle of the lake in the higher area of Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Go past the gazebo and look at the corpse in the middle of the water. Go towards it and then pick up the Divine Bird Feathers.

title: Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9]
text: Jump onto the roof of the gazebo east-southeast of the corpse to reach a Shadow Realm Rune [4].
Drop down and head back through the scarlet rot to find Dappled White Cured Meat x2 at the end.

Smithing Stone [8]: x2 From the Spiral Rise Site of Grace, head up the stairs and exit through the roof. Continue following the path and you'll find this on a corpse on the right side of one of the roofs.

Greater Potentate's Cookbook [9]: After getting past the scarlet rot swamp area in Ancient Ruins of Rauh, head outside and you'll find this item on a corpse near the wall before the invisible bridge that leads to a nearby tower.

title: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom
text: Cross the invisible bridge to reach a stele that can be used to raise your Stone-Sheathed Sword (or Sword of Darkness) into the Sword of Light. Note: If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Light is instead acquired at the stele in the Ruins of Unte.
Note: If you obtained the Stone-Sheathed Sword here, the Sword of Light is instead acquired at the stele in the Ruins of Unte.

Jump to the plateau beside the bridge, then, facing its west-southwest edge, drop down twice to an area with red trees. Continue down to a lift, then go past it to find a Somber Smithing Stone [9] on some rocks.
Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom: Can be found on a corpse near the Giant Miranda Sprout in Ancient Ruins of Rauh

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Revered Spirit Ash: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead found above the lift near the scorpions and poison flower in Ancient Ruins of Rauh, along with x1 Silver Horn Tender, x1 Dewgem, and x1 Rauh Burrow.

title: Mottled Necklace +2
text: Drop down and go out the south-southeast exit to find Knot Resin x3 behind the second pillar.
Go up the first flight of stairs, then head northeast and kill the Chief Bloodfiend accompanied by dogs for Sacred Bloody Flesh x5 (first time).
Pick up a Golden Horn Tender from the corpse between two of the pillars.
Use the spiritspring in the middle while facing east, then pick up Beast Horn x2 from the roof of some connecting pillars to the south.

Mottled Necklace +2: Talisman found in the upper area of Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Use the spiritspring in the area to reach the platform to the east and go up the stairs, at the end of the path you'll find a chest with this Talisman.

title: Boss: Romina, Saint of the Bud
text: Romina, Saint of the Bud: Legend type boss Drops 380,000 Runes when defeated and Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud: Dropped by Romina, Saint of the Bud . Can be consumed for Runes or handed to Enia at te Roundtable Hold , for Poleblade of the Bud or Rotten Butterflies .
Dryleaf Dane's summon sign can be found next to the road outside.
Activate the Church of the Bud grace after the fight.
Continue ahead and use Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree.

title: Spiraltree Seal
text: Somber Smithing Stone [9]: Upgrade Material found in Enir-Ilim, right next to the Site of Grace and directly next to where the Tarnished will spawn when they teleport into the location from Church of the Bud
Activate the Enir-Ilim: Outer Wall grace next to the shut door and rest at it.
Spiraltree Seal: Reward for completing "The Sacred Tower" Painting Puzzle .

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to Enir-Ilim and make your way into a tower with the First Rise grace inside.

Messmerfire Grease: From the second fountain, turn back and move forward. Enemies will attack you from a bridge, turn right as soon as you can. You will find two shadow enemies. You will then find another Messmerfire Grease nearby.
You can send the shortcut lift down to Belurat, but it is already usable from both ends.
Head up the stairs near the grace to find a Somber Smithing Stone [8] on a broken span.
Drop down from the roofs and go up the stairs. Pick up a Broken Rune from the ash on the right.
Rune Arc: Continue following the path up the stairs and you'll see a corpse on the ground with this item.
Revered Spirit Ash: Climb up after defeating the two Gravebirds and you will spot a Shadow Pothead enemy. Grants 735 Runes upon defeat. Drops x1 Revered Spirit Ash and x1 Golden Horn Tender.

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Pick up the Budding Horn x4 surrounded by a group of Inquisitors.
In the courtyard's eastern corner is a corpse with Lightningproof Pickled Liver x2.
Looking north, jump over the fence to land next to a corpse with Thin Beast Bones x8.
Circle around the tree to pick up Whiteflesh Mushroom x3.
Follow one of the tree's roots to a corpse with Redflesh Mushroom x4.

Revered Spirit Ash: After defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, head to the right side of the arena to find a lift. Take the lift up and proceed forward to open a large door. Once through, you will find the altar nearby that has a Revered Spirit Ash.

title: Furlcalling Finger Remedy
text: Furlcalling Finger Remedy: After dealing with the Horned Warrior, you will see a platform on the northern side with a tree shaman and an item. You can drop down to the tree branches below if you want to go there. Immediately after dropping down, you can loot x3 Furlcalling Finger Remedy behind you.

title: Spira
text: Spira: Enir-Illim: Found on small altar that is directly in front of statue, accessed by walking on the tree branches leading to this small broken-off platform

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Past the Divine Beast Warrior is a corpse with a Dragonbolt Grease.

Drawstring Golden Grease: Continue following the path going up the stairs. Once you get past the Dragonbolt Grease, continue heading up the stairs. Be wary of enemies in the area. Check the left side corner and you'll find a corpse with this item.
Quickly grab the Fire Arrow x10 and Golden Bolt x10 when running up the rest of the stairs.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be looted by Miquella's Cross of the Spiral Rise Site of Grace.

title: Inquisitor Ashes
text: Inquisitor Ashes: They can be found on a corpse in Enir-Ilim, beneath the second to last enemy before reaching the Spiral Rise site of grace (coming from First Rise site of grace).

title: Boss: Radahn, Consort of Miquella
text: This is the next form of Radahn that's faster and more dangerous.

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Fireproof Pickled Liver: Drop down to the stairs, and you can pick up x2 Fireproof Pickled Liver from the body.

Holyproof Pickled Liver: Found after dropping down from the spiral incantation inquisitors. You'll come across a broken section of the narrow edge going to an item. Jump to get to the other side, and you can pick up x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver.
Drop through the broken arch to land near a corpse with Smithing Stone [8] x3.

Lordsworn's Bolt: x10 Jump down to progress toward Euporia. Found as you drop down to a spiral ledge and traverse the ledge going southwest. Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it.
Follow the ledge down to drop onto a staircase, then grab the Somber Smithing Stone [8] in the tower.

Fireproof Pickled Liver: Follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.
Scadutree Fragment: x1 Scadutree Fragment can be found on the altar near the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

title: Euporia
text: Up the northeastern stairs is a lift that takes you back to Enir-Ilim.
Euporia: Found after dropping down a secret area in Enir Ilim, after doing some difficult platforming

title: Revered Spirit Ash
text: Return to the Spiral Rise grace and go up the stairs to reach the rooftops. Pick up Smithing Stone [8] x5 from a raised roof on the right.
Revered Spirit Ash: 2 Revered Spirit Ash can be found on the alter in the middle of the room infested by Spider-Scorpions.

title: Horned Warrior Ashes
text: From the stairs, jump over the railing to land on a staircase with a Silver Horn Tender.
Horned Warrior Ashes: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the left side.
Stanching Boluses: After jumping down the broken staircase, head up and enter the room, you'll find this on a corpse on the right side. This is the same room as the Horned Warrior Ashes

title: Scadutree Fragment
text: Climb the ladder to a corpse with a Golden Horn Tender hanging from the broken balustrade.

Scadutree Fragment: Location: Outer Tower of Enir-Ilim. After picking up the previous Revered Spirit Ash, continue heading up the stairs and you'll find a room with an altar where x1 Scadutree Fragment can be picked up.

title: Gravebird Helm
text: In the corner east of the room is a corpse with Sunwarmth Stone x2.
Continue up to a tower, then pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [7] at the bottom of the stairs.
Gravebird Helm: Found on a ledge by the lift on the spiral staircase - technically above the site of grace. Accessed by jumping onto the platform from the lift

title: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
text: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone: From the altar with an elevator, head outside and go down. Be wary of an enemy lurking in the area. Get past the enemy and you'll find this material on a corpse at the edge of a broken stairs.
Horned Warrior's Greatsword: Guaranteed drop from the Wind-Aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim.

title: Invader: Needle Knight Leda, Leda's Sword
text: Activate the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom grace and grab the last Scadutree Fragment. Note: This is your last chance to decide Moore's fate, pass St. Trina's final words to Thiollier, deliver Freyja's letter, and give Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll before exhausting his dialogue.
Note: This is your last chance to decide Moore's fate, pass St. Trina's final words to Thiollier, deliver Freyja's letter, and give Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll before exhausting his dialogue.

Needle Knight Leda: From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Needle Knight Leda as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.
Leda's Sword: Dropped by Needle Knight Leda upon defeat.

title: Freyja's Greatsword, Freyja's Set
text: Thiollier can be summoned if you passed on St. Trina's final words after his invasion. Summoning him unlocks a dialogue option with Ansbach (if he is also summoned).

Ansbach can be summoned if you gave him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhausted his dialogue. Summoning him causes him to appear before the final battle, allowing you to speak with him for some extra dialogue.
Sanguine Noble Nataan can be summoned if Ansbach is not available.
If Moore appeared in the fight, loot Moore's Bell Bearing, the Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set from his corpse.
Freyja's Greatsword: Can be looted from Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim .

Freyja's Set: The following armor pieces of the Freyja's Set can be obtained by looting Freyja's body after defeating her in Enir-Ilim : Freyja's Helm Freyja's Armor Freyja's Gauntlets Freyja's Greaves

title: Invader: Redmane Freyja
text: From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Redmane Freyja as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Dane's Footwork
text: If Hornsent appeared in the fight, loot the Falx and the Hornsent Set from his corpse.
Dane's Footwork: Defeat Dryleaf Dane as part of the Enir-Illim event.

title: Invader: Dryleaf Dane
text: Enir-Ilim - From the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace, exit the room east and you'll find a gold summon sign for Pureblood Knight Ansbach and a red blood summon sign to challenge Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Interacting with the red blood summon sign will have Dryleaf Dane as one of the invaders to spawn in the area.

title: Leda's Armor
text: Leda's Armor: Can be looted from Leda's body after defeating him in Enir-Ilim .

title: Boss: Promised Consort Radahn
text: If you summoned Ansbach, he appears at the top of the last lift. Ask him about Mohg's death. If you also summoned Thiollier, you can also ask him about Thiollier.
Head up the final set of stairs to activate the Divine Gate Front Staircase grace.
Promised Consort Radahn: Promised Consort Radahn is an imposing, fully armored humanoid enemy adorned in red and gold, wielding two colossal swords. and is found in Enir-Ilim.
Remembrance of a God and a Lord: Dropped by Radahn, Consort of Miquella upon defeat.

title: Thiollier's Hidden Needle, Thiollier's Set
text: Thiollier's and Ansbach's summon signs can be found outside the entrance if they were each summoned against Leda and her allies.
Activate the Gate of Divinity grace and rest at it to reload the area.
Thiollier's Hidden Needle: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight.-

Thiollier's Set: Summon Thiollier during the battle at the end of his questline, then loot his body in the boss arena after the fight. Thiollier's Hidden Needle Thiollier's Mask Thiollier's Garb Thiollier's Gloves Thiollier's Trousers
miss: You must pass on St. Trina's final words to Thiollier before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Obsidian Lamina, Furious Blade of Ansbach
text: Obsidian Lamina: Complete the entirety of Sir Ansbach's questline by assisting him. This weapon will be available at the end of his questline after the Final Boss where he will be by the entrance to the arena after the fight.

Furious Blade of Ansbach: Complete Sir Ansbach's questline all the way through the end, and side with him when facing Leda, and then Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella . After the fight is over, Sir Ansbach's body will be near the site of grace, alongside with his equipment and this Incantation.
miss: The Obsidian Lamina and Furious Blade of Ansbach are missable if you don't give him the Secret Rite Scroll and exhaust his dialogue before fighting Leda and her allies in Enir-Ilim.

title: Let Us Go Together
text: Let Us Go Together: Obtained after being grabbed by Radahn, Consort of Miquella while charmed or by picking it up inside the arena after the fight.

title: Circlet of Light
text: Circlet of Light: First, defeat Promised Consort Radahn / Radahn, Consort of Miquella in Enir-Ilim. After the battle, at the center of the boss arena, towards the golden orb. Select "Touch Memory" to trigger a cutscene. You'll obtain this item after the cutscene plays.

title: St. Trina's Blossom
text: St. Trina's Blossom: This item drops after completing St. Trina's questline. It can be picked up from her fallen body inside the Garden of Deep Purple.

If you forgot to make the choice for Moore's questline and he is still at the Main Gate Cross, you'll have to kill him for his loot. Kill two of the Forager Brood to cause him to invade, then finish him off for the Verdigris Greatshield and the Verdigris Set. Pick up Moore's Bell Bearing from where he usually sits.
Congratulations on completing Shadow of the Erdtree! Now return to the base game or prepare for NG+.

title: Talk to St. Trina
text: NPC is located at the end of the Stone Coffin Fissure. You will need to defeat the Putrescent Knight boss first to reach the very end of the Stone Coffin Fissure. From the Garden of Purple Site of Grace, go straight and follow the path until you enter the room filled with purple-glowing flowers.
